Preface[]

A number of the incidents recounted of Wolverine's life are cited to have occurred in specific decades relative to the era of publication. However, the Earth-616 universe operates on a Sliding Timescale these events could not have occurred in the times they appeared due to the fact that it would drastically age the character.

However, Wolverine is unique in the sense that he was born during the late 19th century and that his powers allow him to age slower than an ordinary human which means that despite being well over 100 years of age, Wolverine retains the health, appearance and physical vitality of a man in the physical prime of his life.

Wolverine's early history from his birth to his escape from the Weapon X experiment in the 1970s are considered to have happened in "real time". As such the length of time between his escape from the Weapon X compound and his encounter with James and Heather Hudson should be considered relative to the sliding timescale.

Origin[]

Childhood[]

Wolverine's life began in Cold Lake, Alberta, Canada, sometime between 1882 and 1885.[1] The mutant who would come to be known simply as "Logan" was born James Howlett, the illegitimate son of Elizabeth Howlett (who was married to John Howlett, owner of a large estate) and the Howletts' grounds-keeper, Thomas Logan. As a boy, James was notably frail and prone to bouts of allergic attacks. He was largely neglected by his mother, who had been institutionalized for a time following the death of her first son, John Jr., in 1897. James was constantly under the pressure of his grandfather, Mr. Howlett, who believed that James required constant punishment by a strong hand, in order to be raised properly. "Firm, but fair," was what Mr. Howlett said to justify his abusive actions.[2]

James spent most of his early years on the Howlett Estate grounds with two playmates that lived at the estate with him: Rose O'Hara, a red-headed Irish girl who was brought in from town to be a companion to young James, and a boy nicknamed "Dog", Thomas Logan's son (and James's half-brother). The children were close friends, but, as they reached adolescence, the abuse inflicted upon Dog warped his mind. Dog made unwanted advances towards Rose, which James reported to his father. In retaliation, Dog killed James' puppy, leading to the expulsion of Thomas and Dog from the estate.

Thomas, in a drunken stupor and armed with a shotgun, invaded the Howlett Estate with his son and attempted to take his former lover Elizabeth with him. John Sr. attempted to stop him and Thomas shot him in the head, in cold blood. James had just entered the room when this occurred and his mutation finally manifested: bone claws extended from the backs of his hands and he attacked the intruders with uncharacteristic ferocity, killing Thomas and scarring Dog's face with three claw marks.[3] Already an emotionally disturbed woman since the death of her first son, Elizabeth, completely unhinged, drove James away and took her life immediately afterward with a blast from Thomas' gun.

Rose fled the estate with James in tow, hiding in a shed. James experienced his heightened senses for the first time telling Rose that he could smell apple dumplings.

Dog falsely reported to the police and James' grandfather that Rose had murdered John Sr. and Thomas. Rose led James to his grandfather's house, but Mr. Howlett simply ordered them to flee by train, with cold, cruel eyes, but still used his influence in town to help the pair escape, due to blood ties. Rose then fled the estate with James, who appeared to have been deeply traumatized and his healing factor had somehow driven the trauma from his memories, leaving him partially amnesiac.[4]

"Little Smitty"[]

James and Rose later found themselves taking refuge in a British Columbia stone quarry, under the guise of being cousins. James also assumed the name of "Logan," in order to hide his identity. Within months, as the hard work of mining and the tough environment provoked traumatic changes in his body, Logan grew to be unusually healthy and ferocious, displaying enhanced agility and strength, possessing animal-like heightened senses that rivaled any animal's and learning to break the rocks by hating and bullying them.[5][6]

Later, Logan stated that it was a piece of his grandfather's devil personality. In his adulthood, James came to resemble the appearance of the groundskeeper much more closely than his legal father. Logan became a valuable and admirable figure among the small community of miners, due to his hard work and strong ethics, earning him the respect of his peers.

Even the foreman, Smitty, who became a surrogate father figure to Logan, was impressed with him. Logan even gained the nickname "Little Smitty," due to their similar work ethics, and this brought him into conflict with Cookie Malone, Smitty's original favorite.[5]

Cookie took an instant dislike to Logan and continually hurt him, until Smitty came to his rescue. Cookie even shortened the fuse to an explosive of Logan's, killing five men. Cookie also cut Logan and Rose's rations, so Logan hunted deer in the woods and gave the extra to the neighbors, which made him more loved. Logan was immune to the elements, due to his healing factor, and even ran with the wolves in the forest, learning to hunt like an animal. Logan also defeated Cookie in a cage match, where he earned the nickname "the Wolverine." It was said that no one could beat Logan in a cage fight. After his victories, Logan would hear "It's not the size of the dog in the fight. It's the size of the fight in the dog" a phrase that he repeated out loud to make it come true. During this period, Logan developed strong feelings for Rose, but could not act on them for the sake of their guise as cousins. Smitty, who had been mentoring Logan all these years, had also grown close to Rose and the two eventually fell in love and became engaged, much to the scorn and surprise of Logan, who later accepted the situation for the sake of Rose's happiness.

Meanwhile, his grandfather, Mr. Howlett, was in failing health and asked Dog to find Rose and his grandson, so he could make peace with them before he died. Dog agreed; however, Dog (who had become a physically formidable man himself) decided to track them down, so he could kill Logan. Dog hunted Logan and Rose down so easily that it seemed he had a preternatural skill for tracking.[7]

On the night that Smitty was due to leave the mining town with Rose, Logan fought him but allowed him to win, hoping to reconcile with him and Rose, but Dog finally found and confronted Logan. Dog reminded Logan of his past as James Howlett and that fateful night back on the estate that had changed all their lives. The two fought fiercely in the middle of the street and, despite being the physically stronger of the two, Dog was eventually overpowered by the enraged Logan.

As Dog lay unconscious, Logan unsheathed his claws, for the first time in public (to the shock of everyone watching), and was about to deal the deathblow, when Rose leaped in to stop him, but was accidentally impaled by his claws. Horrified, Logan held her in his arms as she died. Stricken with grief and guilt for the death of his first love, Logan fled into the nearby woods, where he lived in self-imposed exile in a feral state with a pack of wolves for a while.[8] Logan also tried to kill himself several times for what he did to Rose, but his healing factor always brought him back to life.[9][10]

One day, while he was traveling with his wolf pack, Logan came across a Native American camp and discovered that the whole tribe had been killed, and standing here in the middle of this massacre, he met for the first time face to face, Death itself. Logan wondered if Death was responsible for this massacre and if that was the case he wanted to be killed too, but before he could get an answer, Logan learned that the true responsible of this massacre was a criminal who wanted to steal the pelts of this Native American tribe. Logan was disgusted by the thief's actions and told him that he was evil, the criminal then told him that the reason Death was just standing here was because she was waiting for him to die, and as he was about to die Death approached him and took his soul. Seeing this scene, Logan attacked Death and told her to take him too since he had no one left but Death left him alone, Logan then wondered if Death was just here to amuse herself and take this murderer's life because he deserved it or because she was needed here since it was this criminal's time to go.[11]

After this encounter, Logan decided to resign himself to his fate and kept living with his wolf pack, but Dog continued to hunt him and his pack of wolf all over Canada in the years that followed, and after killing half of his wolf pack, he finally cornered Logan outside of an old mine along the Yukon river. Thinking Logan was inside, Dog entered the mine in order to kill him once and for all, but in here he discovered several strange diamonds that teleported him to the future where he would spend years preparing for his revenge against his half-brother.[12][13][14]

The Creeds[]

In 1907, Logan was still living with his wolf pack in the wilderness and was now at peace with his new family. But Logan's peaceful days ended, when Nathaniel Essex sent a weaponized polar bear near Logan's pack. Logan saw it from afar but decided to leave it alone, but one day while Logan was away, the bear killed and ate all the wolves Logan was living with. When Logan discovered this massacre, he attacked the bear and during their brutal fight both the bear and Logan mortally wounded each other. Thanks to his healing factor, Logan survived and the bear died, but after this hollow victory, Logan was now all alone once again.[15]

Soon after, Essex sent several of his men to investigate the death of the bear and after finding its corpse, they quickly understood that the bear hadn't been killed by a man or an animal but by something else. Back in town, rumors started to spread about this incident, which attracted the attention of Essex but also of Hugo, a circus promoter, and his associates the Creed siblings: Saul, a tracker and Clara, an animal trainer.

Essex was able to locate Logan and was happy to finally discover that he was a mutant, he then sent his personal army after him: The Marauders. But despite their training and the use of chemical weapons, Logan defeated all of them and escaped. Not far from here, Hugo and his men were also on Logan's trail and thanks to Saul's tracking skills, they were able to find him. Logan attacked them but in the midst of the fight, Clara believed that Logan wasn't just an animal but also a man and tried to calm him down. As a result, Logan let his guard down, but Saul used this opportunity to get the jump on him, Logan was then beat down and captured by Hugo's men which angered Clara.[16]

Logan, now known as "The Clawed Man of the Woods", became the new attraction of the circus where he was tortured by Hugo and Saul on a daily basis, and despite Clara's pleas to have him talk to her so she could help him, Logan stayed silent. Saul on the other hand became jealous of his sister's attraction towards Logan and as result he started to hate him.

But Essex was still fascinated by Logan, and decided to get his hands on him by any means, he decided to lure Hugo with Logan to his laboratory where he killed Hugo and started to torture and experiment on Logan. After a whole day of violent experiments, Essex discovered how Logan's healing factor worked and intended to continue his torture session the next day. Fortunately for Logan, Clara convinced her brother, Saul to help her rescue him that night. At first, Logan told them to run, but after Clara told him that he didn't really meant it, he asked for her help, she then freed him and the trio escaped from Essex' laboratory.[9]

For a month, Clara tried to teach Logan how to act like a man but to no success making Logan believed he was a lost cause. But Clara didn't give up on him and as time went on, they became romantically involved which made Saul even more jealous than before. To get rid of Logan and to make sure that Clara would never leave him alone, he contacted Essex and gave him their location. Shortly after, Essex sent his Marauders after Logan and Clara, Logan was able to defeat them but in a berserker rage he accidentally stabbed Clara and he thought she died.

After discovering what he's done, Logan's memories of Rose's resurfaced and his mind almost shut down once again, but Saul arrived shortly after and decided to lure Logan to Essex' location in order to get their revenge for Clara's death. But unknown to Logan, Clara wasn't dead, she was also a mutant and possessed an healing factor just like him and Saul.[10]

Shortly after, Logan and Saul arrived at Essex' laboratory where Logan confronted Essex and discovered the truth about how Saul betrayed him and Clara. After this revelation, Logan stabbed Essex and threw him through a window and confronted Saul for what he did.

Logan beat Saul down but before could finish him, Saul told him about a strange potion Essex created, a potion that could remove the memories of anyone and tried to manipulate him into drinking it for what he did to Clara. But before Logan could make a choice, he was soon stopped by the return of Clara who told him the truth about her powers. But after what happened with the bear and what Saul did to them, Logan decided to kill Saul to make sure he would never hurt anyone ever again. Despite Clara's pleas, Logan drown Saul in a vat full of the potion created by Essex to remove the memories of anyone, which killed him.

After the death of her brother, Clara told Logan that he was a just a coldhearted killer for what he did and she never wanted to see him ever again, Logan then left and never saw Clara again. Four months later, Clara joined another circus where she was found by her older brother, Victor who wanted to maintain his years-long tradition of beating and bullying Saul on his birthday. Clara then told Victor about Saul's death and how he was now free from him, which prompted Victor to go after Logan to get his revenge.[17]

In 1909, Victor Creed found found Logan unconscious in the middle of a crime scene, the victim of this murder was the third in as many months and Creed believed that Logan was the mysterious serial killer the police was after. Creed didn't care about the murders though, he was already following Logan since he wanted revenge for what Logan did to his sister, Clara, and to his brother, Saul.

Before the police arrived, Creed snatched the unconscious Logan from the crime scene and took him to the Ravencroft Institute in Westchester County where he was working as Nathaniel Essex' assistant. Seeing Logan again made Essex eager to resume his experiments on him. To that end, Essex lobotomized Logan which put him in a comatose state, he then proceeded to cut Logan's left arm off while Creed was enjoying seeing Logan suffer. One night, one of the doctors, Claudia Russell, was able to free Logan and tried to help him escape but on their way out the duo was confronted by Creed.

Creed threw Logan away and confronted Claudia, when suddenly Logan’s healing factor kicked back, it started to heal his brain and he finally awoken from his comatose state. Logan then sneaked up behind Creed and thrust his claws into his throat before being thrown away again by his foe. Knowing that Logan had no chance against Creed in his condition, Claudia begged him to escape while Creed was injured. Despite still being in a feral state because of his brain injury, Logan understood and agreed to escape.

Before Creed could go after Logan, Claudia revealed to him that Logan was not responsible for the murders, those murders happened during a full moon, and she was the killer but it was an accident. She then transformed into a Werewolf and attacked the injured Creed who was saved by Essex resulting in Claudia's capture. Creed and Essex later experimented on Claudia and killed her.[18] With his brain recovering from Essex's lobotomy, Logan wandered back to Canada. While in Niagara Falls, his feral instincts sparked a deadly bar brawl.[19]

It was supposedly around this time that Romulus, an immortal being who used and manipulated the members of the Hudson line (Logan's mother's family) for decades, decided to take an interest in Logan.

The Amazing Immortal Man[]

Birthday Surprise[]

Possibly on his first trip to Japan, Logan encountered members of the ninja sect known as the Hand. The Hand extorted Logan into fighting Sabretooth, another Romulus operative who was murdering women in Tokyo.[20] During their fight, Logan discovered that Sabretooth possessed an healing factor just like him but he still managed to defeat his foe and impaled him with his sword. Before Logan could finish Sabretooth, their fight was stopped by Romulus who knocked Logan out. After he awakened, Sabretooth was gone, Logan decided to head back to Canada but first he made a stop in Madripoor.[21][22]

In Madripoor, apparently under Romulus' guidance, Logan became a mercenary, while here he also met and romanced Seraph, a diminutive woman employed by Romulus, who had instructed her to form such relationship with Logan. In the next years Logan would realize that Seraph and other knowledges were under a single authority, but he didn't know or care who it was at the time.[23]

At some point later, Logan traveled to another frontier community in the Canadian Rockies and met a young Blackfoot Indian woman, named Silver Fox, with whom he fell in love.[24] The two shared a cabin together and lived happily for a time. Logan had made a new life for himself: hunting and farming chores around the homestead was now his daily routine, but, as ever, there were other forces at work in his life. When Sabretooth visited the area and helped Logan defend Silver Fox's honor during a bar fight with the locals, Logan, his memories of their previous encounter erased, befriended him.[25] On Logan's birthday, Sabretooth, possibly under Romulus' orders, brutally attacked Silver Fox, raping her and leaving her for dead, the first of many birthday "surprises" from him to come. Enraged, Logan battled him in a bar, only to be defeated.[26]

Sabretooth then manipulated a feral, mindless Logan into believing the people of a nearby town had ordered Silver Fox's death, prompting Logan to slaughter the inhabitants of the town, persuading him that "the townspeople are afraid of you--they don't want you around. So, they got rid of the one thing keeping you here."[27]

Later, employed by the Hudson's Bay Company as a fur trader to the Blackfoot Indians, Logan defeated the demonic snake-worm, known as Uncegila, a feat which earned him the Blackfoot warrior name of "Skunk-Bear" (or "Wolverine").[28]

Around 1911, Logan was in Montana where he was helping locals when things went bad, at the time, Logan was known as the unkillable "Man From Up North". One day, the locals called on Logan after finding 4 dead bodies but Logan discovered that there was no witness and that the murderers covered up their tracks. Logan then met for the first time a time traveling Loki who told him that he could help him tracked the murderers, Loki then jokingly told Logan that his name was "bub" although after seeing Loki used his powers, Logan has his own idea about Loki's true nature.

The duo then tracked the murderers to a nearby saloon and after a brutal fight, they were able to capture the criminals alive.[29]

But unknown to Logan, Romulus was about to shape him into the perfect killer and as a result wherever Logan went, Creed, one of his handlers, was not far behind.

World War I[]

Before the start of World War I, Logan joined the Canadian Army, where he was assigned to the Devil's Brigade, a special Canadian military unit sometimes used by Romulus.

In 1912, a super-humanly strong man known as Silas Burr (who would later become the mercenary Cyber) became Logan's new commanding officer. Burr was formerly an agent of the Pinkerton Private Detective Agency, where he abused his position, committing several atrocities, even burning down a schoolhouse full of children once and was later sentenced to death for his crimes. Burr was rescued from the courthouse, by Victor Creed, and brought to the training facility where Logan was, in here he was hired by Frederick Hudson due to his sadistic nature.[30][31]

Under Frederik Hudson's orders Burr had to make Logan's life a nightmare, not to keep him under control but to turn him into an obedient animal bred to kill. To that end another Romulus operative, Janet, was used by Burr in order to make Logan fell in love with her.[32]

When World War I started, Logan alongside other soldiers were deployed to Europe,[33] and while fighting in Ypres, Belgium, on April 22, 1915, Logan encountered a being called Lazaer (an anagram of Azrael, the Angel of Death) armed with a large broadsword and he had been using it to kill soldiers on the same battlefield. They began to fight one another, with Lazaer initially gaining the upper hand, but, after being impaled with Lazaer's sword, Logan pulled it from his chest and stabbed his surprised opponent with it.[34]

Besting Lazaer in combat sent Logan into a deep depression, even causing him to put a gun to his own head at one point. Logan started to drink considerably more as the war dragged on and ate less and less, until Lazaer finally confronted him. Lazaer explained that the depression was a punishment for defeating him and defying the natural order of things. It was also later revealed that because Logan defeated Lazaer, whenever Logan was wounded severely enough to tax even his healing factor, he recovered by defeating Lazaer in an astral arena.[35]

In October 1918, Logan was present in the north of France and was still fighting in the Great War as part of a Canadian squad alongside a psychic mutant, Lieutenant Link.[36] Their mission was to take by surprise a bridge held by German troops, Logan was able to make his way through the camp and took down several German soldiers and despite some setbacks after meeting a familiar German soldier named Egon Hiban and his psychic link with Bellamy, Logan was able to complete his mission forcing the German troops to surrender.

On November 11, 1918, Logan was in Paris just after the signature of the Armistice marking the end of the war. People thanked Logan for his help in this victory but the cost of winning this war and the words of Egon Hiban were still haunting Logan.[37]

Kansas City Bank Robbery[]

After the end of World War I, Logan returned to America and in 1921, he found himself in the Mexican Sonoran Desert beaten, locked up by the local police, and accused of horse thievery. As Logan was blindfolded and tied to a post to be shot by a firing squad, a voice next to him asked if he was a murderer. Logan answered, “...worse, a horse thief.” The person next to him turned out to be Mystique, who was also about to be killed for having blue skin. The locals thought she was a witch, even though she explained that she was simply born different, and Logan laughed at meeting someone like her there of all places. Mystique managed to untie herself, just before the firing squad shot, and Logan survived, due, once again, to his healing factor, and killed the guards.[38]

After they both escaped, Mystique stood surprised that Logan was able to survive and asked how he knew she would be able to free herself and escape. Logan responded, “I didn't,” and, when she asked where he was going to next, he said the nearest bar. Mystique introduced herself to Logan and said that she had a group of friends in Kansas City that he would probably like to meet.

Once in Kansas City, Mystique told Logan about her group, who scammed people. After meeting her crew, and saving one of them from an angry mark, Mystique informed Logan that she and her crew were planning a bank heist and she wanted him to take part in it. When Logan expressed his reluctance to get attached to people, she told him that she knew it was hard to trust people, but that they could be a family and to trust her. They kissed and Logan decided to help her.[39]

However, because Mystique didn't pay off the cops like she said so, Logan tipped off the police about the planned bank robbery. Mystique cut and ran, and despite Logan's protests, her crew was killed by the police. Logan again found himself alone and with a festering hatred for the woman he had come to trust.[40] He continued his own criminal activities for a few years, smuggling bootleg alcohol during Prohibition in the mid-1920s.[41]

Prohibition Era and learning espionage[]

In 1929, during the Prohibition Era, Logan's alcohol smuggling activities put him in conflict with Al Capone and his hitman, Victor Creed. Creed then assassinated Logan’s girlfriend, Molly Barker, and lured him to the site of the infamous St. Valentine's Day Massacre, which he barely survived.[42]

Sometime during the 30s, Logan went to Shanghai, China, and he intervened in a conflict between locals, soldiers from the Japanese Imperial Army and their captain, Ogun. Impressed by Logan's bravery and defiance, Ogun offered to train him in the martial arts at the Ogun Ryu Dojo in Kanazawa, but Logan declined.[43]

Shortly after in Kentucky, the ruthless owner of a coal mine was using force in order to brutalize the miners who worked for him each time they went on strike because of their poor working conditions. One day, having enough of those strikes, the man brought in the Pinkertons who made a massacre among the miners and forced them to go back to work.

After this massacre, the miners decided to send a special negotiator, someone new, someone that was sent by the Hudson's Bay Company to help them: Logan. Logan made quick work of the Pinkertons and forced the owner to sit down at the bargaining table with one member of the workers union in order to hear their demands. But the owner ashamed of having to bargain, started to drink, lost his temper and killed the member of the workers union in cold blood.

In retaliation, Logan killed him but the son of the owner saw everything and despite Logan warning him to not chase him and to move on with his life, the boy swore revenge on Logan. As time passed the boy became a man, and after several unsuccessful attempts to kill Logan along the years he decided to find other people like him, other people who wanted revenge on Logan and together they created the criminal organization known as the Red Right Hand. The man would later become their leader and would be known as the Founder.[44]

In 1931, Logan was in South Africa where he met an herd of elephants and befriended one of the youngest one named Lull,[45] unfortunately not long after, the herd was found by two hunters, Sasha and Sergei Kravinoff. The two hunters started to shoot the elephants but Logan was able to stop them and made them run away, unfortunately Lull's mother and sister were killed in the process and the herd decided to move away but knowing that there was no safe place on earth for them anymore.[46]

By 1932 Logan was in Madripoor again, and Seraph taught him how to be a better assassin. Around this time, Logan started to use his recurrent alias "Patch."[23]

In 1933, Logan resumed his smuggling activites and was carrying whiskey down from Canada, with his friend Elias from World War I but one day the duo was confronted by rival bootleggers in Minnesota. Elias was killed during the attack and Logan was heavily injured but thanks to his healing factor, he survived. To honor his friend's memory, Logan decided to fulfill his final request and get Elias' children to safety at their aunt's farm in South Dakota. Logan was successful in his mission and as a reward he was gifted a motorcycle.[47]

In 1934, Logan went to Marrakesh where was hired by the Covenant to kill the Dreaming Maiden, but Logan couldn't do it and decided to hide her somewhere safe in a cave.[48] To make sure she couldn't be found, he asked her to stop using her powers until he found a way to save her, as a result she stopped dreaming and turned to crystal.[49] In 1935 in Shanghai, Logan reported back to the Covenant that the Dreaming Maiden was dead and despite the fact that the Covenant wanted Logan to kill more people like her, he refused and walked away.[50] Unfortunately Logan's memories would be altered afterwards and for years she would remain hidden, but during all those years she grew angry and one day she would start dreaming again.[51]

In 1936, Logan was in Scotland working with Raven Darkhölme and Irene Adler, two mutant adventurers and lovers. Maybe because of memory alteration, Logan was unaware that the apparently male Raven was Mystique. Around the same time he met for the first time Geist but also Kitty Pryde and Rachel Summers who time traveled to the past. The trio managed to stop the plans of Baron Von Struker and Amahl Farouk.[52][53]

Later, Logan went into action in Spain during its Civil War.[54]

Sometimes during the 30s in New York City, New York a member of the Bloodshadows gang named Hector tried to pickpocket Logan but Logan caught him and beat him up but Hector was able to stab Logan in the chest and sliced his throat with his knife but Logan survived. Believing that Logan was a vampire, Hector ran away and warned his boss, a young vampire hunter named Eric Brooks. Eric went after Logan but instead he was confronted by a true vampire who beat him up and was about to kill him, but Logan arrived just in time to confront the creature of the night. Logan proved to be faster than this vampire, he was able to defeat it and saved Eric’s life. After saving his life, Logan gave Eric his coat and helped him get back on his feet.[55]

In 1937, Logan, under Romulus' orders, started to learn espionage from Taras Romanov, and in turn Logan gave hand-to-hand combat lessons to Natalia Romanoff, Taras' ward. Logan trained with Taras for a little over 2 years.[56] According to Sabretooth, Logan was later involved in several espionage operations in Madripoor in 1938.[57] In that year, he also fell in love with aspiring actress Celia Stroud; the two moved to Hollywood but broke up after six months. While working on a film set, he was abducted by Morgan Le Fay using Celia's body as part of a plot to trade immortality for the mutant but her spells were not strong enough to control Logan's enraged mind.[58]

In 1940, Taras told Natalia to kill Logan as her final lesson before becoming an assassin, but unknown to Taras, Logan was also tasked by Romulus to kill both him and Natalia. As a result Logan killed Taras but couldn't bring himself to kill Natalia, he gave her Taras' ring and took her necklace and allowed her to depart, telling her that she was now dead to the rest of the world before disappearing. Natalia swore to repay her debt to Logan one day.[56][59] His training with Taras complete, Logan returned to the Devil's Brigade and to the training facility, soon to be involved in another war.

World War II[]

After Logan came back to the training facility, Silas Burr under the orders of Frederick Hudson, killed Janet as a lesson that whenever Logan overcame his inner bestial nature to care for someone, that person would die. Seeking for vengeance, Logan fought Burr, who severely beat him and gouged out his left eye.[60] Logan descended to a near-feral state, his healing factor again obscuring his traumatic memories, and he fled to the Canada's wilderness. Sabretooth and Cyber were able to track him down and manipulated him into being an obedient animal again.[32]

In the summer of 1941, Logan now back under Romulus and Burr's control, was sent to Madripoor in order to get a new assignment from Seraph. In here both Seraph and Logan worked with the U.S. super-soldier Captain America and others in order to sabotage an alliance between the Hand and the Baron Strucker, luring the Hand's Jonin, their leader, out of hiding. Natalia Romanov now calling herself Natasha Romanoff and a Romulus operative, wanted to kill the Jonin, but Logan, regretting how he trained her to be an assassin, killed the Jonin himself.[61] Later that same year, under orders to recruit or kill Captain America,[62] Logan worked with him and Bucky in Tunisia, where he met Sgt. Nick Fury.[32] Finally, Logan decided not to kill Captain America, creating a rift between Seraph and himself.[63]

In 1942, Logan spent some time in the Sobibor Death Camp in Poland, where he psychologically tortured three Nazi commandants by simply never speaking and returning every time they ordered him executed. While at Sobibor, Logan was known as "Prisoner Zero."[64] In 1943, he surfaced in Newell, California, overseeing inhumane experimentations on Japanese prisoners of war. Even though Logan had been a hardened killer, he was atypically cruel during this period, as his personality had probably been altered by Romulus.[65]

In 1944, Logan participated as a paratrooper for the 1st Canadian Parachute Battalion, during the Normandy landings on D-Day (June 6) where he slaughtered an entire Nazi patrol from the 21st Panzer-Grenadiers with only a knife. Unknown to Logan, one of the Nazis present on that day was none other than Bloodscream. After witnessing Logan's fury on that day, he became obsessed with him and he would become one of Wolverine's fiercest foes years later.[66]

While in France, Logan went to Paris and killed several high-ranking Nazi Officers, it was here that Logan met Hercules for the first time from afar, but Logan mistook him for Namor (since Hercules was forbidden to take part in this war by the Olympian Gods, he hid his true identity and posed as Namor).[67]

Afterwards Logan was sent to Greece in order to teach the Greek nationalists how to use explosives and to help them fight against the Nazis. His work done, Logan gave to a young Stavros his knife and resumed his work in other parts of Europe as a spy for the Allied Forces, during which he conducted many special covert missions.[68]

During the winter of 1944, Logan went back to France and helped a group of U.S. Soldiers against several German tanks in the Ardennes Forest. Seeing Logan in action and his heroism motivated the soldiers to resume the fight against the Nazis.[69]

While he was still in France, Logan and several soldiers from the Canadian Army discovered that the Nazis were forcing a French sorceress named Marie D'Arqueness to summon a powerful demon called "the Truth," in order to use it against the Allies or they would kill her daughter, Sylvie. Seeing no other choice, Marie summoned the demon but at the same time the Allied forces attacked the Nazis and she was wounded during her spell by one of the bullets fired.

As a result she lost control of her spell which resulted in a giant explosion, that freed the Truth and killed everyone around. Marie and Sylvie were able to survive thanks to a magical barrier created by Marie, and Logan also survived thanks to his healing factor. Back on his feet, Logan then helped Marie facing the Truth. As they were fighting this demon, the duo was confronted by a a future version of Logan, a future version of Sylvie and their daughter, Rien. The trio then tricked the Truth from their timeline into fighting the Truth of this reality while telling Logan to stand down.

Then with the help of Marie, the future Logan, the future Sylvie and Rien were able to trap the two demons in a magical cage, but to make sure that the two demons couldn't escape, the future Logan and the future Sylvie decided to stay behind in order to serve as a "lock" for this cage. Once the spell was completed, the two demons, the future Logan and the future Sylvie were turned to stone for eternity. With the crisis now averted, Rien decided to embrace Logan and revealed to him she was his daughter.[70]

Later, on April 28, 1945 Logan and the Devil's Brigade were tasked to infiltrate Germany in order to put an end to the German Super Soldier program but the entire unit was decimated during an aerial attack. Only Logan survived. On April 30, during the Walpurgis Night, Logan finally infiltrated the Nazi facility and discovered that several soldiers were changed into werewolves by the General Wolfram. Logan managed to defeat them but before he could kill Wolfram, he was stopped by Nick Fury.

Despite Logan's protests against letting Wolfram live after killing his whole unit, Fury explained that Wolfram could prove useful in the coming war against the USSR. Fury also revealed that both Captain America and Bucky Barnes had been killed by Baron Zemo and that the lead scientist in charge of the US Super Soldier program had died too, to that end Fury and the US needed Wolfram as part of this new program they had created: The Weapon Plus Program.[69]

Logan couldn't believe that Captain America was dead, he also considered that Fury made a deal with the devil by not letting him kill Wolfram and the news that the US were already preparing themselves for a new war while the current one wasn't even over yet, really made him fear for what the future had in store for him and the world.[69]

Later that same year, Logan was captured by Japanese soldiers in Japan, where he was sent to a prison camp near Hiroshima. Logan escaped from his cell along with Lt. Ethan Warren, an American soldier who was also captured, and found refuge and love in a local Japanese girl, named Atsuko.[71] Unfortunately, Lt. Warren, himself a mutant, returned and murdered the girl and the two men fought, until both were caught in the atomic bombing of Hiroshima that destroyed much of the city. Logan survived, but was devastated to lose another woman in his life.[72]

Landau, Luckman & Lake and Jasmine Falls[]

After the war ended, Logan was hired by Chang and started to work for Landau, Luckman & Lake. During one mission when he was guarding Michael Carling, a scientist for Landau, Luckman & Lake, Logan fought the immortal Kimora, who was after Carling's expertise in large-scale transportation between Earth and Kageumbra, his home dimension. Kimora defeated Logan, and even called him a beast in a man's clothing, however Carling managed to free himself and seemingly decapitated Kimora.[73]

After this mission, Logan decided to leave Landau, Luckman & Lake and went back to Japan, Logan remembered Ogun's offer and he went to his dojo to better learn self-discipline. There, Logan spent years under Ogun's tutelage, Ogun and Logan became friends, and as time went on Logan regarded Ogun as a surrogate father.[74] During this training Ogun taught Logan how to balance his human side and animal side in order to become a great warrior,[75] he also taught him about the Art of the Samurai and the teachings of Sun-Tzu.[76]

During one of their meditation sessions, Ogun and Logan were attacked by a group of ninja led by the criminal Lord Ugama Hana who wanted reparations from Ogun for wronging him in the past. Ogun told Logan to stand down and he quickly took down all the ninja before facing Hana. Their fight was brutal and the warriors were evenly matched, but in the midst of the battle Ogun decided to drop his sword and taunted Hana, who impaled him as a result. Suddenly, Ogun's eyes flashed red and he started to laugh, he then removed the Hana's sword from his stomach in front of an horrified Hana who then begged him for mercy, but Ogun beheaded him. On that night, Ogun revealed to a horrified Logan that he had discovered how to beat death.[77]

After this event, Ogun became more and more obsessed by Mystic Arts and he started to refine his new technique to cheat death, a forbidden process only used by the most skilled Master Ninja or the ones who were corrupted. Ogun's technique was a mix of magic and psychism, he recreated his whole existence in a psychic form, then he would copy this psychic form into someone, creating a psychic clone of himself in the head of one of his victim. As time went on, Ogun's personality would overtake the personality of his victim and he would take over their bodies completely with all his memories and skills intact.[78][79]

Ogun intended to use this technique on Logan to take over his body, but Logan left before Ogun could use this technique on him.[78] Not long after, Logan was still seeking redemption for his past actions and under Ogun's advice he went to Jasmine Falls, Japan, where he studied with Bando Saburo, in order to learn how to be a man and leave his warrior nature behind.[80]

While Logan was still training in Jasmine Falls, Kimora came back which prompted Chang to come to Logan and asked for his help to prevent the immortal warlord from conquering Earth with Carling's technology. They both traveled to Kageumbra, where Logan and Kimora fought once again. Logan relied this time upon meditative training and berserker rage, and he hurled Kimora into a dimension-traveling device, which he destroyed. Back on Earth, Chang offered to Logan a position with Landau, Luckman & Lake, but Logan declined and returned to Jasmine Falls to resume his training.[73]

During his fourth year of training, finally at peace since Silver Fox's supposed death, Logan met and fell in love with a local woman, named Itsu they married and conceived a child together which filled Logan with joy.[80]

One day while Logan was proving himself worthy of being a father in combat, the demon sword-smith, Muramasa, created an explosion that caused Logan to accidentally stab a villager with his claws. As a result, Logan was banned from the village, but before leaving he wanted to say one last good-bye to Itsu. Returning to their self-built home, Logan found Itsu murdered, by Bucky Barnes, now the brainwashed Winter Soldier. Although Barnes ostensibly served the USSR, he was acting under Romulus' orders in order to draw Logan out of hiding and back to Madripoor.[80]

After Itsu's death, Logan disappeared for a month, during this time he went to see Muramasa so he could help him to "kill 'em all." Muramasa accepted, and promised to forge him a "mighty blade -...- against which all... even one as great as you... will fall" by using a piece of Wolverine's soul.[81]

While awaiting new orders the Winter Soldier saw that Muramasa's underlings were transporting a still unconscious Logan after Muramasa extracted a piece of his soul. Bucky decided to ignore his orders and he killed Muramasa's men, Logan was then extracted 8 hours later.[80]

Unknown to Logan, Romulus took the child from Itsu's womb, and he was safely born and adopted by a Japanese couple. This child was named Akihiro, but he eventually took the name "Daken," which means "Mongrel." Nine years later Daken fell under the influence of Romulus, and he was told lies that his father despised him and abandoned him, filling Daken with hatred.[65][82]

Nuke, The Black Dragon and Cyber[]

In 1953, now back under Romulus' control, Logan helped into turning a young boy, named Frank Simpson, into the deranged super-soldier, Nuke. Frank was growing up watching his alcoholic mother constantly verbally abuse his meek father and was influenced by his babysitter (who was working for Romulus) into killing his mother. Meanwhile, as Frank's father drove the babysitter home, she abruptly pulled out his flask and began to drink it and then seduced him.[83]

After pulling over into the nearby woods, the couple was interrupted by a police officer, who was revealed to be Logan. Logan asked Frank's father to sit back in his seat and shot the babysitter, with Frank's gun. Logan then suggested that Frank's father had taken advantage of the babysitter, playing her with alcohol and even going so far as to shooting her because she resisted. Frank's father realized the gravity of the situation and, seeing no other way, he shot himself.[84] Afterwards Logan discovered that Frank killed his own mother, he then abducted him and years later he would oversee his conditioning in order to make him the perfect subject for the Project: Homegrown.[85]

During the late 50s, Logan went to a restaurant in San Francisco and more precisely in Chinatown in order to get some noodles but once he arrived he discovered that the owner of the restaurant and his daughter, Lin, were brutalized by the Black Dragon Tong, a criminal organization ruled by Lo Shang Cho, also known as the Black Dragon. Logan was able to scare the Black Dragon Tong away with his gun and was soon asked to help get rid of the Black Dragon by Lin and her father.[86]

After a vote, all the Chinatown Fighting Schools decided to unite under Logan's lead in order to take down the Black Dragon and his organization.[87] After a brutal battle, Logan was able to defeat Lo Shang Cho, he then beheaded him and ended his reign. Logan was then offered the spear of the Black Dragon Tong which made him the new Black Dragon and the leader of all the Chinatown Triads. But Logan didn't want any part of this, he just wanted to help the people of Chinatown by defeating Lo Shang Cho and after defeating him he decided to leave.

Logan's choice was perceived as an insult by Lin and all the Chinatown Fighting Schools, and after stabbing Logan in the eye with the Dragon spear Lin became the new Black Dragon instead of Logan and warned him to never come back.[88] It was during this adventure that Logan met for the first time, Master Po, a Kung Fu Master but at the time he refused to teach Logan.[86]

In 1959, Silas Burr came back from Indochina and started to train Daken in the same facility Logan was trained before World War I under Romulus' orders. But both Burr and Frederick Hudson were tricked by Romulus, as a result Hudson was killed and Burr was fatally injured by Daken. On the verge of dying, Romulus decided to spare Burr's life and had his skin laced with adamantium. Silas Burr became known as Cyber as a result and would become one of Wolverine's greatest foes in the future.[82]

CIA and Cold War[]

Shortly after Logan resurfaced as a mercenary, Chang arranged for Landau, Luckman & Lake to handle Logan's business affairs and find him assignments, in exchange Logan would do occasional services. He operated most of the times from Ottawa and Calgary, with few exceptions into South America and Madripoor, working for government agencies most notably the CIA and he became one of the deadliest free agents of the intelligence field.

Logan continued his espionage work, becoming a favorite of both America's and Canada's secret services, even teaming up with Ben Grimm (later known as the Thing) and Carol Danvers (later known as Captain Marvel)[89] as part of Cold War-era government missions. Logan also worked with CIA agent Rick Stoner in order to retrieve one of Hudson's prototype empowered-armor suits, stolen by Hydra.[90]

During his time into the CIA, Wolverine had also allegedly participated in strikes against three African leaders, stating on records and informations of the Mbangawi rode by the Doctor Crocodile.[91]

The Team X Project[]

By 1961, Logan, known as Wolverine now, joined the Weapon X Project, part of the Weapon Plus Program, which had been created to fight the mutant menace. Nevertheless, Weapon X only used mutants as superhuman operatives on international tasks. He was then placed on the Black Ops squad run by the CIA, called Team X, with Sabretooth, Silver Fox (it's unknown if they remembered their past history and how Silver Fox was still alive at this point), Maverick, Kestrel and Mastodon.[92] During this time, Logan and the others received memory implants via staged scenarios, telepathic manipulation by Aldo Ferro, and other technology.[93] Weapon X also duplicated Wolverine's healing factor and implanted it in Team X, slowing their aging processes.

In 1963, a few days after the Assassination of John F. Kennedy, Logan under the alias of Emilio Garra and Victor Creed under the alias of Julio/El Tigre were in Cuba alongside Silver Fox, but the duo was betrayed by Silver Fox to enemy soldiers and afterwards she fled Weapon X.[92]

The Sym-Soldiers[]

In 1966, Logan was contacted by Nick Fury to help him investigate and put a stop to the atrocities committed by the Sym-Soldiers in Vietnam. Logan decided to help Fury and they went to Vietnam, shortly after landing they discovered a survivor Rex Strickland, codenamed Tyrannosaurus, who was part of the Sym-Soldiers and who appeared to have been separated from his symbiote. The trio was then attacked by the Sym-Soldiers and Logan was taken over by Rex's symbiote. He was saved by Rex but after being bonded with the symbiote Logan discovered the truth, that this whole mission was a setup and that the Nick Fury he teamed up with was just a LMD.

The real Fury activated a bomb inside the LMD to destroy the symbiotes, Rex's symbiote - touched by Logan's compassion and influenced by Rex's nobility and inherit goodness - threw Logan outside the blast radius, saving his life.[94]

The End of Team X[]

During their time with Team X, Logan and Creed were sent to kill a high ranking NSA officer obsessed with several top secret projects and organizations including Team X. What Logan didn't remember, because of the brainwashing he suffered along the years, was the fact that the wife of this man Creed just killed knew him, because Logan also killed her father (who was also obsessed with several top secret projects and Logan) a long time ago. Creed was about to kill her but Logan stopped him and despite the woman's claims that she knew Logan and that he was a ruthless coward, Logan told her that no she didn't know him and he spared her life, the same way he spared her life after he killed her father years ago. But the woman would swear revenge and at the funeral of her husband she would meet an old man who hated Logan too. Thanks to his help, she killed Victor Creed's mother as a revenge for what Victor did to her husband, and later joined the old man's organization: the Red Right Hand.[95]

Between 1967 and 1968, during the Space Race between the US and the USSR, Logan and Team X were sent to kill Epsilon Red as part of the "Terry Adams" mission but Logan couldn't do it. Despite Epsilon begging Logan to kill him (because after the experimentations he suffered he couldn't feel anything anymore not even the touch of his wife), his wife on the other hand begged Logan to spare her husband's life.

Before Logan could make a choice, Sabretooth told him the mission was aborted and Logan left both Epsilon Red and his wife alive. Unknown to Logan, Epsilon Red also begged Sabretooth to kill him after Logan left but Creed refused and instead killed his pregnant wife in front of him just to make him suffer even more.[96]

In early 1968,[97] Wolverine was called to report in a facility located in Dallas, Texas, in here he was shot with Carbonadium bullets, which slowed his healing factor so that Weapon X or Romulus could know how to kill him.[98] The bullets were removed but Logan awoke earlier than expected, and he regained his memories for the first time in years, because they hadn't been altered yet.[99]

Logan tried to keep the secret, and he rendezvoused with Team X in Berlin, East Germany where the team was sent to steal the Carbonadium Synthesizer in order to sabotage the Russian Super Soldier program and save Janice Hollenbeck, a double agent. After retrieving the device, the team was attacked by the product of this new Russian Super Soldier program, Omega Red. During the team's escape, Sabretooth, apparently aware that Wolverine had regained his memories, killed Janice to reinforce Wolverine's conditioning about innocents dying when he overstepped Romulus' boundaries.[100] In the end, Team X was able to escape from Omega Red but it seemed the Carbonadium Synthesizer was lost.[101] In truth, Wolverine was still in possession of the Carbonadium Synthesizer and decided to hide it from the rest of the team. After this event, Logan quit Team X in late 1968.[102][103]

Unfortunately, Logan fell back under Romulus' influence shortly after, turning to atypically sadistic activities. Near the end of 1968,[104] Logan went back to Vietnam as a Russian adviser where he tortured and brainwashed Frank Simpson, now a soldier, into becoming a murderous madman, known as Nuke under Romulus' orders.[83] In 1971,[105] Logan served in Laos as part of the Vietnam War alongside his friend Sycame Blaine.[105][106]

Logan's women and the Mongrels[]

During all those years, Logan met and fell in-love with many women and unknown to him, he also fathered a number of children. Those children would be found later on by another one of Logan's son, Daken. On Daken’s advice, the Red Right Hand trained them, in order to use them as weapons against Logan but knowing perfectly that they wouldn't stand a chance against him. They would be known as the Mongrels.[107]

The Ultimate Weapon[]

Department K[]

Later on, Wolverine joined Department K, a secret Canadian Defense Ministry branch with ties to Weapon X. Based in Ottawa, he partnered with Neil Langram and worked again with Nick Fury, now a high-ranking CIA agent, and with Richard and Mary Parker (the parents of Peter Parker a.k.a the Amazing Spider-Man).[108]

Years later, Langram was sought as an operative by the Hellfire Club, but he refused, and he was then slain by Sabretooth, hired as a mercenary. Wolverine and Carol Danvers, a young US spy, investigated and infiltrated the Canadian Ministry of Defense, and more precisely a top secret research and development agency which was in its early stage of growth hidden in a sub-basement of this vast government complex: Department H. In here they discovered a list of several names called: "The Mutant Agenda", and more troubling both Neil Graham and Logan names were on it.

Logan and Carol then decided to track Doctor Perry Edwards, who wrote a book about the rise of superhumans and whose name was at the top of the list. The duo found him in New York and were able to save him from an assassination attempt, they then told him what they had found. He wasn't surprised and explained to them that he discovered the existence of genetically superior beings who were living among them: the Mutants. But more importantly he also discovered that some of those Mutants weren't benevolent and were planning to kill all the members of the inner circle of the Hellfire Club in their search for power, but to that end they needed to keep the existence of Mutantkind a secret.

After infiltrating the Hellfire Club in order to learn more, Logan and Carol were lured by Sebastian Shaw and Sabretooth to one of the Hellfire Club's Canadian facility where they were confronted by Sabretooth. After discovering that Sabretooth killed Perry Edwards and several government officials to make sure the existence of Mutantkind couldn't be revealed to the public, Sabretooth then told Wolverine details of the Club's intent to guide a war between mutants and humans. Sabretooth then tried to kill Logan, during their fight Sabretooth told Logan that it was time for him to admit the truth: he was a mutant just like him and that was why he was so obsessed by all this mutant's stuff.

Logan then understood that Sabretooth was the one who killed Langram which angered Logan who then proceeded to defeat Sabretooth by stabbing him with his sword. Despite the severe injury, Sabretooth wasn't done and he decided to bomb the facility, but Logan and Carol were able to escape in time. Sabretooth survived and also escaped later on. After this adventure, Logan and Carol parted ways, but after he started to talk about this conspiracy with the Ministry of Defense and after bursting in both Department H and the Hellfire Club during this adventure, Logan's reputation was now dirt in his country. As a result, he tried to forget about the mutant problem and decided to go to the Yukon.[109]

But Logan was still troubled by Sabretooth's revelations, and he started to develop a morbid preoccupation with the current "Mutant" scandals.[104][110] To make things worse, Logan's natural mutation started to take its toll on his mind around that time, giving him nightmares and visions every night to the point of turning him crazy and feral.[111] As a result, Logan started to abuse drugs and he became an alcoholic. This self-destructive behavior led Logan to accidentally shoot a fellow agent at a firing range one day and as a result he was dismissed from Department K and decided to leave Canada.[110]

Weapon X Program[]

In 1974,[112] before leaving Canada, while in his Lotus Seven, Logan was pumped full of Thorazine, beaten, and kidnapped, after being approached by three armed men from the Weapon X Project, possibly under Romulus' orders.[113] The man known only as the Professor, Dr. Abraham Cornelius, and Dr. Carol Hines began to examine Logan while he floated in a sensory deprivation tank. Doctor Cornelius observed there were trace remnants of the Tyrannosaurus symbiote in Logan's blood and began experimenting to see how they responded to various stimuli. These experiments caused the remnants of the Tyrannosaurus symbiote to regenerate into a Knullified duplicate, which took over Logan's body and attacked the scientist. Doctor Cornelius was able to escape and subdue the symbiote, and after determining it couldn't be tamed for weaponization, Doctor Cornelius purged the symbiote from Logan's body.[114] During the surgical operation, Logan's skeleton, including his claws, was bonded with the indestructible metal known as Adamantium, making it unbreakable, and his personality was buried beneath the most intense brainwashing he had ever undergone.[115] Soon after the procedure was done, Logan was then put under deep hypnosis, telling him that he was not a man or individual, and being a man disgusted him.[116] The Project wanted Logan to believe that he was an obedient animal and that individuality lead to suffering and death. Reduced to a near-mindless state, Logan was apparently forced by Weapon X to slaughter every inhabitant of the small town of Roanoke as a test.[117]

Logan proved too difficult for the Weapon X Program to control and, after some time of repeated escape attempts, he broke free of the programming, fell into a berserker fury and escaped the facility, killing nearly everyone except for the Professor, Dr. Cornelius, Dr. Hines, and Malcolm Colcord, who later became the Director of a new Weapon X Program.[118][119] Unknown to Logan at the time, the Winter Soldier was apparently present and helped him escape from his captors.[120] As a result of having his bones and claws laced with the adamantium, Wolverine's natural mutation, which was an ongoing state slowly turning him feral, was put into remission, as the adamantium precipitated a chemical change within his body.[111] As a result of this experiment impeding his natural evolution, Wolverine's healing factor was weakened and he healed slower than before.

Driven into savagery by the experiment, Logan wandered the forests of the Canadian Rockies for months, living in a feral state. During this period, the feral Logan saved the lives of a young couple and their children from a pack of wolves while he was hunting.[121]

Logan also saved the life of a creature, known as the Hunter in Darkness, one of a race of feral beings apparently mystical in origin. A psychic link of some sort was established between the two, to resurface in later years.[122]

On occasion, Logan's human personality surfaced, to the extent that, years later, he was able to recall pleasant experiences in these woods. Years after this experience, Logan's memories of much of his past would remain clouded, as a result of the Weapon X experiment and additional false memories during the procedure as well.

Department H[]

Wandering in the woods, Logan was eventually discovered by Heather and James "Mac" Hudson, a young couple honeymooning in the Rockies, whom he attacked, only to be shot by James, whom neither knew was Wolverine's cousin from his maternal Hudson line. While he recovered, Logan regained enough of his human persona to be horrified at his claws, believing them to be artificial implants.[123] Recovering his mental faculties with the Hudson's help, Logan became a member of Canada's Department H, the superhuman-oriented government agency James Hudson founded. Sometime later, Wolverine consulted adamantium expert Myron MacLain, and he was targeted by Sabretooth and, under Silver Fox' leadership, Hydra. Wolverine was aided by Nick Fury, Carol Danvers, and Natasha Romanoff, now the Russian super-spy Black Widow. Even though Wolverine and his allies triumphed, his full memories remained not restored, and he didn't recognize former friends or enemies.[124] Logan eventually regained memories of Burr, Seraph, Captain America and other parts of his life, but due to Weapon X intervention and his healing factor, some areas were left blank, like his life with Itsu and much of his Team X service. Logan also underwent ongoing intense psychotherapy to help him control his berserker rages.[125] As a Department H operative, he returned to espionage and served primarily in Siberia and the Western Pacific, like Asia's Pacific Rim and its adjacent islands, including Japan. He accepted deadly and brutal assignments that no other agent would, and he soon rose to Captain in the Canadian Armed Forces.[126] Eventually, Romulus or his proxies contacted Wolverine, who received secret orders to facilitate Romulus interests even while on Department H missions.

After the Fantastic Four's debut, Hudson steered the Department H's resources to form a super-team sponsored by the government. He nominated Wolverine for leadership of this team, which was called the Flight. Contemplating the wisdom of this move, Wolverine temporarily returned to Madripoor to reunite with Seraph. He helped her and Viper, her new student, against Sabretooth, probably a case of infighting in Romulus' forces. Seraph sacrificed her life for Wolverine, but before dying, she made him promise to help Viper in the future. Seraph's heroism influenced Wolverine to agree to Hudson's proposal, although he also continued espionage missions abroad.[127]

Later on, when a 40th century time-traveler called D'von Kray invaded Canada on the hunt for a fellow time-traveler, Cable, Wolverine captured Kray and turned him over to Department H. Hudson hoped Kray's technology could empower super-agents, but Kray soon escaped and resumed tracking Cable, pursued by Wolverine. Kray was defeated by Wolverine and Cable, and Cable became a mercenary whom Wolverine encountered during select missions.[128]

Shortly after, Hudson subjected William Nowlan, a convicted murderer, to experimental procedures to manifest superhuman powers. Wolverine, maybe remembering his Weapon X experimentation, warned Hudson that Nowlan, now called Bedlam, might prove uncontrollable. His prediction accurate, Wolverine assisted Hudson in placing the insane Bedlam in suspended animation.[129] Months after the Avengers' debut, Wolverine recruited Canadian Detective Sean Benard to be a member of the Flight. As Groundhog, Benard wore Hudson's Guardian armor. Some weeks later, the criminal Egghead led superhuman mercenaries to extort funds from Canada, threatening via a nuclear warhead. Wolverine led Flight trainees against Egghead and his minions, and even though the mission succeeded, trainee Saint Elmo died, Groundhog resigned, and some other trainees proved unsuited for such missions. Hudson, taking notice of this, divided the Flight into three divisions of increasing proficiency: Gamma Flight, Beta Flight and Alpha Flight.[130]

Later, on an espionage assignment, Wolverine went to Vladivostok, Russia, where he worked with Nick Fury before him being appointed director of SHIELD.[131] While Alpha Flight's preparation continued, Wolverine traveled to Japan to seek Ogun's advice, but he found out that Ogun had surrendered himself to dark magic and he was now an assassin, a role into which he intended to enslave Wolverine.[132] Escaping this situation and deeply disturbed, Wolverine vowed to never return to Japan.

As Wolverine prepared to publicly debut as a superhero, he was kidnapped by the Leader, as were Hercules and Karkas, all of whom the Leader intended to use against the Hulk. Wolverine and the other prisoners escaped, but coincidentally the Hulk arrived in Canada shortly before Wolverine.[133] The Canadian military mobilized to fight the Hulk, but Wolverine received orders from Romulus to attract an unidentified party's attention by fighting the Hulk. Wolverine started a battle with the Hulk and a Wendigo.[134]


Wolverine's speed and maneuverability proved to be a match for the two plodding powerhouses, but after realizing Hulk was a more formidable opponent, he changed tactics. Teaming up with Hulk to take out the Wendigo, Hulk threw the Wendigo into a patch of trees and Wolverine then delivered the finishing blow. The Hulk and Wolverine kept on fighting, and as Hulk had by now grown so enraged that Wolverine's adamantium claws failed to penetrate his skin, he finally managed to temporarily knock Wolverine out.[135] Quickly back on his feets and despite his protests to keep fighting the Hulk, Wolverine was ordered to return to Department H while the Hulk was knocked out with a gas bomb and captured.[136] Still slated to take leadership of Alpha Flight, Wolverine spent months completing some espionage missions, even when various factors made him increasingly troubled by his service to Department H.[137][123][138]

The X-Men[]

Joining the X-Men[]

During his leadership of Alpha Flight, Wolverine was approached by Charles Xavier, attracted by his fight with the Hulk (as Romulus expected), who was looking for mutants to help his students, the X-Men, to escape from the island-being known as Krakoa. Wolverine resigned from Department H to accompany Professor Xavier and rescue the captured X-Men.[139]

Wolverine, under Romulus' instructions, tried to assassinate Xavier, but Charles broke Romulus' hold on Wolverine by blocking the effects of his programming but neither man knew their enemy's identity at the time. After Krakoa was defeated, Wolverine decided to stay with the X-Men, at the School for Gifted Youngsters, with fellow new recruits Storm, Nightcrawler, Colossus, Thunderbird, and Banshee, as the original members left to pursue a normal life.[140]

Logan remained with the X-Men for quite some time, but a rivalry grew between him and Cyclops, one of the reasons being that he had fallen for Scott's girlfriend, telekinetic telepath Jean Grey, who soon rejoined the group.[141] Despite decades of hard-earned cynicism and at first skeptical of Xavier's hope for mutant and human coexistence, Wolverine began to respect his ideals, determination and goals, and grew to be a loyal and trusted member of the X-Men. Wolverine also developed a strong friendship with Nightcrawler.[142]

When the X-Men traveled to Agarashima, Japan, the first time for Wolverine since breaking with Ogun, he met Lady Mariko Yashida and aided her cousin, former X-Man Sunfire, in battling Moses Magnum. Although she was unable to requite his love, Wolverine fell in love with Lady Mariko, heir to an extremely powerful Yakuza family in Tokyo. Initially frightened, Mariko was soon set at ease by Wolverine, who was attracted to her gentle demeanor, and both fell in love.[143] The X-Men departed, but they were diverted to Calgary, Alberta, where they battled James Hudson, now calling himself Vindicator, aided by Alpha Flight, who wanted to arrest their former would-be leader. Wolverine surrendered to the Canadian team, but somehow escaped and returned to the mansion with his team.[144]

After Wolverine and Nightcrawler snuck into the Hellfire Club, the Phoenix fell under Mastermind and the Hellfire Club's control and transformed into the Black Queen.[145] After the X-Men battled the Hellfire Club's Inner Circle, Phoenix underwent another transformation into the Dark Phoenix and soared through the universe, where she devoured an entire star and the five billion inhabitants of one of its planets.[146] When Phoenix returned to Earth, she threatened to kill everyone, but Professor Xavier was able to keep Phoenix under control and helped her will herself back to normal. The X-Men were then teleported away by the Shi'ar.[147] The Shi'ar Empire had witnessed Dark Phoenix consuming the star and the X-Men were forced to battle with the Imperial Guard over Phoenix's fate. The battle triggered her transformation into Dark Phoenix once more. Phoenix understood that she would never be able to fully control the dark hunger inside and sacrificed herself on the Moon.[148]

Wolverine later made the first change to his costume and journeyed to Canada to make things right with Alpha Flight and Department H, accompanied by Nightcrawler. Together with Alpha Flight, they battled a Wendigo.[149]

Logan grew closer to his friends and even dared Nightcrawler to walk down the main street of Salem Center undisguised, in his natural shape and took the underage Colossus to bars. Logan also aided Spider-Man in battling Mentallo.[150] Later, the Brood retaliated by implanting embryos in all of the X-Men, but Logan's healing factor and Storm's new connection to an Acanti saved them all.[151] The X-Men returned home to battle the Brood Queen that was inside of Professor Xavier and saved his life by transplanting his mind into a cloned body.[152]

After the X-Men watched a televised debate, between Professor X and Reverend William Stryker, they received news that Cyclops, Storm, and the Professor had died in a car accident. While investigating the scene of the accident, the X-Men were attacked by the Purifiers and rescued by Magneto. After capturing their attackers, the X-Men and Magneto tortured them for information and rescued Kitty, who was being pursued by Purifiers. After arriving at Stryker's base, the X-Men and Magneto rescued Cyclops and Storm and Magneto resuscitated them. Professor X was taken to Madison Square Garden, where he was attached to a machine that, using his brainpower, would kill all living mutants. Magneto, with his psi-shielded helmet, was able to distract the Professor enough for the X-Men to destroy the machine. Televised, Cyclops entered into a debate with Stryker about his actions and Stryker pulled a gun, attempting to kill Kitty. Before he could fire, Stryker was shot-down, by a police officer. Later at the mansion, Professor Xavier admitted that Magneto was right and began to accept his offer to join, until Scott stopped him and stated that he believed in the Professor's dream and will see it come true.[153] Following Storm, Kitty, and Colossus, the X-Men battled Dracula again, this time Logan was bitten by Dracula and attacked Cyclops until Rachel van Helsing destroyed Dracula. Logan stopped Storm from assisting Rachel in suicide, per Rachel's request, stating that killing was his profession and while embracing her, drove a wooden steak through her heart.[154]

Engaged to Mariko[]

After investigating the return of his letters to Mariko, Logan learned that she had been married to an abusive husband, Noburo Hideki.[155] Logan intended to kill her husband, but was then drugged and challenged to a duel of wooden swords by Mariko's father, Lord Shingen. During the duel, Logan was soundly beaten and humiliated in front of Mariko, due to the poisoning and Shingen using deadly pressure points. Logan then threw the sword and unsheathed his claws, only to be beaten more and revered as an "animal cast in a semblance of human form," for using deadly force in a non-lethal duel. With this act, Logan had dishonored himself to Mariko and was cast into the streets, where he was rescued by Yukio, later his close friend and sometimes lover.[156] After being attacked by the Hand, Yukio manipulated Logan into helping her, which led to further embarrassment in front of Mariko.[156]

Upon realizing his deceit, Logan took the fight directly to Shingen.[157] After Yukio killed Mariko's husband, Wolverine was forced to kill Lady Mariko's father, Lord Shingen, in a duel. Afterward, Mariko gave Logan the Clan Yashida Masamune sword, stating he was worthy. Forged 800 years ago by the supreme sword-smith Masamune, the sacred blade represented everything that was best and most noble in the family and the samurai, the lord’s champion, who wielded it. With the deaths of her father and husband, Mariko was named head of Clan Yashida. Logan stayed with her, and they later announced their engagement.[158]

Before the wedding service, Viper and Mariko's half-brother Silver Samurai poisoned the X-Men and battled Logan over control of Clan Yashida, from Mariko. At first enraged at seeing Rogue had joined the X-Men, she gained Logan's respect after saving the life of Mariko, by jumping in front of a shot from Viper intended for her. Mariko and Logan became estranged, due to the honor customs of her family, as well as the manipulations of the villain Mastermind, and Logan returned the Masamune sword to her.[159] After the X-Men defeated Mastermind, Mariko returned the honor sword to him and stated that she had to break her Clan's criminal connections. Mariko felt that she could not marry Wolverine until she did this.[160] The X-Men again battled with Mastermind, the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, and the Morlocks.[161]

Meeting Amiko[]

Weeks later, the X-Men battled a giant dragon when they were teleported to Japan. Unable to save a dying woman, Wolverine vowed to protect her daughter, Amiko Kobayashi.[162] Logan initially left Amiko in the care of Mariko and the X-Men next battled Selene.[163] Amiko would eventually become Wolverine's foster daughter.[74]

Saving Kitty Pryde and Facing Ogun[]

Following a distress call from teammate Kitty Pryde, Wolverine traveled to Japan.[164] Kitty was then captured and put under the mental control of Ogun. Ogun mentally controlled her, transforming her body and soul as he had originally intended to do to Wolverine.[132] After arriving in Japan, Kitty was sent to kill Wolverine and injured him greatly,[78] but with help from Yukio, she was restored.

Logan undertook a crash program in order to teach Kitty's body, just as Ogun had taught her mind, to become skillful enough in the Japanese martial arts to contend against Ogun and to help her overcome his evil.[79] Kitty went to face Ogun herself, who was attempting to kill Mariko and Amiko to punish Wolverine. After being defeated by Ogun, he offered Kitty, calling herself Shadowcat, to join him or die. At that time, Wolverine came to her rescue.[74] Sadly, Wolverine was also overwhelmed and the two of them sat helplessly at Ogun's mercy. In a turn of events, Kitty informed Wolverine that she was scared until he arrived and when he apologized, she stated that she did not want an apology, but life. At that moment, Wolverine turned the battle and defeated Ogun and Kitty regained her innocence that Ogun had taken. After killing Ogun, although his spirit survived, Logan and Kitty became very close friends, with her as a near-foster daughter to him.[165]

It was during this adventure that Logan learned from Charles Xavier that his friend James "Mac" Hudson died.[79] After Ogun was defeated, Logan decided to head back to Canada and checked on Heather Hudson in order to support her in this ordeal.[166][167]

Lady Deathstrike[]

Later, Heather became the new leader of Alpha Flight under the codename Vindicator after the death of her husband and decided to go see Wolverine in order to ask him for some advices. As she was approaching the X-Mansion Magneto mistakenly attacked her which angered Logan. Once the misunderstanding was cleared, Logan decided to have a talk with Heather but their reunion was interrupted by Lady Deathstrike. She explained that she was tracking down Bullseye, who had his spine laced with adamantium by her father and who fled without repayment. But while she was tracking Bullseye's Adamantium skeleton, she found Wolverine's adamantium signature instead. She explained that the process that laced Logan's skeleton with adamantium was stolen from her father years earlier and as a result she wanted him to return what he had stolen from her father.[123] Lady Deathstrike and her army of warriors attacked and as she was about to deal a fatal blow to Logan with her sword, Vindicator shattered it and Deathstrike was arrested afterwards.[168]

But after this defeat, Yuriko swore to defeat Wolverine and avenge her honor. To that end she escaped custody and went to see Spiral, she was then changed into a cyborg with superhuman strength and Adamantium claws. Three former Hellfire Club soldiers that were severely injured by Wolverine when he saved the X-Men from the Hellfire Club, also swore revenge on Logan and as a result they were also changed into cyborgs and became the Reavers. Lady Deathstrike and her Reavers then attacked Wolverine and almost killed him.

Fortunately Logan was aided by Katie Power and with her help he was able to recover from his wounds and defeat the Reavers. Logan then confronted Lady Deathstrike and after a violent battle he defeated her and was horrified to discover what Yuriko did to herself in order have her revenge against him. Despite Yuriko begging Logan to kill her out of mercy, he refused and told her she had to earn it. Logan then thanked Katie for her help and and walked her away to reunite her with her family. He then told her that no matter what happened he would always be here for a her if she needed a friend to run to, to which Katie replied: "an‘ so, Mr. Logan, will you.“[169]

Mutant Massacre[]

Unable to heal on his own after his encounter with Lady Deathstrike and her Reavers, Wolverine was taken by the X-Men to the Morlock Healer and his teammate Phoenix attempted to telekinetically heal him. Rachel opened her mind to Wolverine's and, soon after, Rachel decided to kill Selene for her attack when she first arrived in the mainstream timeline. Wolverine, mentally sensing Rachel's intentions, stabbed Rachel in the chest to prevent her from vengefully murdering Selene.[170] Logan later justified his actions by saying that he was afraid that the murder of Selene would have made Rachel lose control of the Phoenix force, turning her into the Dark Phoenix.[171]

The X-Men attempted to rescue the Morlocks after the Marauders began to indiscriminately massacre them and, after the team was defeated, Wolverine was charged with staying behind and bringing one of the Marauder as a prisoner.[172] While hunting the Marauders, Logan was confronted by Sabretooth who was about to kill the Healer, despite wanted to fight Sabretooth and kill him as a revenge for everything he did to him in the past, Logan decided that saving the Healer was more important than his feud with his old foe. As a result Logan managed to trap Sabretooth under a pile of rubble and helped the Healer to get to safety.[173]

While in the tunnels, Logan also recognized Jean Grey's scent who was previously here with X-Factor, but at the time Logan and the X-Men still believed she was dead, as a result Logan thought he was losing his mind.[173]

Unfortunately for Wolverine, Sabretooth wasn't done with him. After the evacuation of all the surviving Morlocks from their tunnels, Sabretooth snuck inside the X-Mansion, knocked down Rogue and tried to kill the X-Men newest recruit: Elizabeth "Betsy" Braddock. Betsy was able to handle her own for a while despite Sabretooth's ferocious attacks until the X-Men finally arrived at the mansion.
