Wolverine then decided to confront Sabretooth while Psylocke used this opportunity to probe Sabretooth's mind in order to learn who was the secret leader of the Marauders.

Despite Sabretooth's psy-shields, Betsy succeeded and after letting Logan and the X-Men know, the team decided to help Wolverine against his foe. Sabretooth knowing that he was going to lose against both Wolverine and the rest of the X-Men decided to dive into the lake near the Mansion, with Wolverine following after him. But in the end, Sabretooth managed to escape and not even Psylocke could detect him.[174]

Wolverine and Captain America[]

Logan then assisted Captain America in defeating Overrider and his adamantium-coated robot TESS-1, who were attempting to fire all of America's nuclear missiles and send them into the sea. Due to Wolverine's disrespect and brash methods, Captain America stated that the X-Men better not ever get tired of him, because the Avengers would never have him.[175]

Jean Grey Lives!?[]

Later on, Wolverine and Storm investigated the recently bombed home of Sara Bailey and Logan sensed Scott Summers (Cyclops) and, the thought dead, Jean Grey (Marvel Girl), which sent him into a berserker rage as he began to search for the woman he secretly loved.[176]

Crystal of Ultimate Vision[]

On the anniversary of his wedding to Mariko, the team was abducted by Horde who wanted to use them as his lackeys in order to retrieve the Crystal of Ultimate Vision, of which he wore a shard on his forehead. The X-Men were sent to the Citadel of Light and Shadow, where the crystal was hidden. As the X-Men progressed through it, the citadel created illusions of each of their most powerful desires. Only Wolverine, Storm, and Psylocke were able to resist. Wolverine reached the Crystal but Horde cut him down and killed him by removing his heart that he wanted to keep as a trophy. However, a lone drop of Logan's blood splattered on the Crystal, which gave out enough energy for Wolverine to be restored and reborn. Empowered to godhood, Wolverine plucked the crystal shard from Horde's forehead and the tyrant quickly aged and crumbled to dust within seconds. Wolverine rejected the god-like power and returned the X-Men and their friends home, ensuring that the human race would be able to evolve to its full potential.[177]

Charlemagne[]

After the deaths of ex-KGB agents all over Manhattan, Logan was reminded of an old freelance operative from the Cold War, Charlemagne. The last time Logan had seen Charlie, she was working in West Berlin. It was a mission that Logan had protested, but Charlie insisted and her handler double-crossed her. Charlie called for Logan's help and he understood that it was serious. After fifty Soviet operatives couldn't take them down, they sent in KGB agents that had been undercover for years and Wolverine's berserker rage finished them all. After the slaughter, all that was left was a little heart shaped pendant. After leaving the X-Men in a time of need, Logan traveled to Potsdamer Platz, West Berlin, where two KGB agents blew their cover by killing muggers and Charlemagne killed them while Logan's back was turned.[178]

While in Kurfürstendamm, Logan got the scent of Spider-Man in civilian clothing and deciphered his secret identity. Logan warned Spider-Man to stay away from Berlin and forget about Charlemagne, but when Spider-Man returned to his hotel, KGB agents killed Ned Leeds and were asking his involvement when Logan arrived and killed all of the agents and again warned Spider-Man to leave. Logan tracked Charlie to a steel mill just outside of East Berlin and the two stay together for a while. When the couple went to dinner at The Ganymed on Friedrich Strasse, Spider-Man arrived to inform them that everyone in the restaurant was an agent wanting to kill Charlie, a fact that Charlemagne and Wolverine already knew, and a gunfight broke out.

After losing Charlie in the fight, Wolverine and Spider-Man attempted to track her down, by getting to her marks before she did, but were always one step behind. After the pair split, Charlemagne called Wolverine to a Soviet cemetery at Teptow and he understood that she wanted him to end her life, so that the Soviets wouldn't have the chance to torture her.

After flinching, Wolverine pulled too much and Charlemagne was bleeding to death. At that time, Spider-Man arrived and attempted to stop Logan from killing her. A brutal fight broke out between the two. While on top of Spider-Man, Wolverine stated Spider-Man would have to use all of his strength to break Wolverine's neck, while he would just have to lash out his claws to kill Spider-Man. At that time, a government chopper arrived and the two split. In the confusion, Charlemagne snuck up on Spider-Man, aware that he was tense, and he gave a punch of super strength, killing her. Charlie died in Wolverine's arms and the agents left. After giving Spider-Man a fake passport, the pair returned home.[178]

Fall of the Mutants[]

When Storm left to regain her powers, Wolverine led the X-Men and rescued Madelyne Pryor-Summers, Cyclops' wife that he had abandoned to a coma, from the Marauders.

The X-Men then decided to track Storm, but on their way they were attacked by the Hulk, which prompted Wolverine to face his old foe, their fight ended on the stalemate and the Hulk decided to leave.[179] But during their fight, a man named Roger was driving his wife, Carol, to the hospital to give birth to their first born but they got caught on Highway 18 and accidentally crashed into Wolverine who was trying to stop Hulk's rampage. Their car was destroyed as a result, Roger then tried to carry his wife to the hospital but she and the baby died on the way. He always blamed Wolverine, even though the news said he saved the day. His deep hatred of Wolverine would attract the attention of an old man and of a powerful demon who told him they could help him get his revenge, Roger accepted and joined the old man's organization, the Red Right Hand.[180]

The team then resumed their track and finally arrived at Forge's Eagle Plaza, in Dallas, Texas, where they were attacked by Freedom Force. After the initial battle, a rift opened in the sky of Dallas and a chaos ensued of different weather patterns right next to each other and beings and creatures from the past appearing and attacking.

The X-Men and Freedom Force formed a temporary alliance with each other to save the citizens of Dallas, until Colossus, recently recovered, decided to enter Eagle Plaza. After gaining access into the Starlight Citadel, the X-Men battled the Adversary and, after Rogue absorbed his power and opened a portal to seal him in, gave their life to imprison the Adversary, with a spell used from Forge. However, the Omniversal Guardian, named Roma, restored the X-Men to life and freed the Adversary, under the notion that there could be no order without chaos. The events had been broadcast over a live television news feed and the world believed the heroes to be dead. After being resurrected, the X-Men decided to use the opportunity to go underground and keep their rebirth secret.[181]

While the world believed the X-Men to be dead, O.Z. Chase decided to drown his sorrow in a bar while remembering a time when he, Logan, Dazzler and Henry Gyrich stopped the drug dealing mutant, Vladimir Zaitsev. When a man in the bar disparaged the X-Men and Dazzler, Chase threatened him and made he and the rest of the bar's patrons toast Dazzler and the X-Men's memory.[182]

The X-Men resurfaced later in Australia, where they defeated the Reavers, who were holding Jessán Hoan as a hostage. They released Jessán and claimed their base and teleporter, Gateway, a mute, mutant of Aborigine descent with the ability to create gates with his bullroarer. Roma appeared and presented them with the Siege Perilous, a gem that created a portal which granted any person who walked through it judgment and a new chance at life, with a new career, home, and so forth, she also informed them that she had magically made them invisible to any sort of mechanical perception.[183] Around this time, Logan ordered a new armor costume for Psylocke from Landau, Luckman & Lake.

X-Man and Adventurer[]

Patch[]

After finding Dave Chapel in the desert tortured and dying from exposure, Wolverine returned to Madripoor, perhaps the first time since Seraph's death, to the Princess Bar, and saved O'Donnell from thugs of a crime boss, Roche, while searching for "the Tiger."[184] While at the bar, Logan realized that he was being watched and confronted the woman, who turned-out to be Jessán Hoan.[185] After a brief battle with Jessán, Wolverine was beaten by Sapphire Styx and Razor-Fist and delivered to Roche.[186] After surviving torture from Inquisitor, Wolverine escaped and was brutally attacked by Razor-Fist, who stabbed him in his throat and torso and left him for dead.[187] Wolverine was rescued from a harbor and looked after by Jessán.[188] After healing, Wolverine began wearing an eye patch, to keep the resurrection of the X-Men a secret, and learned that Jessán was in fact Tyger Tiger and vowed to aid her in overthrowing Roche and taking his place as the Madripoor crime lord.[189] After defeating Razor-Fist, Wolverine and Tyger Tiger rescued O'Donnell, killed Roche, and Wolverine declared that he would become Tyger's conscience to remind her that if she became like Roche, he would come for her. After stating that he did not like crime lords, he let Tyger Tiger choose her own path. Tyger responded that he had won her heart and the two kissed.[190] He started using the alias "Patch", given to him by Razor-Fist during that fight, and alternated between a white tuxedo with an eyepatch, and a blue costume with a mask covering both eyes.[191]

While rescuing an agent of Mariko's, Kojima Noburo, Logan killed Banapur Khan and his pirates and found-out about the Cult of the Black Blade's quest to steal the Muramasa Blade, a blade that all who wielded were possessed by its demonic essence, except for the one warrior destined to be its true master. Returning to Madripoor, Logan saved Lindsay McCabe, who he met while the X-Men lived in San Francisco with Jessica Drew, but didn't recognize him, due to his Patch identity.[192] After intentionally holding back in a fight with the Silver Samurai, Patch chased Jessica, who had been corrupted by the sword, through the streets of Madripoor, until he caught the blade with his bare hands and defeated her, claiming the sword. Holding the sword, a voice came from within the Black Blade, telling Patch that he and the Blade were destined to be one.[193] The blade transformed Patch's clothing to a leather ninja outfit and he attempted to sacrifice Jessica. Patch was tracked to the Cult's hide-out and Lindsay stopped him from killing Jessica, by snipping him in the head. After fighting the Silver Samurai, Patch fought the influence of the blade and gave the sword to the Silver Samurai.[194]

Scorched Land[]

Logan then returned to the X-Men in order to investigate a Brood Star-shark that Havok had found and tracked the source to Harry Palmer, who was unaware he was infected and had made an entire crèche of mutant hosts. The X-Men were too conflicted with killing the human hosts and Wolverine was captured and implanted with an embryo again. Once again, Logan's healing factor fought-off the transformation in time for him to kill Temptress, freeing Psylocke, and kill Harry, ending the Brood threat.[195] Following Storm, who abruptly left in the middle of the night, the X-Men tracked her to the Savage Land. Upon arrival, the Savage Land was scorched and barren and the X-Men battled Garrok, in the armor of Terminus. After the initial battle, Longshot was lost and Wolverine followed him to another dimension. Storm's Cameo Crystal opened a portal to M'Rin's dimension, where the Fall People escaped to. Together with M'Rin's people, the High Evolutionary, and the Fall People, the X-Men separated Garokk from Terminus and, with his sacrifice, restored the Savage Land.[196]

Genosha and Inferno[]

After Maddie went missing, the X-Men battled the Press Gang and Genoshan Magistrates, where Logan and Rogue were captured and taken to Genosha.[197] While in captivity, Logan and Rogue were stripped of their powers, by Wipeout and contained, until Rogue escaped and rescued Logan.[198] Logan and Rogue followed Phillip Moreau to the Mutates' camp, until they were attacked and the X-Men arrived to rescue them.[199]

Later, Havok tracked the Marauders in the Alley, and the X-Men ambushed them. The Marauders fled and, as the X-Men gave chase, they found themselves also battling a demonic invasion of New York, slowly becoming demonic themselves.[200] Wolverine recognized familiar scents and the X-Men confronted X-Factor, the original X-Men, harassing Madelyne and her baby. After Logan forcibly kissed Jean, Madelyne instigated a battle between the X-Men and X-Factor, having the X-Men under her demonic influence and believing that X-Factor was attempting to kidnap Nathan Summers, her and Scott's child. After the demon N'astirh attacked, the X-Men and X-Factor combined efforts to defeat him, assuming that he was controlling Madelyne, calling herself the Goblin Queen, and Havok, calling himself the Goblin Prince.[201]

At that moment, Marvel Girl was captured, by Maddie, and another battle was instigated between the X-Men and X-Factor. The Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Nathan atop the Empire State Building to permanently open a gateway between Earth and the demonic Limbo. The Goblin Queen locked herself, Nathan, and Jean inside a psionic barrier. Both the X-Men and X-Factor's combined efforts seemed to be futile in an effort to break through the telekinetic bubble. The invasion was thwarted after Madelyne committed suicide in combat with Jean, attempting to kill everyone in her power, but the X-Men and X-Factor protected each other while Jean protected Nathan Christopher.[202]

After Madelyne's death, Jean began to scream in pain and Storm ordered Psylocke to take Scott and the X-Men into her mind, where Mr. Sinister was attempting to erase all of Jean's memories, until Jean defeated him on the Astral Plane. Following Mr. Sinister's psychic trail, Marvel Girl tracked him to the School for Gifted Youngsters and the X-Men and X-Factor were ambushed by the Marauders. While interrogating Malice/Polaris, Mr. Sinister destroyed the school.[203] While the X-Men and X-Factor battled Sinister and Malice, Wolverine defeated Sabretooth and Sinister attempted to claim Marvel Girl, but Cyclops seemingly killed Sinister with an unchecked optic blast.[204]

Crime War in Madripoor[]

Shortly after, Logan left the X-Men with no explanation and returned to Madripoor. After following the scents of suspects for a murder case, Patch ran into Karma, of the New Mutants, working for her uncle, who was attempting to overthrow Tyger Tiger, and made an uneasy ally with Police Chief Tai. After informing Tyger that he would not assassinate or kidnap for her, Patch and Tyger were beaten by Roughhouse and Bloodsport and rescued by Karma.[205] Patch left Tyger with Jessica, Lindsay and Chang (who was killed by Roughhouse and Bloodsport) while he destroyed General Nguyen Ngoc Coy's opium supplies, where he encountered the Harriers.[206] After disrupting Coy's drug activities, Patch took the fight directly to Coy and battled and defeated Roughhouse and Bloodsport, while rescuing Lindsay, Jessica and Tyger. Patch had General Coy at his mercy, until Prince Baran intervened and,[207] thanks to Lindsay, considered them all honored guests of his. The Prince offered that Tyger and General Coy worked together, to stop a power vacuum and warzone in Madripoor and Patch convinced Tyger to accept.[208]

Next, Patch began his quest to save Karma from her uncle's service, but was sidetracked when he learned that disrupting General Coy's drug activities planted a target on the General's head and Karma needed him to help her find her missing brother and sister. Patch accompanied Xuân Cao Mạnh to the airport to witness the arrival of Joe Fixit, who Patch smelled right away and recognized as the Hulk.[208] Patch went-on to use Joe to disrupt General Coy's drug and slave operations.[209] Later, Police Chief Tai informed Patch that he was aware the Patch and Wolverine were one and the same. Remembering his first "birthday gift" from Creed, Patch saved a couple from being mugged and was later targeted by the thugs. After escaping an attempted hit, Patch tracked them to the Princess Bar only to find them dead and a note from Creed reading "Nobody kills you but me - especially today."[26]

The Gehenna Stone Affair[]

Patch then returned to San Francisco with Jessica, when Archie Corrigan asked for help with his mentally unbalanced brother, Burt Corrigan, who was in danger of losing his inheritance. While the trio was waiting for Burt, he suddenly burst through a window, dressed as Indiana Jones, screaming that he needed help against Ba'al.[210] The demon Ba'al was trying to collect all the pieces of a stone called the Gehenna Stone which contained Ba'al soul in order to create his own vampire army. One of the pieces was detained by Burt hence why Ba'al's army was trying to kill him.

Patch, Archie, Burt, and Jessica managed to fight back against Ba'al's army and escaped,[211] but soon after they met Ba'al himself and Patch tried to take him down but failed and as a result Ba'al recovered the piece of the Gehenna Stone from Burt and decided to head to Madripoor in order to retrieve the last fragment. Despite the fact that Archie wanted to let go of this madness, Patch decided to go after Ba'al and his army and stopped them once and for all.[212] During the flight towards Madripoor, Patch now wearing the Wolverine costume fought against Ba'al again and this time had the upper hand and crashed down his plane.[213]

After finally landed in Madripoor, Patch learned that Lindsay, Jessica and O'Donnell always knew that he was Wolverine and that the streets of Madripoor were now full of vampires. They also learned that Tai and the Madripoor police confiscated another piece of the stone that O'Donnell used to possess and gave it to the Prince Baran. It was also revealed that Ba'al survived the plane crash, struck an alliance with the Prince Baran and let his army of "half vampires" invaded the streets of Madripoor.[214]

In the end, Ba'al crossed the Prince and retrieved the last piece of the stone, now complete he could create "true" vampires but Wolverine finally managed to catch up and fought Ba'al one last time. Ba'al recognized Wolverine as the reincarnation of the warrior of the legend also known as the "Hand of God" that killed him eons ago and shattered his soul. An angry Ba'al tried to kill him but Wolverine managed to destroy the stone and killed Ba'al once and for all.[215]

Wolverine and Havok[]

Back with the X-Men, Logan attempted to comfort Havok after the recent loss of both the women he loved, Wolverine suggested that the men of the X-Men go to a bar in Sydney, taking the idea from Dazzler who took all of the women out. While at the bar, the four X-Men stopped an alien invasion of the many aliens in the Conquest.[216] Shortly after, Wolverine and Havok were vacationing in Mexico and saved a woman from terrorist attackers.[217] The woman was actually Scarlett McKenzie and was working for the Russian scientist, Dr. Neutron (Meltdown), who wanted to use Havok as a means to absorb the entire energy of a breaking down atom reactor and transmute it into himself.[218] Scarlett gave Alex Summers false information that terrorists were trying to sabotage the plant and when he ventured into the heart of the reactor, he found it shortly before reaching critical limit. The timely arrival of Wolverine prevented a full disaster and after Logan killed the scientist, Alex redirected the nuclear radiation into space. For Alex's sake, Logan kept Scarlett's betrayal secret, as he was still trying to get over the back-plotting of Madelyne.[219]

The Jungle Adventure[]

Back in Australia, a man would ask Wolverine to go to the Savage Land, where he encountered a tribe of humans. Arriving in a lightweight plane, the tribe believed him a god, with the exception of Gahck, the tribe's female chieftain. Gahck challenged Wolverine to combat, and once it was established that he wasn't a god, he offered to help their hunting parties. Logan subsequently started a relationship with Gahck. When members of the tribe were captured, Wolverine discovered that a robotic Tyrannosaurus Rex would attack the tribe and take their members to a secret base.

Wolverine discovered that experiments were performed on the tribe members by Apocalypse, and after freeing himself and the captured Gahck, he battled Apocalypse, though it turned out to be a android. In the Apocalypse android's lab, Logan learned that the real Apocalypse was the man who had told him to journey to the Savage Land. After defeating the android, Wolverine left the Savage Land and returned to Australia, despite Gahck's feelings for him. Unknown to Logan, Gahck was pregnant and a few months later their son was born.[220]

Back to Basics[]

In the Australian Outback, Wolverine was hunting a wild boar and after killing it, he started to eat it like an animal. But as he let his animal side take over, he remembered his first battle with Lord Shingen and how Shingen called him an animal after beating him. Suddenly Storm appeared, Wolverine told her he didn't want the X-men to see this side of him but Storm reassured him by telling him that his feral side saved them several times through the years and they accepted it a long time ago.

But Logan knew he needed to let the animal out from times to times but not in front of the X-men because they're his family, so thanks to Gateway's help, Logan decided to head to Madripoor where he could let the beast out for a little while.

In Madripoor, Logan now under his patch identity started a fight with Roughouse that he defeated, Logan celebrated his victory in the arms Tyger Tiger while the unconscious Roughouse was bought from the General Coy (his current boss) by Geist (an old Nazi that Logan met during WWII) who was now a cyborg.

The next day, Wolverine smelled the odor of cocaine in Madripoor lowtown coming from a truck, Logan decided to follow the truck to the port where he saw Roughouse being throw out from the truck, being kidnapped by Geist and taken to a US navy vessel. As Logan was infiltrating the ship, he heard Roughouse screamed under Geist's torture.[221]

After dealing with several soldiers, Logan discovered that Geist completely shaved Roughouse as some form of torture but also for the experiment he was about to perform on him. He explained to Logan that he was working for Felix Guillermo Caridad, the president of the Central American Republic of Tierra Verde, a dictator who made a fortune from the traffic of cocaine. But Caridad discovered that some batch of cocaine from Tierra Verde and that Logan previously smelled in Madripoor seemed to have some side effects on their users such as giving them superhuman abilities. Caridad wanted to use this cocaine to have his own superheroes army and for Geist, Roughouse was the perfect guinea pig to test this batch.

Having heard enough, Logan freed Roughouse but Roughouse became crazy after what Geist did to him and attacked Logan on sight. Between the fury of his opponent and being shot by sedative darts, Logan was beaten and was thrown in the sea while Geist took Roughouse to Tierra Verde where Caridad and his wife Sister Salvation were waiting for them.

Logan was rescued by Tyger Tiger, O'Donnell and Corrigan, angry about what just happened Logan told them that he was going to invade Tierra Verde.[222]

Shortly after, Logan arrived in Puerto Verde, the capital city of Tierra Verde and discovered that a revolution was taking place here, and the leader of the resistance was a young woman named La Bandera who was fighting Tiger Shark. Logan helped her and was able to damage the villain’s suit which made him run away.

The fight over, Logan met an old contact from the CIA named Jack Bascomb who told him the origins of La Bandera and warned Logan to stay out of this because things were more complicated than what it looked like. Logan ignored Bascomb and was able to track Geist, he took him down and asked him to take him to Roughouse’s location. But Logan was ambushed by Tiger Shark who started to fight him underwater in order to drown him.[223]

Despite Logan's best efforts he was no match against Tiger Shark underwater and in the end the villain was able to stuck Logan's claws into some coral shelf, leaving Logan to drown. But thanks to his indomitable will and enough force Logan was able to crack the thin section of coral where his claws were stuck.

Now free Logan found Tiger Shark and defeated him and thanks to La Bandera's help he was able to free Roughouse and kidnap Sister Salvation. Logan discovered that Sister Salvation had some healing powers and with them she was able to cure Roughouse from the side effects he suffered from the drug.[224]

Unfortunately, the helicopter they used to escape crashed and Logan was also shot with several needles full of the same drug used on Roughouse. The drug turned Logan crazy until he was also temporarily healed by Sister Salvation but soon after Logan was again under the influence which distorted the reality around him.

The drug in Logan's system started to speak to him and explain its true nature, it was originally a Spore, a living disease created by the Deviants during the prehistory when they were at war with with the Eternals which was then destroyed by the Celestials who considered it to be an abomination. But its consciousness survived and was absorbed by the soil of Central America and by the plants, Spore was then resurrected through the cocaine that was manufactured from those plants by Caridad. It wanted a host in which it could survived long enough in order to consume it and emerged fully free from it, and Wolverine was the perfect host thanks to his healing factor. But Logan was able to reject it thanks to his indomitable will, his healing factor and Sister Salvation help. Free from the drug, Logan discovered that Sister Salvation sold them out because Caridad had her son.[225]

Logan was then taken to a military camp where he was tortured by Geist and Caridad but thanks to Roughouse's help Logan was able to escape. Logan and Roughouse discovered that Geist and Caridad were about to infect Sister Salvation's son with the spore but Wolverine was able to stop Geist but in the midst of the battle Caridad was fatally wounded.

As La Bandera and her men were raiding the Military camp, Caridad decided to inject himself with the spore, which freed it and it attacked Wolverine and absorbed him.[226]

With La Bandera's help, Wolverine freed himself and with the help of Sister Salvation the trio was able to finally destroy Spore. After this adventure, Roughouse decided to stay with Sister Salvation and her son in order to protect them and helped them rebuild their mission that her husband destroyed. Logan then decided to track Geist and easily dealt with him and destroyed his life support leaving him to die alone and powerless. After saying goodbye to La Bandera, Logan met Jack Bascomb once again and understood that Geist was a CIA mole inside Caridad's organization and they extradited him. The CIA also used to backup Caridad's regime for a time but knowing they couldn't control the spore they decided to also back up La Bandera's revolution in order to put an end to Caridad regime and to his cocaine traffic. Bascomb then told Logan the real world was more complicated than personal feuds and that there were worse enemies than the old ones out here.

Angry about those revelations and most especially about the fact that the CIA was working with an ex-Nazi, Logan left Tierra Verde and went back to Madripoor where he kidnapped both Prince Baran and General Coy. He made them think he infected them with the spore drug and forced them to escape through the sewers system to humiliate them in front of all the citizens of Madripoor but also for allowing the cocaine to enter Madripoor in the first place.

Logan, now with his inner beast under control, returned to the Australian Outback and rejoined the X-men. After his extradition from Tierra Verde, Geist returned to Washington to one one of the CIA safehouse, but someone was waiting for him, someone who knew him from when he was a Nazi during WW2: Magneto. After easily disarming him, Magneto told him he wanted to have a talk with him in his safehouse where they wouldn't be disturbed.[227]

Meeting Jubilee[]

Now back in Australia, Logan decided to return to town but while here he was severely beat down and captured by the Reavers and Donald Pierce who then decided to hang him on a cross and tortured him. While on the cross, Logan had several fever dreams during which he saw several of his friends and foes but also a vision of what was happening to the X-Men thanks to Gateway. Logan learned that without him and after Longshot quit the team and the recent events, the X-Men were weakened and Pierce and the Reavers intended to kill them when they were at their lowest. Psylocke knew the X-Men had no chance against the imminent attack, so she telepathically convinced her teammates to enter the Siege Perilous in order to save them. The X-Men gone, Pierce was left more furious than ever and decided to take his anger on Logan.

After Gateway showed him what happened, Logan was then confronted again by Pierce who decided to crucify him on a X-shaped cross, shortly after a powerful storm started which forced the Reavers to leave Logan alone. In the middle of the storm, a young runaway mutant named Jubilee who secretly followed the X-Men for a while after they saved her from the M-Squad, witnessed what was happening to Logan from afar and decided to help him despite the fear of being caught and killed by the Reavers.

But as she was approaching, Logan has had enough of the torture and amidst the thunder he screamed and unleashed the berserker in his soul. Despite the pain, Logan managed to free himself and fell to the ground. Jubilee both amazed and afraid by what she saw, helped him get back on his feet.[228]

Jubilee hid the wounded Logan who had trouble to heal and who started to have hallucinations of Carol Danvers and Nick Fury after what he suffered at the hands of the Reavers. Disoriented Logan attacked Jubilee but she managed to knock him back with her plasma blast and he regained his sanity. Pierce angry that Wolverine escaped sent his hounds in order to track him down but thanks to Gateway, both Logan and Jubilee managed to defeat the Reavers and escaped.[229]

Despite being part of the Reavers, Lady Deathstrike respected Logan as a warrior, so she decided to protect the Yashida's honor sword that Logan kept in his room from the other Reavers and let him escape with Jubilee because there was no honor in killing him if he couldn't defend himself.[229] Logan and Jubilee then decided to head to Hong Kong and more precisely to the Landau, Luckman & Lake Office in order to investigate the disappearance of the X-Men.[230]

After this adventure, Jubilee would follow Logan on several adventures and would eventually became like a daughter to him, much like Kitty before.

The Search for the X-Men[]

Now in Hong Kong with Jubilee, Logan met his old friend Rose Wu at the Landau, Luckman & Lake office but Jubilee and Ruth Wu (Rose's granddaughter) were kidnapped and Logan was attacked by the Lady Mandarin. During the battle, Logan recognized her scent and discovered that she was in reality a brainwashed Psylocke who was following the orders of the Mandarin and a member of the Hand named Matsu'o Tsurayaba, using this moment of confusion Psylocke plunged her psychic knife inside Logan’s brain and brought him to the Hand.[231]

Now a prisoner of the Hand, Logan was kept in custody under the surveillance of the brainwashed Psylocke but after their precedent fight, Logan’s mind was in turmoil.

In order to break him, Psylocke tried to use Logan’s ghosts and memories against him but Logan was able to defeat her in psychic combat. Victorious, Logan decided to fight Psylocke again but this time in physical combat which resulted in Psylocke plunging her psychic knife inside his brain again. But this time, the effect was different, Psylocke regained her memories and was free of the mind control. Together both Wolverine and Psylocke defeated the Mandarin and freed Jubilee and Ruth but unfortunately Matsu'o was able to escape.[230]

While they were tracking Matsu'o, the trio helped the Black Widow in Madripoor against the Hand just like Logan did way back in 1941, and decided to take down both Andrea and Andreas Von Strucker a.k.a the Fenris' twins and Matsu'o but unfortunately they were unsuccessful and their foes escaped.[61]

The Lazarus Project[]

While he was in Madripoor, Logan dealt with the Snow Queen[232] and paid his debt to Mr. Morrow by protecting his son Gabriel from Piggott (the leader of a rival gang in Madripoor).[233] Logan then went to Japan to investigate the murder of his old Master Bando Saburo and his wife.[234]

His investigation over and after paying his respects, Logan then returned to Madripoor, where he had a rundown with some thugs and met with Karma and Tyger Tiger before heading to the Princess bar and meeting with Jessica Drew and Lindsay McCabe. Shortly after, Jessica went to Prince Baran's palace where she heard him talking about the Project Lazarus. Intrigued, Jessica decided to discover what was this project which lead her to a secret laboratory where she heard a discussion between Doctor Page and Merrick about an upcoming attack against a village. Unfortunately, she was spotted and Doctor Page activated a strange robot named Pinocchio to attack Jessica but she was able to escape.

Later Logan found her in bad shape and she told him what she discovered, fearing for Jessica and Lindsay safety he decided to send them stateside by plane before heading to the Prince Baran palace. While here Logan fought against Pinocchio and discovered that his claws couldn't pierce or cut Pinocchio’s shell. Their fight was interrupted by the Doctor Page who threw a strange green liquid to Logan's face which blinded him, but despite the pain Logan was able to discover that the village that was about to get attacked was named Rumika before escaping and failing in the water nearby.[235]

Logan awoken later on Rumika island without any memories but even without any memories he decided to help the Island's villagers against a shark attack. To thank him for his help, the villagers took him to their village, gave him a home and let him live here as long he wished. Even without his memories, Logan was riddled with nightmares from his fight with Pinocchio and by how the name Rumika seemed familiar to him.

During the night, Captain Merrick and his group of mercenaries were watching over the village to make sure that a strange object called the Master Form was safe in the hands of the villagers that they previously met, but back in Madripoor, Karma discovered that her uncle was about to send a squad a mercenary to kill every villager in Rumika and retrieved the Master Form.

She decided to head to Rumika to warn them but it was too late, the next day, the village was attacked by a group of mercenaries who killed everyone. Despite Wolverine and later Karma interventions, no one survived but Karma was able to retrieve the master form with the help of a mercenary named Target who was under Merrick’s command and whose mission was to protect the village.

Thanks to his heightened senses and despite his amnesia, Logan recognized Merrick’s scent from when he fought Pinocchio before and understood that he was a traitor and the one responsible for this slaughter which angered Target, who shot Merrick in the head. After meeting Karma, witnessing this slaughter, seeing his home destroyed and seeing the dead bodies of the Island's children, Logan finally remembered who he really was: He was Wolverine.[236]

After giving the last rites to all the dead people of Rumika, Logan asked Karma and Target to tell him how they had been involved with the Master Form. After hearing their stories, Logan discovered how both of their families had been connected to this strange object through the years, how the Master Form was supposed to be some kind of power source and that a man named Broker Andover was also connected to all of this. The trio was then attacked by several mercenaries who wanted to recover the Master Form but Logan and Target managed to kill them. The battle over, Logan decided that the Master Form should stay in Rumika since it was his place and that it was now time to get some answers, and the only place to get them was in Madripoor.[237]

Back in Madripoor, the trio was able to infiltrate the Prince Baran's palace and faced the General Coy, Pinocchio and Doctor Page. During the fight, they discovered that Pinocchio was not just a robot but also a human and more especially Target's cousin Rick.

After this revelation, Logan stopped fighting Pinocchio, took Doctor Page out and discovered that all the other members of the Lazarus Project were dead. Unknown to Logan, Broker Andover, was able to fool Logan’s senses and escaped.

Wolverine discovered that what happened to Rick and to Rumika was part of the Lazarus project, this project that turned Rick into Pinocchio had been going on for years and killed more than a hundred people. The goal was each time to use the survivors of those slaughters as subjects for this project in order to have them volunteered into becoming super soldiers, half man half machine but totally under the control of their masters just like what happened to Rick. Those super soldiers were the reason the Prince Baran and the General Coy financed this project in order to have their own army.

The Project had been stopped and the Master Form was safe but this victory came at a cost as it took the death of hundreds of innocents to uncover the truth about this mysterious project and stopped it once and for all.[238]

Killing Zone[]

While he was still in Madripoor, Logan under the disguise of Patch decided to have some drinks with his friend Archie at the Princess Bar but shortly after they were attacked by a gang of Yakuza. At the same time at the palace of the Prince Baran, Dai-Kumo had one his scientist named Dr. Malheur forcibly extract the hypothalamic fluid from the brain of a Spider-Monkey in front of Tyger Tiger, the Prince Baran and General Coy.

According to Dai-Kumo, this fluid could cure cancer but also make all them rich, to that end the Prince Baran already agreed to suspend any governmental restriction since the Spider-Monkey was a protective specie native of Madripoor. Dai-Kumo only needed General Coy’s drug harvesters already present in the mountain where the monkeys lived to harvest them and then used Tyger Tiger’s established net of smuggler to ship the monkeys to Japan where they would be processed.

Of course the idea of avoiding tariff and government inspections delighted both the General Coy and the Prince Baran but Tyger Tiger wasn’t really happy about Dai-Kumo’s plan and warned him that the mountain tribesmen would be furious and that monopolizing a cure for cancer was going to bring a lot of opposition. Dai-Kumo agreed which is why he sent several yakuza to take care of one of the most obstreperous resident of Madripoor: Patch.

Back at the Princess Bar, Patch was overwhelmed by the dozens of yakuza and entered into a berserker rage, he was able to take most of them out until he was shot from behind and fell to the floor, outside Archie tried to find some help but no cop wanted to help and Tyger Tiger wasn’t available.

Thinking he was dead, one of the zakuza tried to finish Patch with a sword, but after being stabbed Patch awakened, broke the sword and defeated the rest of the Yakuza. Back at the Prince Palace, Tyger Tiger warned Dai-Kumo that taking actions against Patch would be foolish as it would disturb the fragile balance of power in Madripoor. She then asked Dai-Kumo to reveal what he was hiding from her but the Prince told her that it was none of her concern. As Tyger Tiger left the meeting, Dai-Kumo told his right hand man Goro to follow her.

Outside of the Princess Bar, seeing that Patch was gaining the upper hand, Dragonhead and his minions Eleven and Seven revealed that the fluid extracted from the brains of the spider-monkeys was also used to create a powerful drug named Thunderbolt making them unstoppable and after ingesting the drug they decided to attack Patch. After a long fight, Patch managed to defeat two of them before their leader Dragonhead threw himself and Patch in the waters nearby and blew himself up with two grenades, Patch survived but his healing factor was overloaded, Tyger Tiger decided to take him to one of her safe house in order for him to heal but unknown to them both Goro and his associate Reiko followed them.[239]

Shortly after, in the Madripoor mountains Dai-Kumo started to kill and harvest the Spider-Monkeys and when Goro told him he found Patch’s safe house, Dai-Kumo ordered him to kill him and to bring something back as a way of a proof. Reiko was displeased by what Goro was about to do and revealed that the only reason she was working with him was because she had to pay her father’s gambling debt now owned by Goro.

Just after Archie and Tyger Tiger left Patch alone in order for him to heal, Goro and Reiko killed all of the Tyger’s guards and then Goro killed Patch by stabbing him through the heart with his sword, Goro then took a picture of Patch’s dead body as a proof of the success of his mission.

In a state between life and death, Patch had a vision of Jean Grey, he was able to remove the sword from his heart and came back to life just as Tyger Tiger and Archie came back to the safe house, Tyger then told him that Dai-Kumo had a warehouse in Madripoor, which was Patch next destination.

At the warehouse Dai-Kumo and Dr. Malheur revealed that the fluid extracted from the brains of the Spider-Monkeys allowed them to create a drug named ”Zap” which was highly addictive but also a super-drug which was named “Thunderbolt” which granted super strength, endurance and immunity to pain for one one hour before killing its user. Reiko and Goro arrived at the warehouse and showed to Dai-Kumo, the photo of the dead Patch, their mission accomplished all of them headed to Osaka.

Patch now back on his feet was driven to the warehouse by Tyger Tiger, once here he discovered with horror a mountain of dead monkeys and one of the tribesmen who was also shocked by this discovery. The tribesman then felt that Patch was different, he was also a forest creature, a wild thing and he told him that Dai-Kumo headed to Osaka.[240]

To make sure that Dai-Kumo still believed that Patch was dead, Tyger Tiger gave him a drug that induced a state of catatonia so death-like that even doctors could be fooled and then placed his body in a coffin and sent him to Osaka by plane. Once the coffin arrived at the Osaka’s airport, Dai-Kumo was also fooled by Tyger Tiger’s drug and as it was custom for the yakuza to show respect for their foes, he ordered Goro to bury Logan in his personal plot.

As he was being buried, Reiko threw one of her flower on Patch’s coffin lamenting that he couldn’t save her, that he couldn’t kill Goro and set her free. At midnight, Reiko returned to Patch’s grave in order to pay her respect one last time but then after experiencing several nightmares Patch finally awakened from the drug given to him by Tyger Tiger and emerged from his grave. As he was about to attack Reiko, he recognized the smell of her flowers, he spared her and asked her to show him the location of her boss.

Back at Dai-Kumo’s place, the villain showed his invitees the power of his thunderbolt drug by using it on a wolf who became powerful enough to kill three tigers like it was nothing but suddenly Patch arrived seeking revenge for what Dai-Kumo did to him and the Spider-Monkeys. Patch defeated all of Dai-Kumo enforcers before being confronted by the drugged wolf who recognized Patch as one of his own and decided to not attack him.

Patch then went after Dr. Malheur who tried to kill him by making him fall in a vat full of the concentrated Thunderbolt drug, but as he was falling Patch caught Malheur and both men fell in the vat, Patch emerged alive saying that kind of drug had no effect on him while Malheur died a painful death. Patch was then confronted by Goro who ingested the Thunderbolt drug and despite Goro’s new powers, Patch easily defeated him but in the end he decided to spare his life.

Afterwards Patch discovered that Reiko had killed Dai-Kumo while he was taking care of the others, he then joined Tyger Tiger and Archie to their plane in order to get back to Madripoor. Sensing that there was something on his mind, Tyger Tiger asked Patch is he was okay, he answered that he was thinking about being trapped in a bad situation without any way out. Tyger Tiger then told him that not everybody got stuck, sometimes somebody managed to get out and as their plane was leaving Osaka, Reiko watched them from afar, she was now free thanks to Patch.[241]

X-Tinction Agenda[]

Back in Madripoor, Wolverine rejoined Jubilee and Psylocke and the trio decided to leave Madripoor and to start looking for the X-Men which led them to Genosha where they rescued Rictor. Both Wolverine and Psylocke decided to go undercover and infiltrate Hammer's bay but along the way they were captured by the Genoshan magistrates and put on trial.

Shortly after, Logan was forced to fight against Archangel but before the two men could kill each other, Jean Grey interned and stopped the fight. Wolverine then helped the X-Men, X-Factor and the New Mutants taking Cameron Hodge down.[242][243]

The Hunter in Darkness[]

Shortly after, Wolverine went back to Canada to spend some time in the Canadian wilderness in order to clean up his mind after his recent adventures. While he was fishing with his claws, he met two RCMP officers named Sergeant Doolin and Morris. Sergeant Doolin found Wolverine to be familiar but the real reason of their visit was to ask for his help into tracking a dangerous criminal named Athabasca Ike This murderer kidnapped a young girl named Miss Golightly after killing her whole family and was now on the run. Wolverine was able to quickly catch Athabasca Ike and Miss Golightly scents, and agreed to help the two officers to track them. On the road Doolin told Wolverine a story about how a dangerous monster named the Hunter in Darkness was living in the mountains nearby and how he was able to shoot it a long time ago.

Unfortunately, Athabasca Ike saw the officer’s car and shot it with a sniper rifle injuring Wolverine and killing Morris. As night started to fall, Wolverine decided to put on his costume and with Doolin they decided use the dark to track the Athabasca Ike. Along the way they were attacked by the Hunter in Darkness and in order to help Wolverine, Doolin turn his light on which prompted Wolverine to scream to him to "kill that light". But it was too late, the light gave Doolin location and he was shot by Athabasca Ike.

Mortally wounded, Doolin started to remember his past and most particularly his days as a soldier during WW2 after he heard Wolverine screaming to "kill that light" and most especially his corporal who told him the exact same thing. The same corporal who killed a whole regiment of Nazis with only a knife. Memories started to flood the Hunter in darkness' mind too after he recognized Wolverine's scent, especially of the time when a feral Wolverine who just escaped from the Weapon X project helped it when the beast was trapped in a bear trap.

The Hunter in Darkness decided to track Athabasca Ike and killed him while Logan was able to save Miss Golightly. But as Doolin was dying from his wounds he finally understood that he never shot the Hunter in Darkness all those years ago but Wolverine after seeing his walk and his posture. After this realization, Doolin also understood that the corporal from his WW2 days and Wolverine were the same person and as he was drawing his last breath he finally remembered the name of the corporal that he forgotten for years: "Logan". And as Wolverine discovered that Doolin was dead, he wondered how did Doolin know his name.[122]

Wolverine and Puck time traveling adventures[]

Not long after this mysterious discovery, Logan decided to go seek his friend Puck and found him in a bar in Vancouver where he worked as a bouncer. Unknown to Logan, Lady Deathstrike was on his trail and traveled to Osaka and Madripoor where Logan was seen previously and after threatening to kill a waitress in Madripoor, Tyger Tiger decided to tell her that Logan was in Vancouver.

In Vancouver harbor, Logan and Puck were fishing, drinking and talking about Literature, until Judd dropped an old photograph of himself with Ernest Hemingway and a girl named Inez taken during the Spanish Civil war in the 30s.

Logan recognized Inez which surprised Judd since he was sure Logan was never here. Before Judd could get an answer, Gateway teleported Yuriko near Logan and Puck but the vortex created by Gateway sent the trio back in time in April 1937 in Spain during the siege of Guernica.[54]

After meeting Ernest Hemingway and Inez, Logan and Puck were attacked by the Nazis but they were able to get rid of all of them. At the same time, Lady Deathstrike met the Captain Horst Schlachter, the acting commander of the Luftwaffe Feldgendarmerie and decided to use him to track Logan.

Logan and Judd decided to help the partisan resistance against the Nazis but along the way Puck was hurt by one of the Nazi aerial bombing and fell unconscious. Logan decided to put on his costume and fight the Nazis on his own.[244]

In the midst of the battle, Lady Deathstrike ambushed Logan and the two started to fight but their fight had consequences most notably with the continuum which created a time vortex. The time vortex became stronger which awoken Puck who rushed to help Logan, but the trio was then transported back in time once again to WW2, then to when Yuriko was changed into a cyborg by Spiral, next to the first fight between the cybernetic Lady Deathstrike and Wolverine and finally back to the present.

Logan and Puck landed in Vancouver harbor where they were before this adventure and Puck discovered that they inadvertently altered the past most especially with Logan now being present on that old photograph he had before this adventure which shocked Judd.

Yuriko on the other hand landed in Spiral workshop and discovered that Pierce created two new cyborgs to deal with Wolverine: one looking exactly like Logan named Albert and a little girl named Elsie-Dee.[245]

Muir Island Saga[]

Back at the mansion, Logan was still suffering from his recent injuries, although he still decided to spar in the danger room with Gambit while Jubilee was watching them. During the session, as Gambit's eye blinked, the danger room went haywire and as a result Logan was confronted by an hologram of Lady Deathstrike.

Wolverine was able to defeat Lady Deathstrike but was still shocked by the sudden appearance of this hologram, which reminded him of how Yuriko sacrificed her humanity just to have her revenge on him. Lost in his thoughts, Logan let his guard down, Gambit then decided to strike Logan from behind and pinned him down to the floor while mocking him and savoring his victory.[246]

Shortly after an attack of the Shadow King, Wolverine and the other X-Men were teleported to space by Lyla Cheney in order to save Charles Xavier, while there they were confronted by Deathbird and the Warskrulls.[247] Once free, Xavier discovered that the Shadow King had taken over Muir Island, the team decided to head back to earth in order to stop him.[248]

Unfortunately, once they arrived at Muir Island, the X-Men started to fall under the influence of the Shadow King including Wolverine but thanks to Forge Logan was able to regain his senses.[249][250] After saving Colossus, Professor Xavier decided to fight against the Shadow King on the Astral plane while Wolverine and the other X-Men tried to stopped their teammates who were still under his influence.

Along the way Wolverine was confronted again by Gambit who was under the influence of the Shadow King but this time Logan got the upper hand, he easily defeated Gambit and pinned him down to the floor. Logan then found Jubilee who was also under the Shadow King control, and despite her not wanting to fight him, he decided to knock her out to make sure she wouldn't hurt herself. The X-Men then managed to defeat the Shadow King once and for all, freeing all the people who were under his control.[251]

Albert and Elsie-Dee[]

In Los Angeles, Storm was investigating why two mobsters operating on Venice Beach named Jocko and Sally put a bounty on Logan's head, she discovered that someone looking exactly like Logan had been robbing them for a while.

Not far from here Molokai and Reno, two other mobsters working for Sally spotted Wolverine and decided to capture him. Logan, who was also investigating who was impersonated him, let himself be captured to learn more informations. After learning that his doppelganger was spotted on Venice Beach, Logan quickly headed here and was ambushed by Albert. The two fought but Albert was no match for Wolverine and was severely damaged by Logan's attacks.[252]

After Storm arrived on the scene and discovered what was going on, Elsie-Dee started a fire in order to attract Logan and kill him with the bomb that Pierce implanted in her body. Thinking she was just a little girl, Logan quickly headed to her location in order to rescue her while Albert managed to escape. After being saved from the flames by Logan and witnessing his heroism, she decided she didn't want to kill him and told him the truth but she didn't know how to disarm the bomb in her body.

To save her, Albert made his way to an electronics store and hacked into the NSA's supercomputers to crack Pierce's programming. He managed to crunch the numbers and made an override code for Elsie, which he transmitted to her even while getting shot down by the police for raiding the store which allowed her to disarm the bomb in her body.[253]

Shortly after Logan took Elsie-Dee to the X-mansion where Forge discovered that her whole body was rigged with explosives, he told Logan that it would be better to get rid of her but Logan refused saying she was different. Elsewhere, Albert's body was taken by the police and put into an evidence room where the cyborg was able to rebuild himself and gathered several information in order to save Elsie-Dee.

While Logan, Jubilee, Forge and Elsie-Dee were spending some time downtown, Albert was able to infiltrate and army base in Palmdale and stole a stealth bomber prototype. Elsie-Dee caught a message from Albert and discovered that he was alive, she asked Logan to help her reached the top of the World Trade Center where the reception would be better in order to contact him.

Once they arrived, Albert attacked Wolverine and the two fought once again until Elsie-Dee stopped their fight and told Albert that Logan wasn't their enemy. Albert was happy to hear that he didn't have to kill Logan and he agreed to land the stealth bomber and leave Logan alone, but before he could do it the stealth bomber was attacked by several fighter aircrafts and crashed at the bottom of the East River with Logan, Albert and Elsie-Dee still inside of it.[254]

Fortunately, Elsie-Dee was able to save the unconscious Logan and took him to the Morlocks tunnels nearby. While Logan was still healing, Elsie-Dee decided to look for help, but someone else was lurking in those tunnels: Sabretooth, fully healed from his previous fight with Caliban where he got his back broken.[255]

Logan also awoke and was ambushed by Sabretooth who claimed to be his father!!![256]

As their fight continue to rage on, Elsie-Dee found Cable, and tricked him into helping her and Logan against Sabretooth. All four of them were rescued by Nick Fury, Jubilee, Forge and the SHIELD but along the way Elsie-Dee's body was destroyed except for her head. Aboard SHIELD helicopter, Sabretooth escaped from his restrains, attacked Wolverine and was about to slice his throat but Elsie-Dee attacked Sabretooth and made herself and Sabretooth fall into the east river.

After witnessing Elsie-Dee's sacrifice, a S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist told to Logan that Sabretooth wasn't his father even though Creed really believed it, meanwhile at the bottom of the east river Elsie-Dee was rescued by Albert who also survived the crash of the stealth bomber previously.[257]

Logan then exited the SHIELD helicopter, and discovered that a big show was about to happen in town with none other than the Hunter in Darkness. On his way to this big show, Logan stopped at a zoo and freed a Wolverine who was abused by a dangerous psychopath named Linus Dorfman, at the same time, Albert with the help of the Morlocks was able to rebuild Elsie-Dee body. Elsewhere Lady Deathstrike also learned about the big show that was about to happen and decided to head here knowing that Logan would be here too but unknown to her Sabretooth who survived Elsie-Dee's previous attack decided to follow her knowing she would lead him to Logan.[258]

As the show started, the Hunter in Darkness was shot by a sniper and started to become crazy, prompting Logan to quickly jumped on the beast cage in order to free it. Unfortunately, Lady Deathstrike and Sabretooth attacked him at the same time, the trio fought until they broke the cage of the Hunter of the Darkness.[259]

Recognizing Wolverine's scent, the Hunter in Darkness decided to help him and attacked both Lady Deathstrike and Sabretooth while Logan tracked the sniper. Logan discovered that the sniper was none other than Emmy Doolin, the daughter of the sergeant Doolin that Logan encountered previously and she was blaming Logan and the Hunter in Darkness for her father's death.

She shot Wolverine and Sabretooth with some mercury tipped bullets that overloaded their healing factor and gave them some strange hallucinations and an impression of “déjà vu” most notably the mention of the words "the project" and "wranglers". Strangely enough during their hallucinations, Sabretooth also mentioned that Wolverine used to be his partner. Despite the hallucinations, Logan was able to beat Emmy Doolin thanks to Jubilee's help. Unfortunately, Sabretooth disappeared after the fight and Lady Deathstrike escaped with Ronald Parvenue's help while the Hunter in Darkness decided to hide in the Morlocks tunnels where it would soon meet Albert and Elsie-Dee.[260]

The Return of Magneto[]

After defeating the Shadow King, the X-Men were finally united again and decided to create two new teams: The Gold and Blue Team with Wolverine being part of the Blue team. Strangely enough, Logan's healing factor wasn't defective anymore and was now as good as new.

But the X-Men couldn't celebrate their victory for too long, after a danger room session they were contacted by Nick Fury and learned that Magneto returned to Earth and started to pull out the nuclear missiles from the submarine he sunk a long time ago. After learning the news, the Blue team decided to stop him, during the fight Magneto was severely injured by Wolverine and had to retreat. Back on his Asteroid M, Magneto asked one of his Acolytes Fabian Cortez to use his powers in order to heal him, unknown to Magneto Cortez’s powers never healed him but just boosted his powers for a while in order to give him the impression he was feeling better.[261]

Afterwards the Acolytes decided to attack Genosha which prompted the X-Men to fight them and defeat them. Unfortunately for the X-Men, Magneto came back to Earth, helped his acolytes defeat the X-Men, took them as prisoners before kidnapping both Charles Xavier and Moira and bringing all of them to his Asteroid M. Back on Earth, the United Nations decided to activate the Magneto Protocols in order to destroy his Asteroid M with a plasma cannon, knowing that time was running out, Storm assembled her Gold Team and went to rescue the Blue team before it was too late.[262]

Unfortunately, after the Gold Team infiltrated Asteroid M, Magneto used Moira to brainwash the Blue team in order to have the two teams fight against each other but the effects were only temporary and after a while the brainwashed X-Men remembered who they were. United again both the Gold and Blue team decided to face Magneto.

As the two teams were ready to attack him, Magneto collapsed and learned the truth about Fabian Cortez and how he duped him. Cortez escaped from Asteroid M and told Magneto that his base was about to get destroyed by the plasma cannon and that his death would help him gather new followers all over the world.

Shortly after Asteroid M was blasted by the plasma cannon, despite the fact that he was dying from the wounds inflicted by Wolverine previously, Magneto used his powers to keep the integrity of his station intact until the X-Men could evacuate. Despite Xavier’s desperate pleas, Magneto and his acolytes decided to stay behind in order to die.

Before the end and while the X-Men were witnessing the destruction of Asteroid M, Magneto opened his mind to Xavier one last time to show him that he still believed in peace but that Xavier’s Dream was just a fool’s hope and that if one day he was to meet the X-Men again, he would show them no mercy.[263]

Unknown to the X-Men and to Wolverine, back on earth Matsu’o Tsurayaba and the Hand managed to recover a terrible weapon from the Cold War, an old enemy of Wolverine that stayed in suspended animation during all those years: Omega Red.[262]

The Ghosts of the Past[]

Blood Hungry[]

In the woods, near Madripoor Logan was hunting a deer but an old wolf caught the deer before him, Logan decided to befriend the old wolf by carving the deer with his claws and giving the meat to the wolf. To repay Logan for his help, the wolf decided to give a piece of the deer's meat to him which prompted Logan to stay and eat the deer with his new friend.

Suddenly Logan smelled someone familiar who just arrived in Madripoor, to know more he went to see Tyger Tiger. Tyger Tiger told him that this stranger had something to do with a drug shipment full of hallucinogen and the General Coy, so Logan decided to spy on the General Coy.[264]

While at the General Coy's place, Logan was spotted and attacked by this stranger who finally revealed his real identity: Cyber. Thanks to his adamantium laced skin and his adamantium claws tipped with the same hallucinogen drug he wanted to sell to Coy, Cyber easily defeated Wolverine and poisoned him.[265]

Wolverine managed to escape but Cyber's drug gave Logan several hallucinations where he was reminded how Cyber was responsible of Janet's death years ago.[266][267][268] Despite still being shocked by his fight with Cyber but also afraid of him after what he did to both him and Janet years ago, Tyger Tiger convinced Logan to face him again.[269]

While Logan was recovering, Cyber approached Tyger Tiger to make her the same offer he did to the General Coy about his hallucinogen drug shipment.[267] Cyber's goal was to force both Tyger Tiger and the General Coy to agree to buy his drug shipment, and killed both of them at the same time in order to set himself up in Madripoor and used the port city for his own operations. When both General Coy and Tyger Tiger arrived at the rendezvous, Cyber killed all of their men and as he was about to kill the two of them, Wolverine intervened and saved them.[270]

After this close save, Coy and Tyger agreed to a truce for a while. Wolverine then faced Cyber on top of a truck full of the Cyber's hallucinogen drug and this time Logan was able to gouge Cyber's left eye, the same way Cyber gouged Logan's left eye after he killed Janet years ago.

Despite this injury, Cyber was able to leap on a nearby tree, Logan followed him in order to finish him off but Cyber got the upper hand and tried to rip Wolverine's claws off. Fortunately, the old wolf that Logan met previously appeared and bit Cyber’s neck which made him fall into one of the barrel of his hallucinogen drug below. The drug entered Cyber's system through his missing eye and gave him several hallucinations, as a result Cyber started to scream in terror and ran away.

Unfortunately, the old wolf died shortly after in Logan's arms, Logan then reunited with Tyger Tiger finally free from a demon of his past and told her that the next time Cyber showed up, he would be ready.[271]

Shiva Scenario[]

Greatly troubled by his lost memories, Wolverine investigated the abandoned Weapon X Facility in Canada where he had been transformed years before. There, he started having flashbacks of his time with Team X and from when he was abducted by the Weapon X program.[272]

After Logan learned that his memories were tampered, both Xavier and Jean tried to help him by removing some of his memory blocks but as a result Logan was overwhelmed and almost lost his mind. Professor Xavier told him that if he tried to remove Logan's memory blocks one more time it could be worse, Logan could lose his humanity. This revelation angered Logan and he tore off his brown costume and said he wasn't an animal but an X-Man.[92] As a result Logan stopped wearing his brown costume and decided to wear his original blue and yellow uniform again.[273]

Logan then headed to Windsor, Ontario and infiltrated an old Weapon X warehouse where some of his fake memories were created, while here he inadvertently activated the artificial intelligence Shiva, which was designed to kill rogue Team X members and the top name on their list was Wolverine.

Logan managed to defeat the Shiva robot but another one took his place and Logan discovered that he couldn't defeat it the same way twice, but he still had the upper hand when suddenly the Shiva robot blasted him with a mind probe that made Logan relive every pain, injury and moment of agony he had experienced in the past.

Unknown to Logan, the fight between him and Shiva was watched by both Carol Hines and the Professor Thorton who appeared to still be alive but shortly after Silver Fox revealed herself to both Hines and Thorton and she killed Thorton with what appeared to be some claws.

Logan discovered that Thorton was dead and that Hines was still alive but also that before dying Thorton activated all the remaining Shiva robots and that their main target was none other than Sabretooth. While Logan didn't care about Sabretooth's fate the X-Men worried about the other targets on the Shiva's kill list.

As a result of learning that many of his memories were implants, Wolverine became much darker which worried both Xavier and the X-Men.[273]

Omega Red[]

After they recovered Omega Red container, Matsu’o Tsurayaba and the Hand revived him and showed him a picture of Wolverine, telling him to go after him. At the X-Mansion, Logan and the other X-Men were enjoying their afternoon by playing a game of basketball but shortly after several agents of the Hand and Omega Red attacked them, before falling unconscious Logan recognized his old nemesis and ushered his real name: Arkady.[274]

Cyclops and the other X-Men were alerted by Omega Red presence and decided to intervene, they managed to save all the captured X-Men except for Wolverine, only his mask and his costume were left behind by the Hand. In a secret facility in Berlin, Wolverine has been fighting Omega Red for more than seventeen hours, their fight has been monitoring by the Doctor Abraham Cornelius, Matsu’o Tsurayaba and the Fenris twins in order to test Omega Red’s stamina.

Weakened by his fight with Omega Red and most notably by Arkady’s death spores, Logan was rendered unconscious by the vicious attacks of his nemesis, and as he lost consciousness Logan started to remember some parts of his past, most notably a mission in Berlin he did with Victor Creed.

Shortly after the Fenris twins, Mastu'o, Omega Red, and Doctor Cornelius examined Logan, Cornelius was trying to perform several memory inversions in order to discover the location of the Carbonadium Synthesizer also known as C-Synthesizer, the only thing that could stabilize Omega Red’s powers. Once Omega Red condition stabilized, the goal was for the Fenris twins to use him in order to gain dominance in the upstarts and achieve immortality.

Wolverine awakened from the drugs given to him by Cornelius but was still restrained with Omega Red taunting him, unknown to both men Maverick was also present and he switched off the lights, when the lights came back on, Wolverine broke free, took out the guards and was holding a strange canister. Knowing he couldn’t defeat Omega Red in his condition, Logan then taunted him before escaping with the help of Maverick who then brought him to the German Embassy in order for him to heal safely.

Unfortunately, the X-Men Blue Team were also tracking Wolverine and when they arrived at the complex where Logan was held prisoner, Cyclops, Jubilee and Beast were captured by Omega Red. After seeing what happened on Maverick’s screens which was monitoring the whole thing, Logan tried to get back on his feet but the damage he sustained at Omega Red's hands were too important, he fell to the floor and his heart stopped beating.[275]

To save Logan, Maverick decided to give him an injection of Neuro-Epinephrine which revived him and he started to remember that strange mission he did in Berlin alongside Sabretooth, Maverick and a double agent named Janice. Their mission was to put an end to the Soviet Super soldier program by recovering the C-Synthesizer, the only thing that could stabilize the powers of this new Soviet super soldier named Omega Red. As the team was pursued by Omega Red, Sabretooth killed Janice while the rest of team escaped. The trio then wondered if Omega Red wasn’t the only one with mutant power.

In Berlin the other half of the blue team composed of Rogue, Gambit and Psylocke faced against the Fenris twins but then Matsu’o appeared and ushered the word “Fine” which prompted Psylocke to take down her teammates. Matsu’o was able to control Psylocke’s actions thanks to the previously post hypnotic suggestion he implanted on her mind.

Thanks to the psy-link he shared with Psylocke, Wolverine felt Psylocke’s action and quickly awakened and asked Maverick how did he know his name. Maverick then understood that the reports he read were true and that Logan didn’t have access to his memory of time spent as a C.I.A operative. Maverick then remembered how their last mission in Berlin was considered a failure by the higher up because the team lost the C-Synthesizer after their escape, Logan also attacked Creed for killing Janice in cold blood and decided to quit the team afterwards.

Maverick then wondered at the time if Logan wasn’t the one who kept the C-Synthesizer with him during all those years. In the present to keep his cover intact, Maverick just told Logan he was a representative of the German government, Logan knew that Maverick was hiding something but before they could do anything both men noticed a familiar face on one of Maverick surveillance computer: Sabretooth.

Sabretooth was hired by Matsu'o and the Fenris twins to track down Logan and recover the C-Synthesizer by using the psy-link between Logan and Betsy. Both Psylocke and Sabretooth found the location of Maverick and Wolverine and captured them.[276]

Since they were still unable to replicate Wolverine’s healing factor the only way to stabilize Omega Red condition was to find the location of the C-Synthesizer, and since Wolverine was the only one who knew its location he was once again tortured by Matsu’o and Cornelius, who tried to force him to remember his last mission in Berlin.

Despite Cornelius reluctance to continue the memory extraction as it would kill Logan, Mastu'o forced him to speed up the process which resulted in Logan remembering more and more things from this last mission which helped Matsu'o discovered the location of the C-Synthesizer. Matsu’o then ordered Cornelius to kill Logan but Psylocke stopped him and revealed it was all a ruse and that in reality Wolverine’s near death experience freed her from Mastu'o control and that Sabretooth was under her control all along. She was just waiting to know the location of the C-Synthesizer.

At the same time Maverick broke free and teamed up with the mind controlled Sabretooth against the Hand and decided to save the X-Men, Psylocke defeated one of the Fenris twins and held her own against Omega Red until Matsu’o struck her from behind which freed Sabretooth from her control and as a result he attacked Maverick. Fortunately, Maverick had the time to free Beast who managed to knock down Sabretooth and free the other X-Men who easily defeated Creed. Wolverine angry about everything that happened to him finally broke free and attacked Omega Red, with the help of the X-Men the Fenris twins were stopped, but Omega Red, Sabretooth and Matsu’o managed to escape.

Elsewhere the Hand and Matsu’o went to a cemetery in Berlin in order to recover the C-Synthesizer after Matsu’o learned that Logan hid it in Janice’s coffin but when Matsu'o opened it, Wolverine was hidden inside of it and he cut Matsu’o left hand off. After defeating Matsu’o army, Logan was confronted by Cornelius who was going to shoot him but before that he apologized to Logan for what he did to him years ago. Logan having no memory of the Weapon X experiment didn’t understand what Cornelius was talking about and before he could get an answer, Cornelius was shot in the head by Maverick and Matsu’o managed to escape. Logan then gave the C-Synthesizer to Maverick telling him that despite the fact that he didn’t remember everything about his past, he had a vague recollection that it must belonged to him. After Maverick thanked Logan and gave him an intel about the location of one of his "former comrade", Logan disappeared.[102]

The former comrade that Maverick was talking about was none other than Logan's best friend Kurt Wagner a.k.a Nightcrawler,[277] at the time Kurt still believed that Logan and the X-Men were dead after their battle with the Adversary in Dallas during the Fall of the Mutants. Logan found his best friend in a small village in Germany, Winzeldorf.[277] and after a happy reunion,[278] the duo defeated Jutta and the Der Jarrmacht (a group of genetically-altered circus performers) in order to prevent a genocide.[279]

The Crunch Conundrum[]

After what happened the last time Professor Xavier tried to remove Wolverine's memory blocks, he decided to check Logan's mental state by putting him through several simulations in the Danger Room. During the simulation Charles and the X-Men discovered that Logan was slowly letting his animal's side taking over to the point of howling. Once the simulation was over, Logan decided to head to the Cloud 9 Motel where he met Mystique. In the Morlocks tunnels, Albert managed to find and rebuilt Elsie-Dee's body and their bomber, they were then joined by the Hunter in the Darkness. Both Albert and Elsie-Dee decided to bring the Hunter back to Canada until Elsie-Dee discovered a flux in the space continuum.

Back at the motel, Mystique asked for Logan's help against Spiral who lost her mind and begged Logan to not say her name out loud or she would appear. Logan didn't believe Mystique and said Spiral name and as a result she suddenly appeared.[280]

Before Spiral could warn them of an imminent danger, they were attacked by Plasma Wraiths who they managed to defeat. Spiral then told them there was a problem with the space time and that everything was converging to the Crunch (basically the end of time where the universe collapses into itself and ends). To fix this situation, Spiral created a vortex that transported her, Logan and Mystique to the future but also Logan's bike and Jubilee who was secretly following Logan. Now at the Citadel at the End of Time, moments before the Crunch, Logan discovered that Mojo intended to exploit the Crunch for entertainment value. Jubilee who was also teleported to the Citadel faced against one of Mojo's slave: Abcissa. In Canada, Elsie-Dee and Albert discovered an ancient Native burial mound of bones but more surprisingly the remains of a Wolverine from another timeline.[280]

Back at the Citadel, Logan, Mystique and Spiral didn't have any other choice but to use a missile created by Albert in order to destroy Mojo while still letting the Crunch happened. Spiral and Mystique teleported to the present and in exchange for the missile, Elsie-Dee, Albert and the Hunter in the Darkness were transported to the past in order to continue their investigation about the remains of this Wolverine from another timeline. Albert fired the missile through the vortex and the trio was then sent to the past. After seeing the missile passing through the vortex Logan hoped on it and redirected it towards Mojo, at the same time, Jubilee discovered that Abcissa wrap was none other than a future version of herself who accepted to become Mojo's slave but Jubilee refused to become Mojo's slave and as a result Abcissa vanished. Jubilee then drove Logan's bike and saved him before riding out of the Vortex while the missile hit Mojo, which allowed the Crunch to happen and preserved the universe. At the same time the remains of the Wolverine from the other timeline vanished too.

Logan then found himself at Baxter Building playing poker until he received a call from Jubilee who was teleported to Japan with Logan’s bike and who had been arrested for driving without a licence and for having smuggled a bike in another country.[281]

Mariko's Death[]

After receiving Jubilee’s call, Logan quickly headed to Japan with Gambit (to whom Logan owed money after that poker’s game) but unfortunately because of his adamantium skeleton he was stuck at the airport security of Los Angeles. After putting a call to SHIELD, Logan was able to go on the plane but his clearance request set off of Hydra's computers and Silver Fox called in to one of Donald Pierce's final cyborgs named Cylla to go after Logan and eliminated him. After landing in Japan, Wolverine and Gambit were attacked by the Hand that they managed to defeat but as a contingency plan the new leader of the Hand, Matsu'o Tsurayaba, bailed Jubilee out of jail and kidnapped her.

Jubilee met the assassin Reiko who was blinded by the Hand and who was tasked to kill her, in exchange Reiko would get her sights back but after Jubilee mentioned that she knew Logan, Reiko let her go as she was indebted to Logan.[282]

Logan and Gambit finally arrived at the police’s station but they were attacked by Cylla and several ninjas sent by Matsu'o Tsurayaba, thanks to the help of Sunfire they were able to defeat them but Cylla managed to run away. Shortly after Jubilee was found by Yukio who took her to her place while Reiko was promised amnesty with the Hand by Silver Fox in exchange for her help.[283]

After the fight at the police's station Logan and Gambit decided to head to the house of the Yashida's Family and discovered that the Clan Yashida was besieged by internal dispute.
