After Logan met Mariko and the Silver Samurai, the Hand attacked them forcing the Silver Samurai, Gambit and Logan to work together. Along the way Mariko gave Logan his old brown costume and he fought against Cylla again, this time defeating her.

Unfortunately, both Silver Fox and Matsu'o formed an alliance and used Reiko to trick Mariko into being poisoned, after Reiko learned who was Mariko and what she did to the woman Logan loved she killed herself. Faced with a slow and painful death, Mariko asked Wolverine to end her life quickly and mercifully. A heartbroken Logan reluctantly complied.[284]

After the death of the woman he loved, Logan spent the next few days sitting at her grave, even under the rain and despite Gambit and Jubilee's protest Wolverine didn't want to leave. Suddenly after hearing the Silver Samurai said the word “wraith” Logan had a memory flash of the last mission he did with Team X in Berlin that resulted in the death of Janice but now he also remembered the man named Wraith. After experiencing this memory, Logan agreed to leave but on the way to the airport he caught Matsu'o's scent, he then quickly changed in his costume and faced him. Wolverine then vowed to Matsu'o that he would slice off a part of his body on the anniversary of Mariko's death until there was nothing left of him.[285] A promise that Wolverine would kept for years until Matsu'o finally died.[286][287]

The death of Mariko changed Wolverine's character significantly, making him even more disciplined and emotionally distant.[288]

Psi-Borg[]

Shortly after Mariko's death and having experienced yet another flashback Logan decided to investigate his past with Team X. He finally found his old teammate John Wraith who triggered several of Logan's memories thanks to a Shiva's head and revealed that he managed to capture Sabretooth.[289] Afterwards Wraith revealed that he was worried that the age suppressor given to all Team X members was failing, Wraith's fears proved to be true as one of the members of the team named Mastodon died in front of them after the reversal of his "age suppression" factor.

After being joined by Carol Hines in his quest, Logan discovered that Silver Fox was still alive[290] and to his surprise, Silver Fox despised him for something she believed he had done.[93] But before Wolverine could figure out what Silver Fox believed he had done, the team managed to trace Mastodon's death to Aldo Ferro, now known as Psi-Borg. Psi-Borg overwhelmed them with his illusions, resulting in Carol Hine's death from an heart attack and in Silver Fox's death at the hands of Sabretooth. Sabretooth and Ferro both escaped afterwards leaving Wolverine with more questions than answers.[291][292]

Going Down Memory Lane[]

After the recent revelations from Aldo Ferro, Logan began to question the memories he possessed, but his quest to find his true identity and memories proved fruitless. Logan possessed memories of being a samurai in Japan, a mercenary operative for the CIA, a "wild man" in the Canadian wilderness and he also remembered romances with Mariko and Silver Fox. Because of the deaths of both Mariko and Silver Fox and Weapon X's mental tampering, Wolverine suffered a mental breakdown.[293]

Nick Fury and John Wraith decided to help Logan and revealed to him that his memory with Silver Fox was real as Logan was brought to their old Cabin in Canada, Logan then decided to bury her in this place next to the cabin where they used to live.[293]

Professor Xavier also decided to help Logan by unlocking a memory about "Terry Adams," but the process proved to be too much and Logan started to lose grasp with the reality and thought he was back to the 1960s during his team X days and that he had to finish his mission.[294] Logan then headed to Russia where he met a young woman named Elena Ivanova, who told him that she could help him find what he was looking for. At the same time the X-Men managed to find Maverick and learned that "Terry Adams" wasn't a person but the code name of a mission in Russia that took place in a former Soviet space center in Tyuratam.[295]

Soon after arriving at the former Soviet space center, Logan was able to find the super soldier created during the Cold War and more precisely during the space race between the US and the USSR: Epsilon Red He revealed that Logan was sent to kill him at the time but Logan couldn't do it, despite Epsilon begging him to kill him because after the experimentations he suffered he couldn't feel anything anymore not even the touch of his wife but his wife on the other hand begged Logan to spare her husband's life.

Before Logan could make a choice, Sabretooth told him the mission was aborted and Logan left both Epsilon Red and his wife alive. Epsilon Red then used his powers to burn the memory implants from Logan's mind and unlock his memories but unfortunately the process was only half successful and some of Logan's memories blocks proved to be impossible to break. Logan then decided to help Epsilon Red to go "home" which means to the stars so he helped him him smuggle aboard a space shuttle so that he could live among the stars.

It was later revealed that the daughter of Epsilon Red named Elena managed to recover some memories from Logan's mind thanks to her latent psi powers and explained that after Logan left during the original Team X mission, her father also begged Sabretooth to kill him but Creed refused and instead killed his pregnant wife in front of him just to make him suffer even more. As a result Helena was born by cesarean and swore revenge on Sabretooth.[96]

Due to extensive memory implants given to Logan through the Weapon X Project, any or all of these memories were suspect. Logan had at least one memory of meeting Captain America in World War II while he was in the Canadian Army which has been verified as true.[61]

No Longer "The Best There Is"?[]

Magneto's revenge[]

Shortly after, Magneto was revealed to be alive and he unleashed an electromagnetic pulse across the Earth which killed thousands of innocent people, Xavier and the X-Men decided to infiltrate his space station in order to stop him once and for all. Unfortunately for the X-Men, the fight didn't go as planned and as Magneto was about to kill Quicksilver, Wolverine intervened, he slashed him with his claws and saved Pietro's life.

Magneto fell to his knees but quickly retaliated and used his powers to tear the adamantium out of Wolverine's skeleton, causing extensive injuries which almost killed Wolverine.[296] These injuries overloaded Wolverine's healing factor for a time, and Logan also discovered that the claws that he believed a result of the Weapon X program were in fact part of his actual bone structure due to his mutation. As a result of his injuries and the loss of his healing factor, Logan left the X-Men for a time.[297]

The Dying Game[]

After he quit the X-Men, Wolverine traveled all around the world for a while, coming to terms with the loss of his adamantium and healing factor,[298] and facing some of his greatest foes along the way such as Lady Deathstrike[299] and Bloodscream.[66] Logan then decided to go to Muir Island at the request of Kitty Pryde, in here he met Zoe Culloden and was attacked by Cyber who broke his claws.[300]

While on the run from Cyber, Zoe Culloden decided to give a portable television to Logan and showed him a video of Dr. Jaime Munoz, a scientist who recovered a sample from Wolverine's DNA from a federal storage depot.[301] Dr. Munoz discovered that Logan's mutation changed the properties of the adamantium and transformed it into what he called "the adamantium beta." a new metal that would not inhibit the living nature of human bone when bonded to the human skeleton. It could be a major breakthrough in orthopedics but he needed more information and experimentation and implored whoever volunteered to the Weapon X program and to whom the sample labelled "Logan X Vol 1 23" belonged to, to come out and lend his aid not only for science but also because he discovered a defect in this DNA that could caused Logan troubles in the near future.[301] Unfortunately during the chase with Cyber, Logan was poisoned and began hallucinated and losing his mind, Kitty Pryde and Nightcrawler managed to lure both Logan and Cyber to Muir Island where Logan was cured and Cyber imprisoned.[302]

Wolverine couldn't contact Dr. Munoz as his condition worsened, sensing he was dying, Logan decided to put his affairs in order, he went to Japan and saved Amiko from her foster family and gave her to Yukio saying one last good-bye to both of them.[302] He then went to Canada to say goodbye to Heather and James Hudson,[303] helping them against a pack of lupine creatures similar to the Hunter in the Darkness.[304]

His affairs in order, Wolverine returned to Muir Island after receiving a telepathic call from Professor Xavier asking him to rescue the captured X-Men during the Phalanx invasion. Along the way he met again with Cyclops and Jean Grey, returning from their honeymoon (and secretly the future) and with Cable who also received a telepathic distress call from Professor Xavier. All of them teamed up and went to Tibet where they managed to free their teammates.[305][306]

Shortly after Logan went to Madripoor with Gambit where they tracked Maverick, who revealed he was dying from the Legacy Virus and wanted Logan to kill him. Logan refused and told him it was the coward way out and that he should not accept defeat. Maverick agreed but also pointed that Logan should listened to his own advice and not let his own illness made him forget his responsibilities. Gambit agreed with Maverick and told Logan that he should come back to the X-Men.[307]

As a favor to his friend James Hudson, Logan then went back to California to check on Garrison Kane and his girlfriend Copycat but along the way Logan encountered the mercenary known as Deadpool and was almost killed during their fight. But fortunately after his healing factor finally returned stronger than ever and saved him. Logan then went after Deadpool but he managed to run away and after checking on Vanessa and Kane, Logan left them and returned to the X-Mansion.[308]

Before he could arrive at the X-Mansion Logan was confronted by Ghost Rider who asked for his help against Ogun, Wolverine agreed and after defeating his old master he hit the road.[75] Shortly after Logan finally arrived at the X-Mansion, Sabretooth, who was a prisoner of the X-Men at the time that Xavier was trying to reform, managed to escape from his cell and as a result Wolverine confronted him. After a severe beating and hearing Sabretooth threatening to kill Jean Grey, Kitty Pryde and Jubilee, Logan snapped and thrust one of his claws into Sabretooth's brain almost killing him.[309]

Feral Logan[]

Wolverine's victory against Sabretooth came at price as Logan could feel his feral nature slowly taking over and as a result he decided to live in the woods for a while.[111] Around this time Professor Xavier, Beast, and Heather Hudson conducted experiments on Wolverine which showed that Logan's mutation was actually ongoing, and whilst his healing factor and senses would accelerate it would also cost him his humanity- for it would slowly change him into a bestial, wild, animal-like creature. It also turned out that the presence of the adamantium inside his body slowed his mutation process down, his healing factor treated it like a foreign substance and tried constantly to expel it.[310]

While wandering in the woods, Logan found the unconscious body of Maverick who was attacked by an organization which managed to capture Deadpool in order to experiment on him. Maverick asked for Logan's help and warned him that he might be the next on the list, Logan agreed to help him and together they saved Deadpool and defeated Slayback.

As a payback for saving him, Deadpool sent some samples of his cells to Beast in order to cure Maverick's condition but Beast told him there was nothing to do.[311] Shortly after, still living in the woods Logan was attacked by Kierrok and his army of N'Garai, with the help of Nightcrawler he managed to defeat them but the fight proved to be too much for Logan's sanity and he became more and more feral as a result which worried Nightcrawler.[311]

While he was hunting a deer, Logan was surprised by Sam Guthrie and after doing a race with him they decided to go for a drink at the Auger Inn, but while here they met the Juggernaut who was still suffering from deliriums after his fight with Onslaught.[312] Logan then decided to go see Jubilee and Generation X in order to train them but while here he was confronted by a Token that he managed to defeat. At the same time Tyler Dayspring sent his Dark Riders to Muir Island in order to free Cyber.[313]

Soon after Sabretooth who finally healed from his previous battle with Wolverine escaped from his cell and almost killed Psylocke.[314] Logan had to travel to Little Asia and then to the Realm of the Crimson Dawn with Angel and Doctor Strange in order to retrieve the Crimson Dawn blood(a mystical life-giving elixir) and saved her life.[315][316]

After this event, Wolverine finally decided to leave the woods for a while and went to Manhattan but to make sure nothing bad happened Guardian and Vindicator followed him. During his travel, Logan met Dirtnap, a mutant with the ability to absorb living beings and take on their forms. Dirtnap killed a young boy and tried to absorb Wolverine, but Logan's healing factor saved him, Dirtnap was forced to absorb a rat and he managed to run away.[317]

Soon after Logan decided to go camping with the X-Men but despite being with his friends Logan could feel how his perceptions of people were starting to change, how he was now viewing them in a different light and more especially as prey. At the same time Cyber was brought to Akaba, Egypt where he was subdued by Tyler Dayspring and eaten alive by his death-watch beetles who ate his flesh and left only his adamantium behind.[318]

Having learned of Cyber's escape, Wolverine decided to investigate and along the way he met the inter-dimensional pirate Chimera. After defeating her, Logan ran into Zoe Culloden and Landau, Luckman & Lake.[318] Logan headed back to Madripoor and discovered that Archie, O'Donnell and Rose Wu have been killed by someone using claws like him and that he was framed for the murders by Prince Baran and General Coy. After escaping from his cell thanks to Tyger Tiger's help and killing the murderers of his friends, Baran was killed by Coy and Coy was killed by Tyger Tiger. After meeting Dirtnap again along the way, Logan went back to the ruins of the Landau Luckman and Lake office and went through a dimension portal towards Akaba where he met Zoe Culloden again.[319]

In Egypt, Zoe told Wolverine that his destiny was to find Tyler Dayspring a.k.a Genesis, she then left him to chase Chimera. All alone Logan met Jamil who led him to Genesis's citadel. Inside Logan smelled Dirtnap and attacked him but it was a trap and Genesis shot Logan and put him in a water tank in order to bond Cyber's adamantium to his skeleton and made him his new horseman.[320]

Worried about Logan, Sam Guthrie with Tyger Tiger's help followed him to Egypt and after witnessing what Genesis was doing to Logan, he intervened. Sam was defeated and was about to be killed but to save his friend Logan decided to reject the adamantium and lost his humanity regressing to a feral like state. Logan killed all the Dark Riders and then brutally beat down Genesis and killed him too, knowing that he lost his mind Logan told Sam to tell Cable he was sorry for killing his son, he then disappeared. Elsewhere Stick sensed that Logan lost his way and tasked Elektra Natchios to find him and helped him regained his sanity.[321]

The X-Men also learned what happened to Logan and quickly tried to find him and help him especially Professor Xavier who already lost Sabretooth recently and didn't want to lose Logan too.[322] At the same time, the feral Wolverine came across Ozymandias' prison and finally encountered the X-Men again and helped them against Ozymandias' minions. Once the fight was over the X-Men took Logan back to the X-Mansion to help him while Elektra, who was hiding in the shadows, followed them.[323]

But the feral Wolverine couldn't stay at the institute and quickly escaped, wandering on his own[324] until he was found by Elektra who quickly started to train him in order to get Logan back on his warrior path.[76]

Unfortunately soon after, Professor Xavier fell under the influence of Onslaught and attacked the X-Men,[325] so Wolverine decided to look for answers about the origins of Onslaught. Thanks to the help of Elektra and Gateway, Logan went to the astral plane and relieved the painful moment when Magneto removed his adamantium. He also discovered that after Magneto removed his adamantium, Xavier wiped his mind as a revenge for what he did to Logan. But during their fight some essence of evil within Magneto reached out and infected Xavier with a darkness that began to grow and which turned him into Onslaught after a while.

Logan blamed himself for what happened and seeing his older self made him missed being a man, but Elektra told him that wasn't true Logan was still a man.[326] Still dealing with the damages caused by Onslaught, Logan finally met Stick who gave him his final lesson: Logan has always been a man in the places that matter and he needed to accept it or Onslaught would kill him.[326] His training finally complete and back on the warrior path Logan joined the others heroes during their final battle against Onslaught.[327]

After dealing with the aftermath of this battle and making peace with Cable, Logan decided to finish his training with Elektra, first they headed to Alberta where Logan buried Silver Fox to pay his respects and then to Elektra's home in Greece. In here Logan met Stavros who told him about his revenge quest against the murderers of Elektra's father and how only one of them was still alive, a man named Sawyer. But Elektra told him that revenge only brought misery and sometimes it was better to forget and forgive.

Stravos also told Logan a story about a Corporal he respected during WWII, he didn't know his name, only his nickname: "Canada" and that he looked similar to Logan. During the night, Stravos revealed that he already found Sawyer but after what Elektra said he decided to let him go but before Sawyer could leave, Logan caught him and warned him to never come back and to not go to the police or he would kill him. Unknown to Logan, the corporal Stravos was talking about was him all along, but because of Logan's feral appearance he didn't recognize him. His training finally complete, Logan left Greece and went to Japan.[68]

In Japan, Logan decided to pay his respect to Mariko and then went to see both Amiko and Yukio, but to make sure he wouldn't scare Amiko he used an image inducer to hide his appearance.[328] Unfortunately Amiko was captured by the new leader of the Hand Akatora in order to be brainwashed and turned into a weapon. Logan saved her and fortunately Akatora's brainwashing disappeared after a while.[329]

Shortly after Amiko decided to run away from the temporary foster family Yukio turned her over to when she was on mission, but after Yukio learned the news she quickly contacted Logan and both of them tried to find her. Logan managed to find her and learned that Amiko went on a quest towards the Golden temple where her mother brought her as a kid before she died. Logan decided to disguise himself as a thief and helped her on her journey towards this temple. After reaching their destination and discovering that the temple was only a ruin nowadays, Logan revealed his true identity to Amiko and told her that life is full of change and sometimes they are not for the best but not matter what she must always remembered her mother and kept her memory alive. Amiko having finally learned her lesson decided to go back home with Logan.[330]

Shortly after Logan helped Shaman against a demonic bear and thanks to the lessons of Elektra, Stick and the Professor Xavier, he was able to defeat his foe not with his claws but with his hands.[331] Thanks to Elektra and Stick training and all those experiences, Logan reverted back to his original physical appearance and decided to check on the X-Men.[332]

A Mysterious Box[]

At the mansion Logan found a strange wooden box with a device which showcased an hologram of Zoe Culloden who asked him to look after it and warned him that something dark was coming, and that the timelines were converging around him so he needed to be ready.

Shortly after as as a final test an evil spirit appeared in the Danger Room and taunted Wolverine that he could resurrect Mariko in exchange of his soul but Logan refused and stabbed him. Stick then appeared and said that Logan made the right choice and that he was on the right path. More determined than ever Logan took the mysterious wooden box, left the Mansion and headed to the East Village in Manhattan, in order to prove he could still live as a man. But before leaving he promised to the X-Men he would come back to the Mansion once he was ready.[332]

Now in town with his wooden box, Logan was adjusting to this new life and helped Clive Gooch and Helen Bach against some street muggers. Thanking him for his help, they introduced him to Kirstin the superintendent of a building and showed him the Third eye café where they loved to spend their time. Logan decided to rent a room from Kirstin and to find some work at the building construction site where Helen worked.[333]

Unfortunately a strange mime started to follow him around and tried to kill him, at the same time both Jean and Storm followed Logan and helped him against this mime. The trio discovered that the mime was possessed by an evil spirit and Jean managed to exorcise him but the spirit flew away and took possession of Helen.[43]

In Helen's body, the evil spirit revealed himself to be the same spirit Wolverine encountered in the Danger Room previously. Logan decided to pursue the evil spirit while Jean and Storm protected the mysterious box, during his search Logan came across Daimon Hellstrom who warned him to protect the box at all cost and vanished. Soon after Logan was attacked by Lady Deathstrike who also wanted the box because it held a great significance to her and her family.

During their fight, Logan discovered that Yuriko now possessed a cybernetic healing factor but after telling her that the box was given to him by Zoe Culloden, Yuriko decided to stop the fight as she wished to learn more about Zoe and the box. Back at Logan's apartment Jean and Storm discovered that a strange light was coming out the box but before they could discovered what it was, they were attacked by the possessed Helen.

Logan and Yuriko managed to lend a hand to Jean and Storm and Jean was able to free Elen, unfortunately the evil spirit took possession of Lady Deathstrike and used her new cybernetic healing factor to reshape her face into a devil mask before running away.

Logan recognized the evil spirit and told the X-Men that the spirit that he encountered in the Danger Room and who followed him here was Ogun all along. Jean noticed that Logan finally beat his feral regression and he was now back to his old self.[334]

Shortly after Logan now back with the X-Men was attacked and almost killed by Bastion as part of his Operation Zero Tolerance.[335][336] Thanks to his healing factor, Logan survived and managed to free the X-Men and Jubilee.[337][338] Unfortunately while fighting the sentinels Scott was infected by a bomb,[339] but both Logan and Cecilia Reyes managed to save him.[340]

After Bastion was arrested and the heroes that sacrificed their life against Onslaught finally made it back to our reality, Scott and Jean decided to leave the X-Men for a time while Logan stayed at the Mansion and helped the remaining members dealing with the aftermath of Bastion's attack.[341]

Not Dead Yet[]

While wandering in the East Village, Wolverine discovered a dead homeless man in his apartment with a knife and the picture of the dead body of one of his old acquaintance: the movie producer Tak-Wah Wong. On top of that he also discovered that his apartment was booby trapped with several adamantium devices, as his apartment blew up Logan managed to escape by jumping through a window. Logan understood who was behind all of this: McLeish a.k.a The White Ghost, the greatest Hitman that ever lived.[342]

10 years ago, Wolverine used to hang out with McLeish in Hong Kong because he could understand him, most notably the things Logan had to do in the past. But as time went on, McLeish became more and more obsessed with Logan, most notably with his superhuman abilities and his berserker side while Logan grew tired of McLeish company and started to put some distance between them.[343]

Unknown to Logan, McLeish befriended him because he wanted to use him in order to approach Tak-Wah Wong who was the father of Ai-Chia Wong (Logan’s girlfriend at the time), and to kill him. When Logan found out that McLeish killed Ai-Chia’s father and used him, he went after the White Ghost, broke his back and left him for dead in an explosion.

But for Ai-Chia, the loss of her father and the discovery that Logan used to hang out with his murderer was too much and it created a rift between her and Logan, as a result she told him that she never wanted to see him again and that like McLeish the name “White Ghost” fitted him well.[344]

Back to the present, several hitmen employed by McLeish attacked Logan and almost killed him but Logan managed to survive and started to track his old foe. On his way to meet McLeish, Logan was attacked by several mercenaries, all using adamantium bullets. Logan disposed of them and finally found McLeish's hideout but here he also discovered the dead body of Ai-Chia killed by his old foe. The White Ghost then taunted Logan that he killed her and many other and told him to come find him. This revelation enraged Logan and he swore to McLeish that he was going to kill him.[344]

An angry Wolverine continued to track his foe and after he finally defeated the last of his mercenaries, Logan was then confronted by the son of the criminal who hired McLeish to kill Ai-Chia’s father years ago and that Logan killed. Logan killed him with his claws and was then confronted by McLeish himself who shot him down with an adamantium bullet coated with poison and told him that he wasn’t dead yet.

Down to the ground, his healing factor overloaded, Logan tried one last bluff and said that when he was working for the Canadian Security Intelligence Service he discovered that McLeish had a son and he killed him. Angry with this revelation and by Logan’s taunts the White Ghost lost his temper, dropped his guard and came close to Logan. Logan then used his claws to grab him and he finally killed him before admitting that everything he said was just a lie.

After burning McLeish's body and his hideout, Logan went back on the road still haunted by the consequences of his actions on the life of the people he cared about and the fact that he killed McLeish with lie and fear just like the White Ghost tried to do to him. Logan wondered if that made him better or worse than his old foe.[345]

Marrying Viper[]

After dealing with both Bloodscream and Roughouse (who decided to become a villain again)[346] and teaming up with Captain America,[347] Wolverine was contacted by Viper, who invoked Logan's promise to Seraph many years before. Wolverine married Viper, giving her the status to become ruler of Madripoor. During the wedding, Viper and Logan were attacked by Sabretooth who revealed that he now possessed an adamantium skeleton and claws.[127]

As a result Sabretooth easily defeated Wolverine, broke his claws and claimed himself: "The King of the World".[348] Thanks to the help of Kitty Pryde Logan managed to stop Sabretooth from taking over Madripoor leaving only Viper as the sole ruler of the Island for now.[349]

But Logan's defeat at the hands of Sabretooth shook him to the core and made him wondered if he still had his edge, to prove to himself he was still the best there is he traveled to the old Weapon X compound. But after he arrived, he was quickly attacked by the Wendigo, without any adamantium and with his claws still broken after his fight with Sabretooth, Wolverine was no match for the Wendigo and only managed to scare his face which made the Wendigo ran away while Logan lost consciousness due to his wounds.[350]

Fortunately, Wolverine managed to get back in shape thanks to the help of a young boy named Tommy but the Wendigo wanted revenge and tracked Logan again but this time using some gasoline and an axe Logan burned the Wendigo's face and made him ran away again. Logan then understood that this fight was exactly what he needed in order to find the Wolverine from before Department H, before Weapon X, before the adamantium, not just Wolverine the animal but Wolverine the man! The fighter who could analyze his opponents and defeat them no matter how strong they were and that he didn't need any metal to do it.[350]

Now finally at peace with himself, Wolverine decided to resume his adventures but after returning to the X-Men and dealing with Magneto's return, Logan and the team were teleported to space by Ejulp.[351]

Horseman of Apocalypse[]

During this space adventure with the X-Men,[352] Logan was subsequently kidnapped by the would-be conqueror Apocalypse and replaced by one of the Skrulls who infiltrated the X-Men.[353] Logan was then forced to fight the savage assassin Sabretooth for the mantle of the Horseman Death. Knowing that he might be able to resist Apocalypse's programming and that Sabretooth would be a very dangerous villain with the support of Apocalypse, Logan fought and defeated his nemesis. As a result, Apocalypse succeeded where Genesis had failed, rebonding adamantium to Wolverine's skeleton.[353]

As the horseman of Death, Wolverine completed several missions for Apocalypse and fought the Hulk. Meanwhile, the skrull that replaced him tried to create a rift between the X-Men and their mentor but during one mission, he was slain by the real Wolverine under Apocalypse's orders.[354] After discovering that their teammate was a Skrull, the X-Men found out that the real Wolverine was Apocalypse's horseman and decided to help him.[355] Under the control of Apocalypse, Wolverine fought the X-Men ferociously in his Death persona, but Psylocke, Archangel, Kitty Pryde and Jubilee helped him broke free from Apocalypse's control.[356]

Six months later, still dealing with the aftermath of being an Horseman of Apocalypse, Wolverine decided to go to Japan to check on Amiko and Yukio but was soon caught in a gang war.[357] He managed to put an end to this war and spent some time with both Amiko and Yukio,[358] afterwards he joined the X-Men again[359] and witnessed the death of his friend Colossus who sacrificed his life in order to eradicate the Legacy Virus.[360]

After the Legacy Virus was cured, Magneto amassed his army and decided to wave war on humanity and kidnapped the Professor Xavier, Wolverine teamed up with Cyclops (who was also recently under the influence of Apocalypse), in order to infiltrate Genosha and stopped him.[361][362] Years after Magneto removed his adamantium and almost killed him, Logan finally had his revenge when he stabbed Magneto and severely injured him, which put an end to his war against humanity and left the island of Genosha in chaos.[363]

A New Beginning[]

The Return of Weapon X and Ogun[]

Shortly after he met the psychopath known as Mister X who wanted to beat Logan to prove that he was the best there is.[364] After beating Wolverine[365] and telling him how much he enjoyed killing, Logan snapped and let the berserker took over. As a result Logan defeated Mr.X and almost killed him but his foe managed to run away thanks to his bodyguard named Blok who knocked Wolverine out. Logan was able to regain his senses shortly after but to his surprise he also had a strange vision of a demon after his encounter with Blok.[366] Not long after, Logan discovered that since he became a horseman, he had nightmares and visions of himself killing people and most notably the X-Men. Something wasn't right with his mind and after taking down a nest of broods, he tried to search for answers.[367]

It turns out that all those nightmares were caused by a new Weapon X program held by Malcolm Colcord[368] and thanks to some old Weapon X code, Colcord used Logan to do some recons which helped the agents of the new Weapon X program commit several crimes but after Logan was forced to kill a politician, he broke free of the mind control.[119] To get Logan's back under control, Colcord used his right hand man, the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Brent Jackson to capture Logan and sent him to the Cage.

While here, Logan was tortured by the wardens and almost eaten alive by the immortal monster Mauvais.[369][370][371] To free Logan, Colcord enlisted Sabretooth and infused his skeleton and claws with adamantium again and boost his healing factor.[368] After Sabretooth retrieved Wolverine, Colcord intended to put some new memory implants inside his mind but Logan was freed before the procedure was fully completed by Shiver Man under the orders of Nick Fury. Despite being defeated by Sabretooth afterwards he managed to escape although it was unknown if the memory implants procedure was successful or not.[119]

After receiving a mysterious letter, Logan went to Madripoor to investigate.[372] While here he had to take part into several underground cage fights with several superhumans until he fought Mister X in finals who revealed he was the one who sent this letter to Logan because he wanted to fight him again.[373] During their fight, Wolverine finally understood that Mister X incredible fighting skills came from his telepathic powers which allowed him to read his opponents mind and anticipated their next moves. Logan decided to let the berserker take over just like the first time he fought Mister X, since no one, not even Logan could predict his next move while in this state. Wolverine defeated Mister X again but his foe managed to escape and as Logan was about to leave Madripoor, Viper told him that someone else was here, someone much more dangerous than Mister X: Ogun.[373]

Ogun revealed that he took possession of Viper and he followed Logan since his first meeting with Mister X where he was hidden inside Blok's body hence Logan's vision of a demon because he always wanted to possess Logan's body. Ogun tried to possess Logan but because of Wolverine's bestial nature and everything he suffered in his life, the pain was too big for Ogun to handle and he had to leave Logan's body. In the end, Ogun took possession of Viper again thinking Logan would never strike him down though her but Logan stabbed Viper and managed to defeat Ogun, freed Madripoor from his influence and Ogun died as a result. Logan then struck a deal with Viper by allowing her to get some medical treatment and in exchange she put an end to their marriage.[77]

Back in Canada, the immortal Mauvais decided to eat the heart of the Wendigo and took his powers.[374] Almost unstoppable now, he was finally defeated by the combined effort of Wolverine and Alpha Flight and was then sent to the prison of the Great Beasts where he was tortured. But before leaving, Mauvais warned Logan that no matter what happened to him, Logan's fate was going to be much worse in the following days.[375]

The Logan Files[]

Mauvais' predictions turned out to be true, as Sabretooth went on a quest to destroy Wolverine's life once for all. To that end, he stole the "Logan Files" from the Weapon X program, hired Omega Red and Lady Deathstrike to hurt Logan's friends and captured Amiko. To make things even worse Creed used the codes he stole from the Weapon X program to access their latest weapon and completely depowered Wolverine.[376]

Without any powers, Logan went to see Yukio and learned that she was tortured by Omega Red and Lady Deathstrike and that Sabretooth kidnapped Amiko . Seeing no other choice, Wolverine went alone to Las Vegas and confronted the trio and despite wearing the Guardian costume he was defeated and almost killed.[377]

Sabretooth then betrayed Omega Red and Lady Deathstrike and took Amiko and Logan to Canada. He then told Logan that if he managed to get to Amiko before he caught and killed him, he would let her and Logan go but he would also give him something else: The Logan Files. Those files were supposed to contain everything related to Logan’s past before he was abducted for the Weapon X experiment. Seeing no other choice, Logan ran away in order to quickly find Amiko and those files before Creed killed both of them. As a result, Sabretooth tracked Logan all though the Canadian wilderness and almost killed him several times while Logan tried to find Amiko.

Logan then discovered that Sabretooth hid Amiko in the old Weapon X compound where he was subjected to the adamantium bonding process but while here Logan found Amiko dead, killed by Sabretooth. Angry by what just happened, Wolverine tried to fight Sabretooth head on, but in the ensuing battle he was brutally beat down by Sabretooth. Creed then revealed to Logan that the "Logan Files" he stole were empty, the Weapon X project never knew anything about his past, it was all a lie. The only person to blame for Logan's memory loss was Logan all along, since his healing factor was healing the trauma and made him forget his most painful memories.

After this revelation Sabretooth fatally wounded Logan but at the same time Colcord who managed to track down Creed and Logan, also used his last weapon to deactivate Creed's powers. Feeling weak from the effect, Sabretooth let his guard down and Logan managed to gain the upper hand but before he could deal the last blow, Creed teleported himself away. After the injuries he sustained during his fight with Sabretooth, Wolverine fell to the ground and finally died in the place where he was made into a weapon.[286]

In the afterlife, Logan met a strange redhead woman who revealed several things to him about his long life and most notably how he coped with pain. Because of his missing memories, Logan thought that this strange woman was Jean Grey and as he was almost ready to let go of the pain and made peace with himself in order to learn the truth about his origins, he was attacked by several deceased villains who wanted revenge.

Logan decided that he didn't want to let go of the pain just yet and decided to fight all of them one last time, as he was overwhelmed someone intervened and helped him: his deceased friend Colossus. Happy to see his friend back, they both managed to defeat all those villains but Logan's choice had a big consequence, his will to fight kicked back his healing factor and his soul was returning to his body but before leaving the mysterious redhead woman told him one last thing: "I'm not Jean."

As Logan regained his body and wondered who this redhead woman was, in the afterlife, all alone the redhead woman said one last thing before letting a rose flower fell to the ground: "Farewell, James my love, perhaps we'll be reunited again someday." Back to the land of the living, Logan made his way to the X-Mansion and discovered that Amiko was alive, she was saved by the Weapon X project and Colcord to make up for what Creed did.[288]

But this near death experience would have big consequences on Logan, leading him to have nightmares and an obsession about discovering the true identity of this woman.[378][379]

Weapon Plus and the Death of Jean Grey[]

After the X-Men defeated Cassandra Nova,[380] Jean Grey and the Professor Xavier went to Paris and met a strange character named Fantomex who revealed several truths about the Weapon X project and most notably that Weapon X meant "Weapon 10" all along and that the Weapon X program was just a part of the Weapon Plus program which created several weapons through the years. It was also revealed that the latest weapons were created in The World which was a self-contained research facility built by Weapon Plus somewhere in rural England.[381]

After defeating Weapon XII, Jean Grey learned that Fantomex was also a Weapon Plus victim, that his real codename was Weapon XIII and that he was also created in "The World." Shortly after while rescuing the mutant Dust, Logan met Fantomex who called him by his real name for the first time in years:"James."[382]

Shortly after during a riot at the Xavier School, Quentin Quire used his powers to trap Wolverine into one of his memory where he heard someone calling him again by his real name: "James."[378]

After Jean Grey discovered that Cyclops had a psychic affair with Emma Frost, Scott left the Institute but Logan and Fantomex managed to track him down and convinced him to help them infiltrate "the World" in order to learn the truth about the Weapon Plus Program and about Logan’s origins.[383] Wolverine, Cyclops and Fantomex infiltrated "The World," there Wolverine learned how he had been used in the Roanoke slaughter during the Weapon X experiment, and other Weapon Plus secrets.[384]

It was later revealed that it was Sublime's plan all along to let Logan looked at those files in order to unlock this memory about Roanoke and to bring him back to this place later on.[385] After being confronted by the last product of the Weapon Plus program Weapon XV, Logan detonated a bomb blowing up the Weapon Plus station and Weapon XV in the same process.[384]

Shortly after, Jean decided to rescue Wolverine and went to the Weapon Plus station where she discovered that he managed to kill Weapon XV but Logan told her that it was a trap. Jean realized they were both standing on Magneto's old asteroid M[386] and that it was hurtling toward the sun which was Xorn's plan all along.[379]

As the heat slowly began to intensify, Logan could no longer stand seeing Jean in such pain and decided to take her life with his claws, giving her a quick death. Logan then took Jean in his arms, opened the airlock and together they faced the heat of the sun. As Logan and Jean were consumed by the heat, Jean's eyes opened and she unleashed the power of the Phoenix.[379] Thus empowered, Jean returned Wolverine and herself back to earth as Logan slowly healed. However, as the duo confronted Xorn alongside their fellow X-Men, he injected Jean with a lethal electromagnetic pulse and she died in Cyclops arms. Angered by what just happened, Wolverine beheaded Xorn to avenge her.[387]

Wolverine greatly mourned Jean's loss and was not pleased with Cyclops' and Emma Frost's new relationship,[388] but he remained a valued member of the X-Men, serving on as many missions as he could while also indulging in the occasional solo missions. It was during this period that Logan discovered that his friend Colossus had been brought back to life by the alien warrior Ord,[389] he also met Hisako Ichiki a.k.a Armor and decided to train her.[390][391] Thanks to her training with Wolverine, Armor became a valuable member of the X-Men and would even replaced Kitty in the team roster after she was lost in space.[391]

The Brothers, Cassie Lathrop, and the Native[]

While living on his own, Logan met a young woman named Lucy and they became friends most notably because they both love reading. Unfortunately, one night, a commando entered the building where Logan was living and killed Lucy.[392]

After learning that this commando was part of a cult named “The Brothers” and that Lucy escaped from them, Wolverine decided to take them down. After meeting the ATF agent Cassie Lathrop and locating “The Brothers”' stronghold, Logan discovered that Lucy wasn't the first woman who was abused and killed by this cult, and after he saw all the murders this cult committed he entered in a berserker's rage and killed everyone on sight.[393] This experiment was hard to handle for Logan and he asked his friend Nightcrawler to help him but despite Kurt telling him he was an honorable man and his friend, Logan still pondered if after all of that and despite everything he did in the past, he was no more than a bloodthirsty animal.[394]

Shortly after Logan discovered a human trafficking business at the Mexico border, he decided to investigate and put an end to it.[106] Along the way he met Cassie Lathrop again and the two of them began a relationship,[395] but Logan was still riddled with nightmares,[41] and one night he decided to leave while Cassie was still sleeping.[396]

Around the same time Sabretooth was hired to capture a new creature called the Native but he failed. Seeing an opportunity, Creed used Logan to track the Native by telling him that this creature was also part of the Weapon X project.[396]

Logan went on a quest to discover the truth and learned that the Native was a woman with the same powers as him, after a brief fight and letting his feral side took over, both him and the native felt a strange attraction to each other and made out.[397] Regaining his senses, Logan discovered that the Native's mind was fractured but he also discovered several clues leading him to believe that the Native and him had a long history together in the past, most notably that they were both living in a cabin before the Weapon X project abducted them.[398]

Unfortunately, after Creed failed to capture the Native his employers double crossed him and tracked both Logan and Native down and captured the Native and experimented on her. Logan decided to team up with Creed to save her but he betrayed him and then went on his own to save the Native.[399][400] Logan discovered that the Native was pregnant and that her "eggs" were retrieved and would be used as a potent weapon. Logan freed her and killed the scientists while Sabretooth killed his employers and decided to track Logan.[401][402]

After defeating Wolverine, Sabretooth then tracked the Native and told her he couldn't let her live, because other scientists would find her again and used her as a guinea pig to make both him and Logan obsolete. The two of them fought and Creed finally killed her, after retrieving her dead body Logan asked Kurt to give her the last rites.[402]

Meeting X-23[]

Around that time Wolverine received a strange letter from Sarah Kinney, telling him that a young female clone of him named Laura and codenamed X-23 was created and used to commit several assassinations all around the world. Shortly after, X-23 tracked Logan to the X-Mansion, Logan smelt her scent and led her to a quiet place where they wouldn't be disturbed. While here Logan tried to reason with Laura, but Laura attacked him and almost killed him but before she could deal a fatal blow, Logan used this opportunity to calm her down and broke through Laura's conditioning in order to help her. After talking to her and telling her that he would help her, Logan and Laura were attacked by the S.H.I.E.L.D. and Captain America, who were here to arrest Laura for her crimes and despite Logan’s intervention Laura was finally captured. Captain America with the help of Daredevil discovered that Laura wasn’t in control of her actions so he decided to let her go. He told her to go find Logan and the X-Men but unfortunately Laura didn’t listen to Steve’s advice and now on her own she disappeared for a while.[403]

Some time after, Wolverine and the X-Men were investigating several murders cases committed in New York and after looking at the dead bodies Logan and Ororo discovered several slashes similar to Logan's adamantium claws. Their investigation led them to a super-being themed nightclub called the "Wannabees." In here Logan caught Laura's scent and when he tried to talk to her she stabbed him in the chest and cut his face with her foot claw.[404][405] Not giving up on her, the X-Men tracked her and Logan finally confronted her alone, Laura attacked Logan again but this time Logan easily subdued her.[405]

After clearing the misunderstanding, she helped the X-Men and Logan brought her to the Xavier Institute, although Logan made a deal with Laura and decided to hide the fact that he knew her to the X-Men in order to protect her.[406] While here Laura acted really protective towards Logan following him everywhere and even attacking Bishop while he was sparring with him during a training session.[407] Not long after Laura left the X-Men but Logan who called her his “sister,” convinced her to come back to the mansion in order to work with both the New Mutants Squad and the Hellions Squad despite Emma Frost protests.[406][408]

Enemy of the State[]

Some time after a young boy named Rikuto was kidnapped and in order to deal with the kidnapper the parents of the boy Ichiro (who was Mariko's cousin) and Fukuko asked for Wolverine's help. It turned out the kidnapping was a setup and Wolverine was ambushed by the Hand and killed by the Gorgon who told him that they already killed Rikuto.[409] Logan was then resurrected by one of the Hand's mystics, Phaedra[35] who retained a fragment of Wolverine's soul, which became the warrior Shogun.[410] Hydra then used their technology to transform him into a killing machine that they unleashed aboard a S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier.[411] Now in control of Logan's body and with the help of several teleporting devices, Hydra forced him to first kill a S.H.I.E.L.D. nurse[409] before forcing him to fight against several other heroes such as Elektra[411] the Fantastic Four,[412] the Hornet,[412] and Daredevil,[413] each time succeeding in completing his mission.

Although the fight with Daredevil proved to be decisive, as Daredevil managed to impale Wolverine on a sword creating intense pain which allowed Logan to break through Hydra mind control just in time to warn Matt that Hydra was planning to kill the President of the United States and that their fight was just a diversion allowing the Hand and Hydra to kill and resurrect Elektra as one of their own before being teleported away by Hydra.[413]

Wolverine then infiltrated the X-Mansion and threatened Rachel Grey into using Cerebra in order to lobotomize the U.S. President or he would kill everyone in Westchester thanks to a bomb designed by Reed Richards and stolen by Hydra. But instead Rachel used Cerebra to read Reed Richards's mind, dismantled Wolverine's bomb and warned the X-Men. Logan's teleporting device was damaged by Rachel so he could only teleport to short distances, while he was trying to escape from the X-Mansion compound he killed Northstar. Wolverine was finally stopped by the combined efforts of the X-Men, the Avengers and finally by Captain America himself.[414]

Back in the hands of S.H.I.E.L.D., Nick Fury tasked a team a scientists to remove Logan's brainwashing and turned him back to his older self in order to use him against Hydra and the Hand. Unfortunately both Hydra and the Hand with Elektra's help killed several superhumans and resurrected them as part of their army and attack the S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier where Wolverine was detained.[415]

Seeing no other choice, despite Wolverine's rehabilitation far from over, the S.H.I.E.L.D. scientists decided to unleash him against Hydra forces, as a result Logan killed several members of Hydra army and was able to save Nick Fury from the resurrected Northstar. After regaining his senses and told Ichiro and Fukuko that their son was dead, Logan promised them that he would avenge the death of their son no matter what.[416] Wolverine started by tracking Northstar in a bar and after trying to reason with him, he was beat down by Jean Paul and his team and was then taken to an old warehouse in order to be killed. But unknown to Northstar, everything was according to Logan's plan and thanks to the help of a sentinel he stole from the S.H.I.E.L.D. he took all of them down and then headed to Japan to face the Hand.[417]

While in Japan, Wolverine faced an army of ninjas and Elektra who revealed she was undercover all this time, together they took down the Hand and went on their way to take down Hydra and the Gorgon.[418] Unfortunately for them, the Gorgon proved to be too powerful and he defeated them, the Gorgon then read Elektra's mind and discovered the location of a wounded Nick Fury.[419] The Gorgon teleported himself to Nick Fury's location where he easily dispatched all the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents protecting him and was about to kill him but Wolverine wearing a jetpack managed to save Fury and engaged the Gorgon on a one on one fight.

Angry after what the Gorgon did to him and to Rikuto, Wolverine decided to kill him once and for all but despite severely injuring the Gorgon, Logan was about to get killed by his foe's vision. Wolverine then used used his claw as a mirror in order to reflect the Gorgon's sight which turned his own powers against him and turned him to stone that Logan proceeded to shatter. After defeating the Gorgon Logan disappeared for months, leaving a trail of body all around the world which started to worry Nick Fury and the X-Men. The truth was that Logan was searching for Rikuto's body and after finally finding where the boy was buried he told his parents the location of his body, saying he was sorry for everything.[418]

Logan later attended the funeral of the S.H.I.E.L.D. nurse he killed under Hydra's mind control, but unknown to him, the son of the nurse swore revenge against him for the death of his mother. The young boy was bounced around from foster home to foster home, six different foster homes in less then a year. But one day, an old man took him in and knowing how much he hated Wolverine, he brought him into his criminal organization, the Red Right Hand.[107]

Wolverine the Avenger[]

The New Avengers and House of M[]

While on a mission in the Savage Land, Wolverine met the recently reformed Avengers and eventually accepted membership, as Tony Stark felt that Logan could provide a useful perspective to the team in this modern world.[420]

As a result of the House of M, during which Scarlet Witch altered Earth's reality and then restored it, Wolverine regained all of his memories due to Wanda attempting to give all the heroes what they most desired which allowed Logan to finally being able to sort between what was true and implanted in his mind. After regaining his memories he traveled to Japan in an attempt to come to terms with his past and went to visit the Silver Samurai, who serves as a guard to the prime minister of Japan.[421] Wolverine battled with Silver Samurai, cutting his hand in the process.[422] Later, he visited the site of the original Weapon X program,[120] which led to a clash with Bucky, who apparently killed Wolverine's wife, Itsu, who was pregnant at the time.[423] Bucky apologized to Wolverine, telling him that he was not in control of his actions at the time.

Logan then went to see the immortal blacksmith, Muramasa, and claimed the weapon forged with the piece of his soul just after Itsu's death. Muramasa gladly gave it to him, telling him to "wield it like an angry god." The Muramasa Blade now in his possession, Logan was ready to start his quest for revenge.[80]

Shortly after, U.S. government officials aware of Wolverine's intentions and probably under Romulus' command, sent a Shiva robot,[424] as well as Nuke, to kill Wolverine[83] however, he survived.[425] Emma Frost later learned that Daken, Wolverine's son, was still alive and had been manipulated into hating Wolverine. Logan swore to locate him and decided to give the Muramasa Blade to Cyclops to make sure that Scott would use it against him if he went too far.[27]

After the events of House of M, all the powers of the depowered mutants were absorbed by Michael Pointer a.k.a the Collective and was heading to Earth leaving mass destruction and almost killing the members of Alpha Flight[426] but fortunately Wolverine and the New Avengers managed to stop the Collective.[427]

Meeting Daken and the Return of Cyber[]

Despite having Dum Dum Duggan and the S.H.I.E.L.D. on his trail, Wolverine was still tracking his long lost son in Berlin but while here he was confronted by Omega Red who wanted the Carbonadium Synthesizer. In order to lure Logan out of hiding, he decided to attack a center for depowered mutants where he severely injured Maverick and took Jubilee as an hostage along the way.[428]

With the help of the Black Widow, Logan managed to trick Omega Red by promising him the Carbonadium Synthesizer in exchange for Jubilee's life and as a result he was captured by the S.H.I.E.L.D. Unfortunately during the ensuing battle, Jubilee was severely injured and only S.H.I.E.L.D. medical units could helped her.[429] Logan accepted to be taken into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody and Jubilee was saved, but shortly after Daken managed to infiltrate the S.H.I.E.L.D. facility where Logan was detained and father and son finally met for the first time. The family reunion was cut short after Daken eviscerated Logan deeming him weak and left him for dead.[430]

Thanks to his healing factor Logan survived, he managed to escape and decided to resume his track of Daken which lead him to Brussels.[431] While here Logan finally confronted Daken and despite the fact that he wanted to help him, his son decided otherwise and slashed Wolverine's throat.[432] Soon after while Logan was bleeding on the floor, Daken was attacked by a resurrected Cyber who tried to kill both him and Logan. Logan managed to recover from his injuries and helped his son against Cyber, but in the midst of the battle Daken decided to abandon Wolverine and left him to fight Cyber alone.[30]

Cyber had the upper hand during his fight with Wolverine but fortunately for Logan, it turned out that Cyber suffered from a heart condition and as a result he was defeated.[30] In order to get some answers about Romulus, Logan decided to save Cyber's life by taking him to the lab of Tinkerer in the Hague. The Tinkerer saved Cyber by implanting a carbonadium peacemaker on him, the Tinkerer also created three carbonadium bullets that he gave to Logan.[31]

Cyber then learned that the radiations produced by the carbonadium would slowly killed him without the Carbonadium Synthesizer but Logan stole it. Shortly after while walking on a bridge Logan got rid of of the Carbonadium Synthesizer by throwing it in some water below, savouring his revenge on Cyber. Logan then sent the three carbonadium bullets to Bucky with a message telling him to get ready to use them soon.[31]

Civil War[]

After the destruction of Stamford by the super-villain Nitro, which started the Civil War, Wolverine went after Nitro himself. Although the X-Men were neutral in this conflict, Wolverine, also a member of the New Avengers, led a S.H.I.E.L.D. team to apprehend Nitro.[433] This went badly, with Wolverine as the only survivor, and which resulted in a conflict with several Atlantean guards, and the king of Atlantis himself, Namor afterwards.[434] Nitro was eventually brought to Atlantis, where he lost a hand to Wolverine's adamantium claws.[434]

Wolverine then discovered that Damage Control was behind the destruction of Stamford and more precisely Walter Declun. After escaping from S.H.I.E.L.D. and fighting several Damage Control guards equipped with Mandroid armors Logan confronted Declun and stabbed his eyes out.[435][436]

Wolverine then worked with Atlanteans and fell in love with Amir, an Atlantean woman,[437] but she was killed by Scimitar terrorists, who attacked Wolverine.[438] Lazaer then defeated him in the astral plane, leaving him brain-dead. He recovered with the help of Doctor Strange, and then confronted Scimitar members Shogun and Phaedra, who resurrected Shingen Harada to fight him.[439] Wolverine defeated Shingen and slew Shogun and Phaedra. Lazaer also returned the stolen soul fragment, but warned Wolverine he could never escape death by defeating him in astral combat again.[410]

After the end of the Civil War and the death of Captain America, Logan decided to pay his respects to Steve before resuming his quest of vengeance, the next target on his list: Sabretooth.[440]

The Death of Sabretooth[]

After Sabretooth joined Rogue's X-Men team and decided to live at the X-Mansion, Logan confronted him in order to put an end to their feud once and for all but also to get answers about Romulus.[441]

Their fight took them all over the world from Westchester to Wakanda and finally to Canada. During their fight, Logan had many visions about the mysterious Romulus who supposedly had manipulated the events of his whole life with the help of Sabretooth, he also learned that him and Creed were part of the Lupine race (this revelation was later revealed to be a lie). As part of those visions, Wolverine also heard the phrase: "Quod Sum Eris" several times.[442]

Unfortunately Wolverine lost Sabretooth's track for a while, and while he was trying to find him he met the new and improved Wild Child along the way. When Logan finally found what appeared to be Sabretooth again, he discovered that his foe had regressed to being no more than a feral animal.[443] After attacking Wolverine, this feral Sabretooth killed Feral[444] which prompted Logan to get his Muramasa blade back from Cyclops in order to confront his foe near the cabin he used to live with Silver Fox years ago.

Armed with the Muramasa Blade, Wolverine was able to easily defeat this feral Sabretooth by cutting his right arm off, he then beheaded him while wishing him a "Happy Birthday." Shortly after, he was confronted by Wild Child again and he met for the first time since he recovered his memories Romulus. Both Romulus and Wild Child managed to escape and an angry Logan swore he would find Romulus and kill him for what he did to him.[22]

Tracking Mystique and becoming the Black Dragon[]

After the events of Messiah Complex, Cyclops asked Wolverine to find and kill Mystique for betraying the X-Men. Logan managed to find Mystique less than 9 hours later in Iraq and after several encounters with her where she mocked Wolverine and the X-Men, he managed to defeat her.

As the result of their fight Mystique was severely injured, Logan decided to not kill her but to abandon her in the Syrian Desert alone with just a gun, telling her that despite what she thought of him or the X-Men at least he had a family but not her, after betraying everyone she would always be alone and no one would come to help her.[445]

After the destruction of the Xavier's Institute during the events of Messiah Complex, the X-Men relocated to San Francisco. Unfortunately for Wolverine who just recovered his real memories, coming back to San Francisco opened some old wounds and most notably his past in Chinatown with the Black Dragon Tong. After his last visit, Lin became the new Black Dragon and swore vengeance for what Logan did 50 years ago when he refused to become the new Black Dragon which forced Lin to take his place. After she learned that Logan was in town, she sent her Black Dragon Death Squad after him and he was almost killed as a result.[446]

Fortunately Logan was saved by Master Po and a young boy named Yuen Yee, with their help he learned the way of Kung-Fu and was able to easily defeat the Black Dragon Tong Death Squad. Logan then ended Lin's reign and this time he accepted to become the new Black Dragon, the protector of Chinatown. Unfortunately Lin managed to escape.[447]

Leading X-Force[]

Shortly after Wolverine took care of Mystique, Cyclops decided to assemble a new X-Force consisting of Wolverine as team leader, Warpath, Wolfsbane and X-23 in order to take care of the dirty business the rest of the X-Men wouldn't do normally, including murder. Although Cyclops decided to add X-23 to the team without consulting Logan first which angered him since he was trying to have Laura to be more than a killing machine but despite Logan's protest Laura was added to the team.[448]

Their first mission involved infiltrating a North Dakota S.H.I.E.L.D. facility to root out a group of Purifiers led by Matthew Risman who had infiltrated the base and stolen valuable technology required to resurrect the Sentinel known as Bastion. During the planned raid, the team discovered that Wolfsbane had been captured, despite Wolverine telling her to stand down, X-23 disobeyed his orders and as a result Risman shot Wolfsbane in the leg.[448] With Risman still having Wolfsbane and the X-Force team held at gunpoint, Logan told X-23 for the second time to stand down, but instead she detonated several explosives that she planted earlier without telling her teammates. The explosion destroyed most of the Purifiers' base but almost killed the team and allowed Risman to escape with Wolfsbane as his prisoner.[449]

After Risman managed to resurrect Bastion, Bastion found the Magus at the bottom of the sea and in combination with the Transmode Virus he was able to resurrect and control several dead foes of the X-Men and together they formed the Human Council.[450]

After the failure of their first mission, Logan talked some sense into Laura and afterwards the team managed to rescue Wolfsbane but she had been drugged and subjected to subliminal programming by the Purifiers, as a result she attacked on sight both Laura and Warren, ripping Warren's wings off.[451] Following this attack, Warren reverted to his old Archangel persona, the team managed to stop the Risman and the Purifiers but Logan discovered all the villains that Bastion resurrected and he knew that X-Force mission was just starting.[452][453]

Shortly after still dealing with the aftermath of their fist mission, the team added two new members to their lineup: Elixir and Domino, the team then tracked the Vanisher who stole a sample of the Legacy Virus. The team managed to destroy the sample and the Vanisher was forcibly added to the team after Elixir gave him a brain tumor.[454] Around that time, Warpath discovered the true identity of one of the Purifiers: Eli Bard, a two thousand years old follower of Selene who resurrected several deceased mutants with the transmode virus as an offering to Selene.[455]

During the events of Messiah War, the team was sent to the future by Cyclops in order to locate and help Cable and Hope against Bishop and Stryfe. Once in the future, the team managed to defeat Stryfe and protect Hope but Bishop ran away. Back in our time, X-23 managed to save Boom Boom and killed the Leper Queen, but she was captured and took to the Facility and tortured by Adam Harkins and Kimura.[456] Thanks to the help of Agent Morales, Wolverine and the team managed to locate Laura and rescue her.[457]

During the events of Necrosha, thanks to Eli Bard and the Transmode Virus Selene became more and more powerful and resurrected many dead mutants and used them as her own army against the X-Men. X-Force managed to infiltrate her fortress in Genosha and defeated her returning the souls of the deceased mutant to rest. After this event Wolverine told Cyclops that Laura was out of the team from now on, Cyclops agreed but first he had one more mission for X-Force.

Secret Invasion and Dark Reign[]

Not long after the end of the Civil War, Logan stayed with the New Avengers team and during a mission in Japan they discovered that the Marvel Universe had been infiltrated by the Skrulls.[458] After failing to defeat the Skrull Queen and the world witnessing Norman Osborn saving the day, Wolverine and the Avengers were labeled as criminals and outlaws.[459] Norman used his new position to track down and seized everything he wanted and more precisely The World which put him in conflict with both Wolverine and Noh-Varr who both put an end to his plans.[460]

Later on, Norman Osborn recruited Mystique, who managed to survive her previous encounter with Wolverine, for his Dark X-Men team. Mystique then resumed her war against Wolverine and the X-Men in order to have her her revenge against them.[461][462]

Once done, Wolverine then resumed his quest of vengeance against Romulus and used Deadpool to find his son, after he located him Wolverine arranged for Daken to be shot by Bucky with one of the carbonadium bullets he gave him previously. The carbonadium bullet slowed Daken's healing factor down and Logan was able to capture him with the intention of removing Romulus' influence.[463]

However,Sebastian Shaw abducted Daken, intending to brainwash him into servitude. After learning that Professor Xavier was alive, Wolverine teamed up with him and fought against Shaw's Hellfire Club. Blocked by a psychic booby trap in Daken's mind, Shaw manipulated Professor X into triggering the trap and absorbing most of the damage, which restored Daken's memories. Both Wolverine and Daken defeated Shaw and resolved to seek vengeance against Romulus together.[464]

Shortly after, while looking for clues about Romulus both Logan and Daken met Cyber in North Africa who also wanted revenge on Romulus. Unfortunately after learning what Cyber knew about Romulus, Daken betrayed Logan and left Cyber for dead because he decided he didn't want to kill Romulus for revenge anymore but because he wanted to take his place.[465] Now on his own, Daken was then recruited by Norman Osborn for his Dark Avengers.[466]

After learning the news that Daken joined the Dark Avengers, Logan met with Nick Fury and they understood that Daken was after the Muramasa blade in order to have the metal bonded to his bones and becoming unstoppable. But before Logan could warn the X-Men of Daken's plan, Cyclops decided to take matter into his own hands and almost got himself and his squad of X-Men killed by Daken.[467][468] Logan managed to save them and stopped his son from getting the Muramasa blade, but unfortunately a piece of the blade was retrieved by Daken[469] and with the help of both Romulus and the Tinkerer, two of his claws were bonded with the metal of the Muramasa blade. Logan tried to help Daken one last time but he was stabbed in the chest by his son who then ran away. Thinking that Daken was a lost cause, Logan decided to resume his quest of vengeance against Romulus.[470]

After all these revelations about his past, his son's betrayals, seeing him joined Norman Osborn's Dark Avengers and stealing his codename, Logan started to show signs of a nervous breakdown as pointed by Yukio and Spider-Man.[471]

The Adamantium Men[]

Before Wolverine could go after Romulus, his former Team X teammate, Maverick, contacted him to inform him that a private military contractor called Blackguard got their hands on the old Weapon X files, including the recipe for synthesizing adamantium which allowed them to create a group of twelve mercenaries called Strikeforce X, an elite unit of men armed with healing factors, unbreakable skeletons and laser claws.[472] Not only that, but they were being used to carry out atrocities in the name of Blackguard's corporate interests.[473][474] With the help of reporter Melita Garner, Logan was able to expose Blackguard to the world and kill most of Strikeforce X, but the Chief Executive somehow managed to survive. What Logan didn't know was that Maverick was the man who stole the Weapon X files in the first place and sold them on the black market. In an effort to cover up his involvement in kick-starting the Strikeforce X program from Wolverine, Maverick killed the man whom he sold the files to.[475][476]

Insane in the Brain[]

No long after, Wolverine found himself in Dunwich Sanatorium in a foggy haze with a hospital full of misfits and few memories of his past that seemed to point to the fact that he was insane. A fellow patient warned him that the director, Dr. Rottwell, had a penchant for harvesting brains, which seemed to be proven out when, the very next day, Logan discovered that the patient had been lobotomized.[477] After Logan lost his identity in this insane asylum, Dr. Rottwell tried to get him to release the aggressive killer inside of him while still sublimating the rest of his past. A pair of mob goons came looking for someone to pull off a contract killing and Dr. Rottwell offered them Charlie Chainsaws from whom he had removed his hands and attached actual chainsaws. As Logan reached the end of his tolerance for abuse and torture, he finally popped his claws and took out an orderly while Rottwell looked on and smiled.[478] Unable to warp Logan's mind into becoming a feral killer using conventional brainwashing, Dr. Rottwell decided to take the direct approach by cutting directly into his skull. When Rotwell kept wrecking blades on Logan's adamantium skull, he plugged Wolverine into his innovative God Brain machine to get some readings. Logan was able to make a mental cry for help to reporter Melita Garner (the very same journalist who helped him expose Blackguard previously) before the machine took full effect.[479] Melita received the desperate psychic message from Wolverine and called in the X-Men to help, Nightcrawler and Psylocke answered her call and invaded Dunwitch Sanatorium and dismantled Rottwell's God Brain machine. The mob later showed up looking for their missing goons; with chaos abounding as the mob, the patients and the staff all try their best to kill each other, Logan took the opportunity to try and carve up Dr. Rottwell but found his tormentor impossible to kill; Rottwell then escaped as Wolverine made his way to Melita to recuperate but shortly after, Rottwell used what he discovered inside Logan's mind to manipulate him into killing a man and stealing his brain.[480]

Relationship with Melita[]

As his relationship with Melita blossomed into something more, Logan received relationship advices from the women in his life. He tried to warn Melita away from him because of his lifestyle and his past history with women who ended up dead but she simply replied that she could handle it. Unknown to both Logan and Melita, Mystique also found out about this new relationship.[481]

Tomorrow Dies Today[]

Before resuming his quest for revenge, Wolverine learned about Steve Rogers' return so he took his friend to a bar to celebrate his resurrection, unfortunately they were soon attacked by Deathloks.[482] Shortly after Wolverine met Miranda Bayer who told him that the Deathlok cyborgs from the future had killed all of their targets except for one: Captain America. In the dystopian future where those Deathlocks came from, an aged and damaged Wolverine helped the future version of Miranda Bayer and her troops in their mission to destroy the Deathloks' time portal to our time.[483]

Both this aged Wolverine and the future Miranda were killed by the Deathlock in the future while in the present Logan, Steve Roger and Bucky helped the future Deathlok overcame his programing after he met his younger self: Evan Wakowski. Now free of his programing, the future Deathlok decided to explore the present while the Marvel heroes wondered if they really managed to change the future.[484]

Afterwards, Miranda was tasked by the commander of the future to leave the boy in an orphanage where he was going to be brutalized which would lead him to become a criminal and then one of the subject of the Deathlock project. It was later revealed that this boy, the future Deathlock and the commander of the rebellion in the future were the same person at different points of time meaning this apocalyptic future wasn't averted.[485]

Facing Romulus[]

After dealing with the Deathlocks, Wolverine decided it was now time to put an end to Romulus' plans once and for all, so he tracked his right hand-man Victor Hudson in order to locate him unfortunately both Romulus and Victor tricked Logan and led him to a Russian's prison where an angry Omega Red was waiting for him. Logan managed to defeat him but he was soon captured by Wild Child.[486]

Wild Child then revealed to Logan that everything he did since he retrieved his memories was part of Romulus plan, that he made sure that Logan fought against Sabretooth, Cyber, Omega Red, Wild Child and Daken to see who would be the strongest and the fittest to replace him as the head of his empire, which was what the phrase: "Quod Sum Eris" meant.[487]

Suddenly Omega Red appeared and killed Wild Child, Wolverine was able to escape but Omega Red managed to find him again. After what Romulus revealed to him previously, Wolverine decided he didn't want to fight Omega Red because he didn't want to play Romulus' game anymore, but Omega Red threatened to go after Daken if Logan didn't want to fight against him. With no other choice, Wolverine used the broken Muramasa Blade and killed Omega Red but suddenly Romulus finally appeared and confronted Logan.[487]

Wolverine managed to defeat him but Romulus reminded him that no matter what happened, if Logan killed him he would be at the "top of the food chain" and he would have to kill his son next because there could be only one person at the top. Logan shocked by this reveal decided to let Romulus live but he vowed to destroy Romulus empire. As Logan turned his back and lowered his guard, Romulus used this opportunity to knock him out and then left him alone with his broken Muramasa blade.[488]

In order to take down Romulus, Logan needed the help from someone with a plan so outside of the box that nobody, not even Romulus could ever figured it out and that someone was Deadpool. Deadpool's plan was to used the Answer in order to stage the evasion of Ruby Thursday but at the same time Logan needed to seek help from Skaar, Bruce Banner and the Silver Samurai. Before putting Deadpool's plan in motion, Wolverine rediscovered his skills in sword fighting by training with the Silver Samurai, he then rescued Dagger who had been kidnapped by Romulus and Victor Hudson and he killed Victor Hudson.[489]

Once done, Deadpool's plan was put into motion and after witnessing Ruby's evasion, a confused Romulus tried to blackmail her in order to learn what she knew. Naturally Ruby betrayed Wolverine and his team and revealed everything she knew, which was part of Deadpool's plan. Once done and Romulus fooled, she was then quickly sent back to the Raft by Cloak. Thanks to this misdirection Logan was able to lure Daken out of the shadows and staged his son's death which confused Romulus even more.[490]

Once Romulus was out of the shadows, Wolverine was then betrayed by Daken again who decided to ally himself with Romulus against Logan and Skaar. After the battle, both Romulus and Daken escaped, and Daken revealed to Romulus that he wanted to kill him and take his place. Unknown to Daken, his betrayal was also part of Logan's plan and as he was about to strike Romulus with his Muramasa claws, Romulus was teleported away by Cloak.[491][492]

Romulus was transported by Cloak near the Howlett estate, in here Wolverine slashed Romulus with the Muramasa Blade but didn't kill him, instead he made sure that Romulus would be trapped in the Darkforce dimension forever.[493] At the same time Daken, now all alone and without any means to kill Romulus and take his place, was confronted by Logan armed with the Muramasa Blade. Thanks to the lessons of the Silver Samurai,[494] Logan was able to easily defeat Daken and remove his Muramasa claws.
