He then hid both Daken's claws and the broken Muramasa blade in an unmarked grave near the Howlett Estate putting an end to Romulus empire and legacy once and for all.[493] Shortly after ending Romulus' reign, Logan met Nick Fury and finally made peace with his past, he then decided it was time for him to move on and to focus on the present and the future.[495]

The Death of Nightcrawler[]

During the events of Second Coming, Cable and Hope finally came back to our time, Wolverine and his X-Force team had to help them against the Purifiers and the Human Council. Unfortunately after X-23 killed a prisoner in front of the X-Men the news about X-Force broke out and a rift was created between Wolverine and several members of the X-Men most notably with his best friend Nightcrawler. Before Logan could explain himself to his best friend, Kurt was killed by Bastion while trying to protect Hope and shortly after Bastion unleashed an army of Sentinels from the future which forced X-Force and Cable to go to this future in order to stop the source: Nimrod. Once Nimrod was stopped, Cable sacrificed his life to make sure the team could come back to the present. After all the members of the Human Council were killed, Bastion tried to kill Hope but he was finally defeated.

In the aftermath of this battle, the death of Nightcrawler had a profound effect on Logan and the news of this X-Force team broke his friendship with Ororo. True to his words, Logan removed Laura from the team and told her it was time for her to find her own mission in life and to be more than just a weapon. Despite Cyclops' orders to disband the team, Wolverine secretly assembled a new X-Force team with Psylocke, Deadpool, Archangel and Fantomex.[496]

Shortly after the death of his best friend, Logan paid his respect to Kurt, fulfilled his last will and learned a last lesson from him.[497]

A New Era[]

Uncanny X-Force[]

After the formation of the new X-Force team, Warren called for X-Force and revealed to Logan that he hired Deadpool (it would later be revealed that Wade worked for Warren for more than a year[498]) in order to investigate the activities of the Clan Akkaba and that Wade discovered that Apocalypse was going to be reborn in a new body. Logan agreed to help Warren and X-Force went after Apocalypse and the Clan Akkaba.

But unknown to the team, the Clan Akkaba resurrected Apocalypse as a child and was indoctrinating him into resuming his old duties.[499] The young Apocalypse was protected by a new group of Horsemen but X-Force was able to defeat them and they discovered that the new Apocalypse was only a child.[500] After this discovery the team decided to not kill him and Logan proposed to bring the boy back, rehabilitate him and train him but Fantomex, acting on his own, immediately shot the young Apocalypse in the head which created a rift in the team.[501]

After this event, Angel lost control of his Archangel personality, and went on a killing spree.[502] Trying to remove Apocalypse's influence on him, X-Force traveled to the Age of Apocalypse universe, thanks to Dark Beast, to find the Life Seed, the only thing that could save their friend's life.[503] There, Wolverine met the Jean Grey of that universe, his alternate daughter, and an evil version of himself.[504]

When X-Force returned to their universe, they were attacked by Archangel and the Dark Beast, who took the Life Seed in order to restart evolution.[505] After a heavy battle between the forces of Archangel and X-Force, Psylocke was able to stab Archangel with a different Life Seed, killing his alter ego, and saving Earth from the Age of Archangel.[506]

The Heroic Age and Fear Itself[]

After the events of Siege, Logan stayed with the Avengers[507] and worked with them during the Serpent's attacks on Midgard, first by fighting the secret organization S.T.R.I.K.E. that planned to destroy New York with an Atomic Bomb, and later, by using one of the armors Tony Stark made with the mystical metal Uru to defeat the Worthy.[508]

Later, Norman Osborn appeared again alongside his new Dark Avengers team (which included the resurrected Gorgon who was masquerading as Wolverine) to get his revenge on the Avengers but Wolverine and the Avengers managed to stop them.[509]

Spider-Man and Wolverine: Time Travelers[]

During what seemed to be a routine robbery, Spider-Man and Wolverine were thrown back in time by magical diamonds, to the time of the dinosaurs. While Spider-Man secluded himself, Logan befriended a tribe of early humanoids. His involvement with them allowed them to survive the K-T Extinction Event. When the meteor came, Spidey and Logan found themselves flung into the future, where the extinction of humanity allowed the tribe to dominate the world.[510][511]

But in the future, the world was menaced by Doom the Living Planet and only one thing could defeat him: Phoenix Gun, a weaponized piece of the Phoenix Force, capable of destroying anything at the price of the life of the one who fired it. Despite Spider-Man's protests, Wolverine used the Phoenix Gun to destroy Doom and as such, he died in the process. However, Spider-Man resurrected him with a Cosmic Cube, much to Logan's dismay, the duo was then assaulted by the pair of Czar and Big Murder, who sent them through time once again with the diamonds.[512]

Logan wound up in a wrestling ring, facing down Peter Parker. He realized that this was before the death of Peter's Uncle Ben. Meanwhile, Spider-Man found himself in a frozen wilderness as a feral Logan was hunted by Dog. They were then transported to Mojoworld; Mojo had been using Czar and Big Murder to arrange the entire list of shenanigans.[513] Wolverine became overcome with an uncontrollable anger; however, he did not enter a berserker rage, but instead became something far worse. After previously using the Phoenix gun and being resurrected by Spider-Man, the Phoenix Force had stayed within him, and as time passed it grew until Wolverine became the new Dark Phoenix.[514]

Fortunately Spider-Man managed to calm him down, and after Logan told the Phoenix Force to go away, the Phoenix Force seemed to leave him, the duo was then sent back to the American Midwest in the time of the cowboys. Peter fell in love with a woman named Sara Bailey, whom had also been transported through time by the diamonds, while Logan became the chief of a Native American tribe. Any diamonds they found appeared to be inert. The Time Variance Authority found them and set the duo and Sara back into their proper point in the timeline with their memories intact except for Sara who didn't retain any memory from this adventure, which left Spider-Man heartbroken.[13]

Wolverine Goes to Hell[]

After this adventure with Spider-Man, Logan visited John Wraith, who survived Creed's previous attack,[119] and was now a pastor. A few weeks later, a child was found dead with three claw marks. Wraith found Logan but he was attacked by him and discovered that his friend's body had been possessed by a demon, this “Hellverine” was going on a rampage against people Logan cared about and Wraith was one of his target. After stabbing Wraith and covering his body with insects, he burned Wraith's church with the congregation still inside before moving to its next target. Meanwhile Wolverine's soul was sent to Hell by the Red Right Hand with the help of Mystique where he was about to be tortured for eternity.[515][516] In Hell, Logan met Satan and was forced to battle several of his deceased foes and most notably what appeared to be Sabretooth.[517] Meanwhile, Hellverine was going around trying to kill the people Logan cared about such as Amiko, Yukio, and X-23[517] while the Red Right Hand's army killed the Silver Samurai and tried to kill Maverick. At the same time, the Mongrels also confronted Tyger Tiger and destroyed everything dear to Logan in Madripoor,[518] they then tried to kill Melita who was saved by Mystique.[519] Melita discovered that Mystique betrayed the Red Right Hand after she learned what the criminal organization intended to do to Logan if he escaped from Hell, the duo then teamed up with Ghost Rider and Daimon Hellstrom in order to free Logan's soul from Hell.

Back in Hell, Logan discovered that the Silver Samurai had been killed by the Red Right Hand and that the Criminal Organization was after everybody Logan cared about, Logan also discovered that Mariko had been condemned to Hell because of her past actions as the head of Yashida Family. Mariko was then forced by Satan to torture Logan in order to break his spirit while Hellverine managed to get past the X-Men's defense and infiltrated Utopia, in order to burn Logan's belongings and killed Kitty Pryde but he was soon confronted by Colossus.[518]

In Hell, after being tortured by Mariko, Logan was crucified on a cross by Satan and met his old friend Puck, who told him to not give up and to keep fighting as all the demons of Hell was watching him. After hearing those words, Logan was able to free himself and started to fight several demons and then Satan himself. On Utopia, Colossus alongside Kitty, Iceman and Angel tried to fight Hellverine, but they were overwhelmed by the demon's power but as Colossus was about to get killed, Melita, Mystique, the Ghost Rider, and Hellstrom captured Hellverine, took him to a church and began the ritual to bring Logan's soul back to his body. In Hell, Logan was able to make Satan bleed which created a riot in Hell and allowed him to crucify the Devil with his broken bone claws, he then met Thomas Logan (his biological father), who told him he was proud of him. Logan fought "Sabretooth" once again, and defeated him, he then recovered Satan's sword, "Soulcutter", making him the new King of Hell. With the sword in his possession, Logan was approached once again by Thomas Logan and quickly understood that his father had been lying all along, he only wanted to use him in order to rule in Hell. Logan then decided to throw the sword to the demons and punched Thomas Logan in the face, Logan and Puck then decided to escape from Hell.

During their ascension, Logan tried to free Mariko but she refused saying that there was nothing left for her on Earth, she then bid him farewell and told him to remember her as she was before her death and not how he saw her in Hell. Logan and Puck then continued their ascension but along the way Puck fell, but told Logan to keep going. Thanks to his actions and the Hellstrom's ritual, Logan managed to escape from Hell while Puck recovered "Soulcutter" making him the new King of Hell.[516]

But the demons were still present inside his mind, and as result his body was still under the control of Hellverine. Hellverine almost killed Magneto, Cyclops, Namor and the rest of the X-Men while Logan was still trying to fight against the demons inside his mind. It took the help of his own memories, Melita, the X-Men, a subconscious projection of Nightcrawler and what appeared to be a vivid memory of Jean as the White Phoenix to burn the demons from his mind once and for all while telling him to forget revenge and live. Finally free, Logan didn't listen to what Kurt and Jean told him, and planned to get revenge on Mystique and the Red Right Hand for sending him to Hell.[520]

Facing the Red Right Hand and the Mongrels[]

Wolverine quickly found Mystique, who tried to talk Logan down in order to explain to him the plan of the Red Right Hand by respect for his friendship with Kurt, but having enough of her after all the lies she told him in the past and sending him to Hell, he decided to kill her. During their fight, the duo was confronted by Lord Deathstrike who had been hired by the Red Right Hand to kill Mystique in case she would reveal the next phase of their plan, however Lord Deathstrike was defeated by both Mystique and Wolverine and escaped. Maverick then called Logan to tell him that he found the location of the Red Right Hand's base, Wolverine then resumed his fight with Mystique and killed her. He then headed to the Red Right Hand's base but unknown to him, Mystique's body was recovered shortly after and sold at auction to The Hand resulting in her resurrection some time later.[521]

Wolverine then invaded the Red Right Hand's base, where he was confronted by the Mongrels.[44] Despite what they did to his friends, he gave each one of them a chance to surrender peacefully but the Mongrels attacked him on sight and tried to kill him. As a result Logan killed most of them,[44][95][522] while the others killed themselves[180] and after defeating the leader of the Mongrels, Gunhawk, Logan confronted the members of the Red Right Hand.[522] To his surprise, the members of the Red Right Hand already killed themselves, leaving Wolverine with only a message: the Mongrels were his children, this revelation and the fact that he killed his own children devastated Logan.[107]

Logan then took the bodies of his children and buried them next to their mothers, the last one was William Downing whose mother was Dolores Downing. After burying William, Logan went to a bar and got himself drunk. When Logan left the bar he was attacked by Daken who told him he helped the Red Right Hand in what they did which made Logan enraged but he was then surprised by the appearance of Dog and Thomas Logan who started to laugh at him. It was seemingly an illusion or a vision as he was awakened by someone who wanted to steal from him. Later he called Melita Garner and told her to tell everyone not to look for him and to let him go, after that he started to climb a mountain and throwing himself off it many times over as a punishment for what he did.[523]

After a while, he started to move with a pack of wolves and whenever the pack was hunting, Logan couldn't kill the prey as he remembered how he killed his own children. One day, the pack was attacked and the youngs were taken, the old were killed, and Logan was shot in the head, however, his healing factor saved him. Logan tracked the attackers, killed them and freed his pack. Logan found who took his pack and that they were using the wolves to fight children for sport. Logan freed the children and returned them to their parents. Logan was confused afterwards knowing that if he hadn't killed his own children, he wouldn't have saved those children. In the middle of this, Melita found him and with the help of his friends convinced him to return.[523]

Unknown to Logan during this tragedy, Daken worked with the Red Right Hand for years[95][524] and he helped them with their plans to send Wolverine's soul to Hell but more importantly he was the one who found and gathered all of Logan's children. He then gave them to the Red Right Hand and convinced the criminal organization to use them against Logan. Daken's goal was to make sure that his father would kill his own children in order to hurt him in the worst way possible.[107] Later on, after he buried his children Wolverine had a vision showing him how Daken had been involved in the Red Right Hand's horrific plot.[523]

Schism[]

When the return of Kid Omega set off a new wave of anti-Mutant sentiment,[525] Wolverine and Cyclops steadily grew divided. Wolverine wished to hand Quire over to Captain America, while Cyclops wished to deal with him within the mutant community.[525] When a new Hellfire Club attacked and incapacitated the X-Men at the opening of a Mutant History Museum Oya, whom Wolverine had taken a liking to, was the last one standing. As Logan tried to convince Idie to stay hidden, Cyclops pressured her to act leading to Idie killing a dozen men. Logan was enraged and blamed Cyclops.[526]

Eventually it got worse when Wolverine saw that the idea of Cyclops raising and training the teenage mutants as soldiers were only going to get them killed and after demolishing a Sentinel that was sent to destroy Utopia, Wolverine and a number of X-Men quit the team and left with a number of the teenage mutants to return to their former home in New York with it clear that Cyclops has clearly crossed the line with his actions.[527]

Regenesis[]

In order to start the new Jean Grey School for Higher Learning, Logan needed to retrieve all the fortune that he had amassed over the years, unfortunately his money had been stolen.[528] With the help of Gorilla-Man, Master Po, Yuen Yee and Fat Cobra, Logan managed to retrieve his money and was able to open his school.[529] He also let Fat Cobra took his place as the new Black Dragon.[14]

On its first day, the school was assaulted by the new Hellfire Club, whom had been a major force in causing the Schism of the X-Men.[530] Wolverine made it clear that he didn't want to lose any of the kids and fought as hard as he could against several Frankenstein monsters, whom Iceman defeated by making Ice clones of himself. Then, the Hellfire Club sent a spawn of the original Krakoa to destroy the school.[531] Kid Omega who wanted to prove himself to Broo, Idie and Kid Gladiator who told him they never heard of him, reasoned with Krakoa who then joined Wolverine's X-Men.

Wolverine, along the School's staff and students, then confronted the Hellfire Club and he made clear to them to stay away from his school. As the Hellfire Club members were leaving, Krakoa almost attacked them but Logan stopped him as he had a better idea on how to deal with them. The next day Matt Murdock told Kade Kilgore that he was being sued by Wolverine for the sum of 879 million dollars for the damages he had done to the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning and if he didn't pay, Wolverine and the School would take control of his company. As the school was being rebuilt, Logan was informed that Krakoa was glad they allowed him to stay and Logan found it good to have a school ground that could fight back.[532]

After the events of the Dark Angel Saga, both Warren and the young Evan were admitted to the school as new students.[533][534] Logan on his own continued to juggle between his life as a Headmaster and as a member of X-Force in order to protect his school.[534]

The Return of Sabretooth[]

After hearing the news that Sabretooth was alive and that he kidnapped Dagger in order to force Cloak to open the Darkforce dimension and free Romulus, Wolverine decided to investigate. During his investigation, Logan discovered that the Sabretooth he beheaded wasn’t the real deal but just a clone created by Romulus, but as soon as Logan learned the truth, he was attacked by the real Victor Creed and several clones of him.[535]

After surviving his encounter with Sabretooth and his clones, Logan met a mysterious redhead woman named Remus who claimed to be Romulus' sister, Logan also learned that Romulus lied to him, there never was any Lupine’s race, as Remus confirmed it was just a bunch of lies. After several encounters with Romulus, Wolverine managed to rescue Dagger and tracked Romulus to his fortress in Italy where he discovered that his foe had gotten his bones laced with adamantium, with 4 adamantium claws implanted in each of his forearms.[536]

During their fight, Romulus claimed that the Weapon X program was always Logan's idea, but Logan not believing another one of Romulus' lies, managed to defeat him and he was imprisoned at the Raft while Sabretooth escaped.[537]

After defeating Romulus, Wolverine discovered that Seraph was alive and was working with both Cassie Lathrop and Lynx as part of a team called the Seraph's Angels, Seraph then told Logan that Sabretooth resurfaced in Japan where he was working alongside a revived Mystique with the Japanese branch of The Hand and its new leader Azuma Gōda.[538] After hearing the news, Logan quickly traveled to Japan and was ambushed by the Hand and later by Sabretooth.[539] While here, he discovered that Yukio's spine was severed after she was attacked by Hellverine and that Amiko was now dating the illegitimate son of Kenuichio Harada: Shingen Harada II. Afterwards, while he was tracking Sabretooth, Wolverine was drugged by the Mind Ninjas and forced to relive the death of the Mongrels, but Logan managed to break free by letting his berserker side out, and as a result, he killed all the Mind Ninjas. Unfortunately, Mystique took advantage of his berserk state by pretending to be Yukio and tricking him into sleeping with her, then sent the photos she took of their tryst to Melita, who promptly broke up with him heartbroken and refused to answer his calls due to not knowing the true context.[540] However, despite the appearances Creed betrayed Azuma Gōda and left him to be killed by Wolverine in order to give Logan the illusion that he won. In reality, Sabretooth went to a meeting of all East Asia's greatest crime syndicates and killed all the representatives, declaring himself the invisible King of all Asia with at his side Mystique, Lord Deathstrike, and Shingen Harada a.k.a the new Silver Samurai. Before leaving Japan, Logan teamed up with Amiko and they stopped a bank robbery together.[541]

Shortly after, Sabretooth organized a birthday party in Madripoor and invited most of Wolverine foes, thanks to Maverick’s help Logan discovered the location of this party and beat everyone up and wished to Victor a "Happy Birthday."[14]

Some time later Wolverine returned to Japan and was confronted by the new Silver Samurai sent by Sabretooth, Logan was able to defeat him and cut one of his hand off.[542]

The End of X-Force[]

After the events of the Dark Angel saga, the resurrected Angel and the young Evan were sent to the Jean Grey School and the Nightcrawler from the Age Of Apocalypse universe decided to stay with the X-Force team in order to track the Iceman of his reality who fled to our reality and make him pay for his betrayal.[533]

Shortly after, Fantomex was captured by the Captain Britain Corps and sent to the Otherworld to be trialed for the crimes he committed in the past under Weapon Plus order. Psylocke was also teleported to the Otherworld by Brian Braddock and Jamie Braddock because they needed her help to access the Tower of the Omniverse and stopped the war that was ravaging Otherworld.[543] After hearing the news from Ultimaton, the X-Force team managed to go to the Otherworld thanks to Gateway and put an end to this war.[544]

It was later discovered that the true antagonist was an older version of Jamie Braddock and in order to stop him, Psylocke took possession of Brian's body and used it to snap the younger Jamie's neck erasing his older version in the process and putting an end to the war.[545] A rift was created as a result between Betsy and Brian, afterwards Betsy and Fantomex started a relationship and decided to take a break from X-Force.[546]

Back in our reality, the X-Force team tracked the Iceman from the Age of Apocalypse universe and Nightcrawler finally had his revenge when he managed to kill him,[546] but unknown to X-Force, at the same time Daken, the Shadow King, Sabretooth, the Skinless Man, Mystique and the Blob from the Age of Apocalypse universe decided to form the new brotherhood of Mutants.[547] Daken and Sabretooth abducted the young Evan while the rest of the Brotherhood hired the White Sky criminal organization to create three clones of Omega Red and to give them fake memories in order to use them against X-Force.[548] The goal of Daken and the Brotherhood was to torture Evan long enough for him to become the new Apocalypse, then to use the Shadow King to mess with his mind in order to force Evan to destroy the Jean Grey School, to kill all the students, to kill all of Logan's friends and then blamed X-Force for everything.[549]

Shortly after Fantomex was captured by Mystique and then tortured and killed by the Skinless Man in front of Evan's eyes and to make sure the X-Force team couldn't stop their plans, the Brotherhood hacked Ultimaton and used him to kill Gateway and then detonated him to kill the X-Force team.[550] Thanks to Psylocke, X-Force managed to survive and went to the future where they met their older counterparts and discovered the truth about the Brotherhood’s plan and what needed to be done.[551][552] Back to the present, the team prepared themselves to attack the Brotherhood's stronghold to free Evan while Daken and Sabretooth were still torturing him both mentally and physically in order to have him unleashed the power of Apocalypse.[553]

During the assault, Nightcrawler killed Blob and then after being duped by Mystique he betrayed the team which resulted in Wolverine being tortured and almost killed by Daken.[554][555]

The X-Force team managed to stop the rest of the Brotherhood and to punish him for his betrayal, Nightcrawler was fatally wounded by EVA. Wolverine managed to escape and knew that he had to kill Daken after what his older self revealed to him when he was in the future: "He'll kill the students if you let him live".[552] To protect his students, Logan decided to kill Daken by drowning him in a puddle of water.[549]

After killing his son, Sabretooth appeared and revealed that all of what happened was his plan all along that he wanted to hurt Logan in the worst way possible, an angry Evan almost killed Sabretooth as a result but Logan told him to let him go, revenge would only lead him to a path of destruction just like what happened here.[549] Shortly after E.V.A managed to create three clones of Fantomex thanks to White Sky technology, but after those events the team was disbanded.[552]

Avengers vs. X-Men[]

When Nova arrived on Earth with a warning, the Avengers discovered that the Phoenix Force was heading on a destructive path towards Earth. Captain America turned to Wolverine for advice. Wolverine informed him of Hope Summers' connection with the Phoenix, and the stand that Cyclops and his X-Men team would take on this matter, using the cosmic energy that comes with the destructive power of the Phoenix to save mutantkind from extinction. Captain America asked if the Jean Grey School would side with him, but Logan insisted that he had founded the school to keep the kids out of fights.[556]

When Captain America called on the Avengers to invade Utopia, Wolverine was there alongside them. While the X-Men and the Avengers fought for the control of the mutant nation Utopia, Wolverine found Hope, and was going to fulfill his promise of killing her. But Hope, using the powers of the Phoenix, was able to escape, burning Logan's skin and muscles.

Wolverine recovered and went with Captain America to the Savage Land looking for Hope, but Captain America, thinking that Logan was a liability, asked him to stay in the Quinjet while they searched, punching him in the face and prompting a vicious fight between them that was resolved thanks to Giant-Man who pushed Wolverine out of the plane, making him fall in the middle of the North Pole.[557] Wolverine was tracked down by Hope who offered him a truce if he could help her go to the Moon in order to confront the Phoenix but in case she lost control she wanted Wolverine to be there to kill her. Wolverine agreed but betrayed her by calling the Avengers who showed up on the Moon to capture her. The X-Men arrived shortly after but the fighting was cut short by the arrival of the Phoenix.

As the Phoenix descended on the Moon and was about to possess Hope, she released a huge amount of energy, knocking everyone out. Hope said she wasn't ready, it was too much power for her, that she couldn't control it and she begged Logan to kill her. Seeing no other way Iron Man used a special suit to try to destroy the Phoenix but he only managed to splinter it, and it took the five other X-Men present as hosts: Namor, Cyclops, Emma Frost, Magik and Colossus.[558] The Phoenix-possessed X-Men started changing the world into a better place for living, but knowing that Phoenix's ultimately destructive nature would bring chaos, Steve and the Avengers tried to get Hope from Utopia in order to use her knowledge about the Phoenix against it. After the Scarlet Witch helped them against the X-Men (previously having visions of the Phoenix destroying Earth), Cyclops decided to hunt down every Avenger. The Thunderer offered the Avengers to hide in K'un-Lun, as well as to train Hope to face the Phoenix, because of his past experience with the Phoenix Host and Iron Fist Fongji, and the prophecy of the Phoenix bringing chaos to Earth. Before the entire Avengers could teleport to K'un-Lun, Namor attacked where they were hiding, Wakanda, along a full army of Atlanteans. After defeating Namor with the price of the partial destruction of Wakanda, the Avengers teleported to K'un-Lun, in order to help Hope to train to face the Phoenix.

The Avengers were attacked by Cyclops who now possessed half of the Phoenix Force, he made quick work of anyone that opposed him but was defeated by Hope who in an act of desperation combined the powers of the Iron Fist, Scarlet Witch's chaos magic and Shao-Lao's flames to teleport Cyclops to the Moon. The Avengers then teamed up with several X-Men who had realized that Cyclops and Emma had completely lost control. Together they attacked Cyclops and Emma and gained the upper hand until Cyclops was forced to take the final piece of the Phoenix Force from Emma, making him the sole host. Unfortunately the complete Phoenix Force proved to be too much for him and after Scott killed Professor Xavier, it finally turned him into the Dark Phoenix.[559]

The Avengers fought Cyclops all around the world with the help of the X-Men and Nova, as well as trying to contain the chaos the gigantic force produced around Earth, but who finally managed to defeat him were Scarlet Witch and Hope, the Phoenix left Scott and possessed Hope. Thanks to the K'un-Lun training, Hope managed to control the Phoenix Force and repaired all the damage Scott caused on the planet. Finally, using the powers of the Scarlet Witch to manipulate reality, Hope and the Scarlet Witch destroyed together the Phoenix Force with a final blast of energy which caused millions of people around Earth to manifest mutant powers. Cyclops was finally incarcerated, and Steve accepted the Avengers should have done more to help mutants, and not allowed the world to hate them. As a result, he started planning a new team of Avengers in hopes of unifying mutant and humankind.[560]

After the war with the X-Men and End Times, the Avengers team that Wolverine was part of was disbanded,[561] but both Captain America and Iron Man asked him to join the new main Avengers team and the new Avengers Unity Division, which he accepted.[562][563]

Uncanny Avengers[]

After giving an eulogy at Charles Xavier's funeral, Wolverine tracked Sunfire in Japan in order to recruit him for the new Avengers Unity division team but at the same time a clone of the original Red Skull awoken and stole Professor Xavier's brain and used it as his own to create a world of hate[564] forcing Wolverine and the Avengers to intervene. Logan managed to cut the Red Skull's hand but was severely injured by a mind controlled Thor, fortunately his healing factor saved him but the Red Skull managed to escape.[565]

Shortly after the Apocalypse Twins made their appearance and started to create tensions in the Unity team by revealing that Logan’s X-Force team killed a child Apocalypse, angering Captain America and creating a rift between them.[566]

Shortly after while looking for clues about the Apocalypse twins, Wolverine was confronted by a resurrected Daken who defeated him thanks to his new powers and crucified him.[567] Logan was rescued by Rogue and Sunfire and told them to go after the Scarlet Witch thinking she was working with the twins.[568]

Logan managed to heal and fought against Daken again and learned the truth about Wanda’s intentions but despite trying to warn Rogue to not kill the Scarlet Witch because it would doom the earth, it was too late, Rogue killed Wanda and she was then killed by the Grim Reaper. Angry about what happened Logan quickly dispatched Daken but in the end he was captured by the Apocalypse Twins and sent to Planet X while the earth was destroyed by Exitar.[569]

In here, Wolverine was tortured during 8 years by Daken[570] until Thor managed to free him, once free Logan made quick work of Daken but didn’t kill him since he didn’t want to relieve the nightmares he had after the first time he killed him.[571] Kang decided that the best course of action was to send the Avengers' consciousnesses back in time, Logan agreed with the plan but warned him to send them back before Rogue’s death or he would sabotage the whole thing.[571] Once done, the Apocalypse twins were defeated, and despite Kang’s betrayal, the Earth was ultimately saved.[572]

Professor Logan[]

On top of being a member of the Avengers Unity Division, Logan was still the headmaster of the Jean Grey School and continued the education of his students. After the conflict between the X-Men and the Avengers, Kade Kilgore started his own school to rival the Jean Grey School: The Hellfire Academy.[573] After dealing with the Frankenstein Monster menace and the Murder Circus,[574] Ororo Munroe joined the Jean Grey school as a teacher and began a relationship with Logan.[575]

To train the students to survive, Wolverine decided to send them on a trip to the Savage Land, in here he met his long lost half-brother: Dog Logan.[576] Now armed with time diamonds and motivated by his future self, Dog tried to prove that he was a better Logan, a better teacher and a better mentor than Wolverine.[12] In the end he failed and was afterwards recruited by the Hellfire Academy after killing his future self.[577] Soon after, the Hellfire Academy and the Jean Grey School clashed, Logan and his school proved their superiority and defeated Kade and his Hellfire Academy but unfortunately both Kade Kilgore and Dog Logan were able to escape.[578]

Around that time a dying Beast, afraid of what Cyclops was doing with his revolution decided to go back in time and snatched the original X-Men in order to confront Scott with his younger self.[579] After the younger Beast helped the current Beast survived his latest mutation, Wolverine learned the news and he wanted them to go back to their time immediately, but the original X-Men refused except for the younger Angel who decided as a result to leave the Jean Grey School for the Cyclops' School.[580]

Logan decided to accept the rest of them as students in his school and let them train under Kitty’s leadership for a while.[581] Unfortunately Mystique with the help of Sabretooth and Lady Mastermind reformed the Brotherhood to commit several heists, Lady Mastermind then used her illusions to incriminate the original X-Men.[582]

Logan decided to go to Madripoor with the original X-Men and with the help of the Avengers Unity Division they were able to put an end to Mystique and Sabretooth plans.[583] After the events of the Battle of the Atom crossover both the original X-Men and Kitty left the Jean Grey School and joined Cyclops’ school.

The Return of Dr. Rot and of the Dreaming Maiden[]

After several reports of murders where the victims had their brains removed, Logan became one of the main suspect, it also didn't help that since Logan's last encounter with Dr. Rot he suffered from several episodes of blackout where he didn't remember what he did. To get some answers, Logan decided to return to the Dunwich Sanatorium, in here he discovered many monstrosities created by Dr. Rot, most notably some shapeshifting monsters who took the appearances of people he knew and a diary containing informations about Dr. Rot.[584]

Following the clues, Logan managed to find Dr. Rot but thanks to one of the old Weapon X trigger phrase that Rot discovered the last time he experimented on Logan, he managed to have Logan under his control again by saying: "Dream a dream of pretty prey and blood red as rage," he then resumed his experiments on Logan's brain.[585]

Melita who recognized Dr. Rot modus operandi in those murders, helped the Police and led them to Dr. Rot,[586] in here she was confronted by a mind controlled Logan, who almost killed her. Fortunately Logan managed to break Rot's hold on him by reversing the trigger phrase and breaking it. When he finally found Dr. Rot, he learned that the Weapon X program implanted many more trigger phrases inside his head but also that those shapeshifting monsters he fought were actually some of his mapped memories extracted from his brain and made flesh. After this revelation, Logan killed Dr. Rot and burned his place. Unfortunately because of Dr. Rot's experiments on his brain, Logan lost several memories and most notably he didn't remember who Melita was. Elsewhere Dr. Rot managed to come back to life thanks to Nurse Fester and decided to find everything he could about the Weapon X program.[587]

Shortly after Melita decided to help Logan remembered some of his lost memories but their session was interrupted by Vanessa Baker who told him that the Dreaming Maiden that Logan hid in 1934-1935, started dreaming again, attracting the attention of the Covenant and Elsa Bloodstone.[588] After fighting several members of the Covenant such as Murderous Lion and Jefferson Chambers and teaming up with Seraph's angels Logan finally found the Dreaming Maiden again.[589]

Unfortunately, in the ensuing battle between Wolverine, Seraph's Angels, and another member of the Covenant named Menace the statue of the Dreaming Maiden was decapitated.[50] After placing the statue of the Dreaming Maiden in the garden of the Jean Grey School, Logan resumed his sessions with Melita in order to remember who she was.[50]

Death and Return[]

Killable[]

Shortly after, during a S.H.I.E.L.D. rescue mission, Wolverine was infected with a Microverse virus that shut down his healing factor.[590] Losing his healing factor proved to be a shock to Logan but Nick Fury Jr. warned him that the sentient virus from the Microverse that removed his healing factor was still present and was spreading all over the world.

The virus was conducting several strikes all over the world against villains who were able to control viruses, and the last viral controller left was The Host. Because she couldn't be killed, she was detained in Wakanda and Nick Fury Jr. feared that the reason she was arrested was because T’Challa was infected and was now controlled by the Microverse virus.[591]

Logan went to Wakanda to check the situation here and to distract T'Challa while Ororo Munroe, Nick Fury Jr. and Victoria Von Frankenstein retrieved the Host. While here a fight broke between Wolverine and Black Panther, both men wanted to test each other to see if they were infected, and to trick the virus into thinking they had a good reason to fight. Once the misunderstanding was resolved and the crisis averted, S.H.I.E.L.D. took The Host into custody and began using her to destroy the Microverse virus. While Logan was in Wakanda, Sabretooth sent Mystique to the Jean Grey School to steal one of Logan's honor sword and to leave him a map with some coordinates, those coordinates would lead Logan to the place he was born: The Howlett Estate.[592]

After checking that the students were safe, Logan and Kitty headed to the Howlett Estate to face Sabretooth and his army. Before they could reach their destination, they were attacked by Batroc the Leaper who was interested in the 10 million bounty Sabretooth put on Logan's head, and despite not having any healing factor Logan was able to defeat him. On the way to the Estate, they were attacked again but this time by Fiber, who didn't want to kill Logan but just hurt him.[593] After Logan and Kitty arrived at the Estate, they discovered that it had been transformed into a mall. Despite this change the place reminded Logan of his childhood’s memories, but shortly after they arrived Logan and Kitty were attacked by the Hand, Lord Deathstrike, the Silver Samurai and Mystique.[594]

Wolverine was severely injured by all these attacks and because of Fiber’s previous attack each wounds inflicted to him made his body flinched, his senses were also affected by the Hand’s magic and as a result Logan was acting more and more erratic. Seeing no other way out and welcoming his end with open arms, Logan asked to see Sabretooth one last time.[595]

Sabretooth finally appeared holding Logan's honor sword, Logan tried to fight him but Creed beat him to a pulp but he didn't kill him because letting him live powerless and weak was in Sabretooth's mind a fate much worse than death for Logan. At the same time, thanks to the Host, the Microverse virus was forced to leave every hosts it possessed in the world and was almost destroyed. While the defeated Wolverine was lying on the floor broken physically and mentally, the Microverse virus took possession of a security guard nearby and begged Logan to save it, that it could reactivated his healing factor but Logan refused and the virus died as a result. Logan then broke his honor sword and told the X-Men that the Wolverine was dead.[596]

After this defeat, Logan started to prepare himself to face Sabretooth again and get his healing factor back. Shortly after an encounter with the Superior Spider-Man, Otto created the Ablation Armor for Logan in order for him to protect himself.[597] Now in possession of this armor, Logan left the Jean Grey School (though he remained the leader of the X-Men) and the main Avengers team (though he remained with the Unity Division), and started working for a businessman's squad of mercenaries.[598]

In reality, however, Wolverine was sent to work for the Offer by the S.H.I.E.L.D. in order to trace Sabretooth's whereabouts by killing one of their agents, Agent Monkton.[598][599] With MI13, he eventually tracked Sabretooth down in Madripoor and tried to retrieve an object that Sabretooth was going to use to alter reality, but the mission was a failure and as a result, Pinch's daughter was kidnapped.[600][601]

Before facing Sabretooth, Wolverine decided to rediscover his martial arts by training with Iron Fist and Shang-Chi and the three of them went to Itsukushima, where they battled several ninjas from the Hand and had an encounter with the entity Death. Logan also encountered Rose's soul and was forgiven by the latter for killing her years ago.[602] With the help of Thor, the X-Men, Damage Control, and S.H.I.E.L.D., Logan was able to defeat Sabretooth and recovered Pinch's daughter.[603]

Despite the loss of his healing factor Logan was still helping the Avengers on several occasions most notably during their battle against the Superior Venom[604] and during their investigation of the Superior Spider-Man.[605] Although Captain America decided to remove him from the main Avengers team, fearing for Logan’s own health and safety.[606] Shortly after dealing with Kang and the Apocalypse Twins, he also quit the Avengers Unity division.[607]

After dealing with some time traveling X-Men and the Future Brotherhood,[608] he tried to make peace with Cyclops after battling some sentinels[609] and he finally succeeded in reforming Quentin Quire.[610]

Around that time while looking for a runaway student he met and teamed up for the first time with the new Miss Marvel,[611] he also teamed up with Deadpool and Captain America in order to stop Butler's plans,[612] he helped the X-Men stopped Azrael's plans and witnessed the return of Nightcrawler,[613] and fought against an army of Wendigo.[614]

Unfortunately, after some time travel adventures,[615] Quentin Quire left his school for a while and a rift was created between the two of them.[616]

Temporary Death[]

Logan had a reunion with Mister Fantastic, who explained to him that his entire physical structure is based on the fact that he could heal himself and that now only using his claws could be fatal. He assured him he could reactivate his healing factor but he needed time and asked him not to fight until he could figure it out. Traveling to an island in British Columbia, Canada, Wolverine was attacked again and again by A.I.M. agents, ninjas and other mercs and assassins who came for a bounty in his head. They took most of each other out competing for the bounty and he killed the rest. Logan then returned to the mainland and left a note with a bartender for whomever else came looking for him before heading back to the island. Next came Nuke and several of his mercenaries. One of them was sent to the port, which was set to explode. Wolverine sunk the boat from below and killed the other mercenaries as they tried to escape to the coast, leaving only Nuke alive. Nuke threw Logan against some rocks but he head-butted Nuke with his adamantium skull until he was defeated, he told Nuke to tell everyone that he was the last one he let live and demanded him who put out the contract. Nuke revealed that the contract was to bring him alive and that it was put by the new queen of Madripoor: Viper.[617]

After this revelation, Wolverine traveled there and disguised himself as an arms dealer and offered to sell to one of Viper’s men an Iron Man helmet, demanding to see Viper herself for the deal, which he agreed. Viper saw through Logan's disguise and sent her guards against him, but he defeated them with little effort. He demanded answers and she revealed that a client came to her for various works and that she subcontracted the word out for him. She would tell him who the client was if Logan could beat her “pet”: Sabretooth, who was chained and captured. He explained that she got him out of prison and injected him with her venom, only getting the antidote if he obeyed. She claimed that she wanted one to die and that only the victor if their fight would get what he wanted. Sabretooth attacked Wolverine and slashed his eye, Logan set the helmet to explode and threw it to Creed but the explosion didn't stop him. However, Lady Deathstrike attacked and impaled Sabretooth, allowing Viper to escape, but Logan stopped Deathstrike from killing Sabretooth, claiming that "when it happens, it's not going to happen this way," Yuriko reluctantly let him go. She explained that she didn't come to capture him but that the bounty extended to her and others like them and she barely escaped from Japan from another who took the contract: Lord Ogun. She tracked Logan there in order for them to work together and get to the bottom of it. However, she noticed that his eye didn't regrow and realized the loss of his healing factor and claimed that he can’t help her but decided to exchange his life for her own. However, Kitty arrived and phased her arm through Deathstrike’s chest.[618]

Kitty threatened Yuriko with un-phasing, but Deathstrike tried to attack her and Kitty un-phased her hand and broke Deathstrike’s right hand and told her to leave. Wolverine passed out due to his wounds, but Kitty injected him with a Regen Serum, which healed him. They traveled to Japan to find Ogun. In Tokyo, Logan considered that it may never stopped until he died and contemplated ending it now but ultimately decided to live out the remainder of his life, however short it turned out to be. Kitty kissed him until he stopped her, she then taunted him on what happened to Jean, Mariko and Rose. Logan then realized that Kitty was possessed by Ogun, his old master revealed that Kitty came looking for Logan in Japan and he decided to possess her. He offered to release her if Logan surrendered but Logan refused and they fought. Ogun threw him into a house, where Logan took a samurai armor and some swords and battled Ogun, who started losing control of Kitty's body as she was fighting him and Logan taunted him that he couldn’t win against two of his students at the same time, as a result Kitty was able to force Ogun's spirit out of her body. Kitty insisted that Logan went after Ogun’s new body and told him she heard the name of who put the contract while Ogun was in her head: Abraham Cornelius. Wolverine tracked Ogun to a factory and found the corpse of Cyber, which was recuperated by Ogun, melting in acid. Ogun revealed that Cornelius was paying great money for Cyber's skin, some swords and other articles. Wolverine assumed he was looking for his adamantium skeleton and Ogun told him where Cornelius was, Paradise Valley in Nevada. Claiming he didn't know more, he threatened Logan with stepping to the acid and killing his vessel but promised to Logan he would find another vessel and leave his current one unharmed if Logan simply let him go. Before departing Ogun also offered to Wolverine more Regen Serum but Logan claimed he was done living forever and told him to warn Cornelius that he was coming for him.[619]

Wolverine then traveled to Cornelius' facility in Paradise Valley. Using improvised fake claws, he killed the guards and broke into his lab, where he witnessed Cornelius experimenting on innocent people. He demanded to know what he was doing and Cornelius claimed that he was "getting it right," claiming that he deserved to be known for something other than helping to make a killer unkillable. Cornelius claimed that he was responsible for what Logan was and that his test subjects were conditioned to do whatever they were told to do, revealing that all they needed was the adamantium. He told him that he had enough adamantium and that what he needed was his healing factor for the subjects to survive, the Regen Serum being his attempt to recreate it. Cornelius told him that he could save his test subjects by giving him his healing factor, but Logan made a cut in his hand and let it bleed, showing Cornelius the loss of his healing factor. Cornelius then ordered a volunteer of his program, Sharp, who was made into a fighting machine, to kill Logan. During the fight, Cornelius activated his machines on the test subjects and taunted Logan, claiming that he was an animal and that Sharp was perfect; however, Logan tricked Sharp into breaking the glass protecting Cornelius, who was hurt by a shard of glass, Logan then knocked out Sharp and crushed his armor, though Cornelius activated the adamantium merging process and escaped.

Wolverine unleashed his claws to slash the batch of liquid adamantium before it was injected and the metal covered his entire body in the process. He injected the subjects with the Regen Serum left around and went after Cornelius before the adamantium hardened. A soldier tried to help Cornelius escaped but he ran away when Logan arrived. Wolverine then killed Cornelius as he asked him what he ever did beside killing, Logan then reflected on his life and said: "Enough." Wolverine then died from suffocation from the hardening adamantium, kneeling in the sunset,[620] leaving Storm in charge of the X-Men and the team heartbroken.

After the facility exploded,[621] Logan's petrified body was left in its ruins, where it was located by Shogun, Skel, Neuro, Endo, and Junk, along with the "Wolverines." They planned to use Logan's petrified body to find a way to prevent their deaths. However, Mister Sinister took the body with him to his fortress, from where the X-Men later retrieved it.[622]

The X-Men initially placed Logan's body in a cabin hidden in Alberta, with a shrine built by Forge in his honor for people to pay their respects; however, they rapidly decided to find a better way to put him to rest. Kitty Pryde phased Logan's corpse out of the Adamantium casing, and he was given a proper burial in a secret location. The casing remained in Alberta as a memorial,[623] which was later shown to an alternate version of Wolverine by Steve Rogers and Kate Bishop.[624]

Hunt for Wolverine[]

Months following Logan's death, his body was found by Persephone who resurrected him as one of her undead killer.[623] With the reanimated corpse of Logan under her control, Persephone used it to carry out assassinations and other type of dirty jobs all over the world,[625][626] including activating a prototype machine, which killed 343 people in Maybelle, Arizona,[627] as part of Persephone's efforts to extend the reach of her abilities.[628]

Around that time, the Reavers tried to steal Logan's corpse and broke his adamantium casing believing his valuable body was still inside. To their surprise the casing was empty and they were apprehended by the X-Men and Alpha Flight, but one member of the Reavers named Starshine managed to escape and warn Lady Deathstrike that Logan's body wasn't in the adamantium casing, which prompted her to gather a team and to start looking for Logan's missing corpse.

After the battle with the Reavers, Kitty Pryde also discovered that Logan's body had gone missing from his unmarked grave, as a result she rallied numerous superheroes to find him, from the X-Men to his least close associates.[623] Despite finding several leads that connected Wolverine's return to Soteira,[629][625][630][631] their investigation was interrupted when Persephone attacked the X-Mansion and threatened to kill latent mutants around the world if they didn't stop looking into it.[626]

Return[]

Shortly after Persephone decided to dress Logan's reanimated corpse in his old yellow costume in order to impress Dr. Bernard Delacroix;[632] however, something happened with Logan's healing factor,[628] and he came back to life, breaking free from Persephone's control and killing several Soteira soldiers in the process.[632]

Now in control of his body, but without any memories and with his claws burning hot for unknown reasons, Logan started to track a Soteira kill team led by Zagreus. After witnessing the murder of a scientist by one of Zagreus' men, Logan decided to intervene, but was quickly stopped by a reanimated Omega Red and lost consciousness. Logan then saw Persephone on the astral plane and discovered that his missing memories were metaphorically represented by various personas locked within a prison of the mind. Persephone gave him a key to open any cell he wanted before kissing him and telling him that she was the one who brought him back to life. Logan then woke up and met Ana, who told him she needed his help to save her son. Logan agreed to help her and opened a cell in his mind freeing his heroic persona.[632]

Logan then stole a boat and started to track Zagreus and his team, along the way Zagreus sent both a reanimated Daken and the reanimated Omega Red after him. With the help of Ana, Logan managed to defeat them and tracked Zagreus to Persephone's island. At the same time, Jean Grey discovered that Logan was alive.[633]

Thanks to the help of Cypher the X-Men managed to locate Logan on Persephone's island where they were quickly attacked by both Soteira's police forces and the island's citizens. Hearing some screams, Logan decided to investigate and after learning from one of the wounded island's citizen that the X-Men were evil, Logan decided to fight them.[634]

With the help of his X-Force persona, Logan was able to defeat Nightcrawler, and while Jean Grey was distracted by her battle with Soteira forces, he used this confusion to take her down as well, though Iceman intervened and froze Logan to try to reason with him in order to calm him down. Unfortunately Logan didn't listen to Iceman, and seeing no other choices, he opened another cell in his mind and unleashed his berserker persona. As a result his claws started to heat up and Logan cut Iceman in half.[634]

Storm quickly intervened to protect Iceman from Logan and after Persephone warned Kitty that if the X-Men didn't leave she would use Logan to kill all of the persons on her island, Kitty and the X-Men had no choice but to abandon Logan in retreat. Logan was then ambushed by all the island's citizens, who tried to subdue him; however, he managed to take a lot of them down until he fell unconscious thanks to his "hot claws" sapping his energy.[635]

Logan woke up shortly after in an hospital with Ana at his side, she revealed that he did well and that her son was okay, thought it was quickly revealed that Ana was none other than a vessel used by Persephone all along and that she, her son, and all the people on this island died a long time ago and were merely used as reanimated drones by Persephone in an effort to strengthen her abilities. After telling Logan about her powers, she revealed that the X-Men he attacked were in reality his friends, she then told him to follow her brother Zagreus to their space station where he could meet her.[635]

Once on Persephone's space station, Logan discovered that Soteira had gathered a small group of gifted people and that she intended to kill everyone else on Earth in order to resurrect them as drones under her control to help build the perfect society. She also revealed to Logan that she was the one who resurrected him as one of her undead soldiers and he killed for her all around the world, but that somehow Logan's healing factor brought him back to life when he met Delacroix.[628]

She then told him that because of his actions, the world now knew that Wolverine was a monster and that his friends would never trust him nor love him again, but that thanks to her plan he could leave the past behind and start a new life in her future world. Logan refused, and as a result she tried to kill him, though he managed to survive and discovered that Persephone's plan hinged upon her satellite network, which Logan managed to destroy with the help of Soteira members that were having second thoughts about the ethicality of the plan.[628]

Seeing that the Persephone's space station was the only thing that could still threaten the world, Logan decided to destroy it as well, but on his way he was confronted by Zagreus and a kill team who beat him to a pulp. Without any other solution, Logan decided to open all the cells in his mind, except for the berserker cell, and as a result he regained most of his memories and most especially his fighting experience.[628]

Finally whole, Logan easily defeated Zagreus and despite Persephone's threats to forever haunt him as a ghost, he crashed her space station into the Pacific. Logan survived and was rescued by some deep sea fisherman.[628]

Infinity Watch[]

Now back to the land of the livings, Logan decided to head back to the X-Mansion but on the way to the mansion he was summoned by the Fantastic Four to help them against the Endlings and the Griever at the End of All Things.[636] Once done Logan was sent back to earth[637] and met with an older version of himself[638] before finally arriving at the mansion.[628][639]

While here he discovered that the mansion was in ruins, that the X-Men were dead and that Loki was standing alone in here and was blaming him for the events of the recent Infinity Wars. After Logan explained to Loki, that he had nothing to do with all of this, a future version of Wolverine hosting the Phoenix Force appeared and explained to Loki that he was the one that Loki met during the Infinity Wars.

After clearing the misunderstanding, this Phoenix Wolverine gave to Logan a Time Bat and told to both him and Loki to track the new wielder of the time stone: Hector Bautista. The Phoenix Wolverine then went back to the future in order to help King Thor against Doom and die.[639]

Unfortunately, Wolverine and Loki weren't the only ones after Hector, a Chitauri warrior named Warbringer landed on earth and decided to kill Hector and retrieved the time stone. Fortunately, Logan and Loki were able to trick him into leaving the earth but soon after the Fraternity of Raptors appeared and captured Hector.[640]

To track him, Logan and Loki enrolled the help of Bats and together they managed to find the location of Hector who was tortured by the raptors leader: Talonar. Logan and Loki were overwhelmed by the dozens of raptors and as a result Logan was captured but Loki managed to escape and decided to find Gloria Rider (the mother of Talonar) in order to free both Wolverine and Hector.[641]

Wolverine was then sent into a burning chamber in order to be killed but Logan managed to escape and thanks to Bats' help he was able to get his hands on his time bat. The power of the time bat fully regenerated Logan who then defeated all the raptors until he found both Loki and Hector. But after finding them, they were attacked by the Time Variance Authority and then by Warbringer who wanted his revenge after being tricked by Logan and Loki previously.[642]

Warbringer's attack damaged the ship which was about to explode, but after listening to Logan's advice Hector froze time completely to save everyone but he was unable to make it start again. After a while, Hector was able to unfreeze time, and with Talonar’s help Logan, Loki, Hector, Bats and Gloria were able to teleport back to earth while the ship exploded with Warbringer and Logan's time bat still inside.

Back on earth, Logan asked Hector, now calling himself “Overtime,” to help him go back in time in order to save the X-Men but Hector refused and after fighting Logan, he disappeared. Angry after what happened, Logan wanted answers from Loki about what was his plan and about finding a way to save the X-Men. After telling Logan that he foresaw his own death, Loki told him that the X-Men were dead and he needed to move on. Still angry after what happened with Hector and in denial about the X-Men “death,” Logan decided to leave.

In the future, King Thor now all alone after the death of the Phoenix Wolverine against Doom, learned that Logan and Loki were successful in their mission and that the clock has been reset for the Infinity Watch.[643]

This Is Forever[]

Shortly after his cosmic adventure with Loki, Logan went to a bar where he fought against several drunk men until the arrival of the new Black King: Emma Frost. Emma told Logan that Cyclops was alive and she needed his help to protect him, Logan was happy to hear that Scott was alive but he was still shocked by the death of the X-Men and didn't trust Emma so he asked her to leave him alone. Emma decided to mess with Logan's mind and removed all the memories of her from it and implanted a mental suggestion that would lead Logan to find Scott.[644]

Soon after Wolverine found Cyclops and met a younger version of Cable who asked him to protect Scott and to find someone who knew about the future. Logan decided to go see Layla Miller and Jamie Madrox and then went to the Morlocks tunnels in order to find Blindfold. After dispatching O*N*E soldiers and meeting Callisto, Logan found Velocidad who told him the location of Blindfold.[645]

After meeting Blindfold who told him to follow Cable's advice, Logan decided to track Scott in order to protect him, along the way he met Black Widow and the Winter Soldier who discovered that Logan was alive. Cyclops then made a call asking to every surviving X-Man to meet him where it all began in Westchester; however, only the Reavers, the Purifiers, and the Sapien League answered his call, and were about to kill him, when Logan intervened and together they made quick work of their foes. Once the battle was over, Wolverine told Cyclops it was time to get to work.[645]

Wolverine and Cyclops decided to rescue several mutants held prisoners by the O*N*E and the general Calahan, during this rescue mission they discovered that some of them, such as Strong Guy, were used as a new type of sentinels. After rescuing Wolfsbane, Magik, Havok, Mirage and Karma, the team was almost killed by a bomb planted into one of the Madrox dupes also held prisoner by the O*N*E but unfortunately Guido wasn't so lucky and died.[646]

Afterwards thanks to Magik, the team was able to escape and relocated to Harry's Hideaway while Wolverine returned to the ruins of the Xavier's institute and brought back some costumes for the team, Logan decided to wear his classic brown costume again. Now ready, Cyclops created a list of things the X-Men needed to take care of and their first target was Dark Beast.

Shortly after, Wolverine discovered one of Dark Beast's working lab in a warehouse on Long Island, but once here the X-Men were attacked by several Madrox dupes that were captured and experimented on by Dark Beast. After the team made quick work of Dark Beast army, the real Jamie Madrox appeared and revealed that he was also investigating the disappearance of his dupes. Despite the trauma, Jamie decided to reabsorb his dead dupes and discovered the location of Dark Beast.

The team was able to track Dark Beast who revealed that he was now half mutant, half cyborg since his resurrection. The X-Men stopped him and kept him as a prisoner but before they could celebrate their victory they discovered that the Mutant Liberation Front (MLF) was back with Banshee amongst their ranks and that they were led by one of the X-Men own: Hope Summers.[647]

Afterwards Cyclops decided to strike a deal with Valerie Cooper in order to have access to classified informations and intelligence reports which could be useful to the X-Men, at the same time the other X-Men were able to catch Reaper in order to use him to infiltrate Hope's MLF. With the Dark Beast as their prisoner, Cyclops intended to use his skills to help the team, to gain the trust of the X-Men, Dark Beast gave them the location of one of his old teammate: Scrambler. After the X-Men arrived at Scrambler's location, he attacked them and tried to run away, Wolverine decided to pursue him but before he could catch him, Callisto stabbed Logan in his right eye with one of her knife. Fortunately both Callisto and Scrambler were quickly caught by Madrox, Callisto then revealed that she stabbed Logan because she wanted to be the one to make Scrambler pay for what he did.

The X-Men then discovered that Scrambler killed several Morlocks and that Chamber and Shogo were ones of the few survivors. In order to find a new home for the surviving members of the Morlocks, Cyclops struck a deal with Valerie Cooper and in exchange for taking care of an extremist group in Chernayan that stole several S.H.I.E.L.D. and Latverian technologies, the Morlocks were allowed to relocate here and live in peace. After this small victory, Chamber decided to give Shogo to Callisto and joined the X-Men in order to have his revenge on the Marauders but shortly after while the X-Men were celebrating their victory, Captain America appeared and told Cyclops they needed to have a talk.[648]

Captain America warned Cyclops and the X-Men to not trust Valerie Cooper but also that he could help them and after giving them an Avengers card he left. Wolverine and Cyclops decided that it was time to take care of Hope and the MLF as they were going to kill an anti-mutant politician at political rally. After Magik teleported them at the rally, the X-Men made quick work of the MLF while Cyclops decided to confront Hope and Banshee on his own. After seeing that Hope was getting ready to murder a politician, Scott tried to reason with her, but Hope who was blaming Scott and the X-Men for Cable’s death didn't want to hear any of it so he decided to take down Banshee before confronting Hope again.

Hope pointed her gun at Scott and told him he came back too soft and that the world had no place for soft anymore, as she was about to shoot Magik teleported Logan behind her but despite his intervention the shot was fired and Cyclops was hit in the eye.

Angry about what Hope just did, Logan swore he would kill her but Hope managed to borrow Cyclops’ powers and blasted Wolverine away before killing the politician. Thanks to his healing factor, Logan was quickly back on his feet and impaled Hope on his claws and was about to kill her when the injured Cyclops told him to spare her before falling unconscious and in a coma for six days.[649]

Hulkverines[]

After he discovered that both Bruce Banner and Logan came back to life, Dario Agger decided to trick them into fighting Clayton “Clay” Cortez a.k.a Weapon H who betrayed him previously.[650] Since his return, Logan spent several weeks tracking down Weapon H and thanks to the anonymous tips from Dario Agger, he finally found him in a brawl with both Hulk and the Leader, Logan decided to intervene and engaged into a battle with Weapon H.[651]

The battle was short as Weapon H weakened by the Leader's gamma altering virus and by Logan's attacks decide to run away in order to track the Leader who threatened his family. As Clay ran away from their fight, Logan understood that all of this was just a set up and as a result he decided to help both Clay and Bruce Banner.[652] When the trio understood who was behind all of this, Logan and Bruce were kidnapped by the Leader and Doctor Alba and with the use of nanotechnology the mad scientists managed to combine the DNA and the powers of the two heroes and turned them into "Hulkverines."

Full of rage and uncontrollable, they were set loose near a nuclear reactor where they started to destroy everything before turning on each other. Weapon H being the only one able to survive the radiation decided to intervene and put an end to this madness but he was no match against the two Hulkverines and was about to get killed until he saw both the Leader and Doctor Alba from afar.

Weapon H decided to run away and lure both Hulk and Wolverine to the Leader and Alba, seeing no other choice the two villains decided to revert Logan and Bruce to their original form before teleporting away. The battle over, Clay rejoined his family while Logan and Bruce decided to go get a drink.[653]

War of the Realms[]

After his team up with the Immortal Hulk and Weapon H, Wolverine decided to go to a bar and get some drinks but unfortunately at the same time the Earth was attacked by Malekith and his army. After meeting with the Punisher, Wolverine decided to intervene, he fought Malekith's army and helped refugees to go to Doctor Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum where Strange was supposed to teleport them away thanks to one of his spell.[654]

Unfortunately, Strange's spell proved to be too powerful and it teleported both the refugees and the heroes away leaving earth defenseless against Malekith's army which resulted in the death of Valkyrie.[655]

After being teleported to the Avengers Mountain, Wolverine met with his old Avengers teammates Iron Fist, Luke Cage, Spider-Man and Captain America and together they decided to head to Utgard the capital city of Jotunheim where Thor has been trapped by Malekith. Now in the Land of the Giants, the team was attacked by several Frost Giants but in the end they were able to defeat them, the battle over Logan heard Thor's screams from afar.

Before they could investigate the screams, the team met the Superior Spider-Man and the West Coast Avengers which allowed Logan and Quentin Quire to have a brief reunion. After some talks with Spider-Man, Otto Octavius and the West Coast Avengers went back to California to face Malekith’s army.[656]

The team then resumed their investigation and they discovered that Thor was in a berserker state and had killed several frost giants.[657] The team was able to extract Thor and after paying their respect after the death of the Valkyrior Steeds that helped them during their mission, they returned to Avengers Mountain in order to plan the next phase of their offensive against Malekith army.[658][657]

Logan then went to Shanghai and helped both Hogun and Fandral against several Fire Goblins,[659] once done he went to back to New York City and helped She-Hulk, the Punisher and the League of the Realms against Malekith’s army until it was defeated. Now that the war was over, Logan told Frank he would buy him a beer to celebrate their victory, but the Punisher refused saying that his war wasn’t over yet.[660]

The Savage Avengers[]

Not long after the end of the War of the Realms, Wolverine discovered that his friend Signore Saviano has been kidnapped. Despite missing some of his memories, Logan still remembered Saviano who helped him in the past. During his investigations, Logan was attacked by members of the Hand that he quickly dispatched but before killing the last of them he learned that his friend was taken to the City of Sickles in the Savage Land.[661]

Wolverine then went to the Savage Land to rescue his friend (unknown to Logan Saviano was already dead) and fought against the Hand again until he met a strange barbarian named Conan. Conan mistakenly attacked Logan and a fight broke between them, but after a while Conan finally understood that Logan didn't want to kill him and they decided to help each other. After parting way, Wolverine discovered that Doctor Voodoo had been captured by this strange cult and despite Logan's pleas Jericho was killed in front of him by a Sickle Priest.[662]

Furious about what happened, Logan teared through several Hand Soldiers and faced the murderer of Jericho, despite gaining the upper hand the Sickle Priest was able to escape. Still hopeful he could help Jericho, Logan decided to perform an open heart surgery on him, then used his own blood while doing some CPR which brought Jericho back to life. Jericho then helped Logan fighting against the Hand until they faced the leader of this cult, a wizard named Kulan Gath.[663]

Unfortunately, Voodoo and Wolverine were no match against Kulan Gath and as a result Logan was captured and used as a blood sacrifice by the mad wizard in order to awaken Jhoatun Lau the Marrow God, while Voodoo managed to escape in order to find a way to free Logan. Voodoo faced Kulan Gath once again shortly after but this time, he was joined by Conan, the Punisher and Elektra and together they were able to free Logan.[664]

But it was too late Kulan Gath was able to summon the Marrow God, Wolverine and the team tried to fight both Kulan Gath and Jhoatun Lau but they proved to be too powerful for them. Logan was absorbed by the Marrow God who was then teleported by Kulan Gath to Shanghai which prompted Conan, Elektra, Punisher and Voodoo to follow it.[665]

In Shanghai, a cosmically mutated Venom decided to join the fight and fought against the Marrow God until the arrival of the team. After Logan was able to free himself from the Marrow God, the team was able to defeat Jhoatun Lau. Once done they decided to go back to the city of Sickles in order to deal with Kulan Gath once and for all.

But while here, Kulan Gath revealed to the team the truth, they were soon to become his pawns before disappearing. Voodoo explained to the team that it was Gath’s plan all along, he wanted them to fight against Jhoatun Lau in order for them to be infected by the Marrow God’s sickness. After this revelation, Voodoo decided to go after Kulan Gath and told Elektra to warn Doctor Strange, before leaving he created a magical gate to allow anyone to go back to New York.

Conan and the Punisher decided to take the long way and returned to New York on foot while Elektra, Venom and Wolverine went back to New York using the Magical gate created by Voodoo.[666]

A Death in the Family[]

Unknown to Logan, while he was helping the Avengers against Malekith, Cyclops awakened from his coma and the X-Men also had to fight against Malekith's army and Sabretooth on their own.[667]

Back in New York, Wolverine went back to the X-Men just as Cyclops decided to hand to Captain America the MLF members they've captured previously except for Hope and Banshee, before going after the new Brotherhood of Mutants led by what appears to be Magneto. After what happened with Hope, Cyclops stepped down as a leader and the other X-Men members voted to have both Hope and Banshee joined their ranks.

After the voting, Rahne told both Scott and Logan that she couldn't do it anymore, that she needed to live a normal life, both of them respected her choice and Logan told Scott to let her go, since you can't force someone to fight for your cause if their heart isn't in it anymore. With Rahne out of the team, the new X-Men team went to face Magneto and his brotherhood.

During the battle the X-Men were overwhelmed by both Magneto and the Juggernaut but along the way, Magneto lost his helmet and Karma discovered that this man wasn't the real Magneto but Joseph. Angry by Joseph lying to him, Juggernaut betrayed Joseph and helped the X-Men defeat him before asking to join their ranks.

But before the X-Men could say anything, Joseph was suddenly beheaded by the resurrected Kwannon who said that Joseph was too dangerous to live. Before the X-Men could do anything, Dani Moonstar suddenly fell to the ground screaming that Rahne just died.[668]

Angry by what just happened, Logan decided to track Rahne killers with Kwannon's help. Once he found them he asked Kwannon to show him what they did, and after witnessing the murder of Rahne Logan decided to take care of the murderers once and for all. But it turned out that the O*N*E was waiting for them in order to take Logan down, but both Wolverine and Kwannon fought back and killed everyone as retaliation for what happened to Rahne.

Shortly after, Logan went back to Harry's hideaway but Cyclops was angry that he skipped Rahne's funeral and when he saw that Logan was covered in blood, Scott has had enough and wanted Logan out of the team. After Logan told him that Rahne died because of them and that many more will die afterwards a fight broke between them. The two men were separated by the Juggernaut who told them that someone made them forget the existence of Emma Frost.[669]

Soon after Wolverine decided to quit the team and warned Magik to not trust anyone and to make their mission count because they won't have another chance. Logan's suspicions proved to be right as it was revealed that the Captain America the X-Men talked to previously, and to whom they handed their prisoners was Mystique all along working with Emma Frost.[670] Now out of the team Logan decided to team up with Kwannon who helped him recover his memories of Emma, he then tracked Emma, Mystique, Elixir and Marrow (the new members of the Hellfire Club) with Kwannon’s Help.[644]

After finding them, a fight broke and Kwannon was stabbed by Mystique. Logan was able to handle Emma's Hellfire soldiers and defeated Marrow but as he was about to attack Emma he was stopped by O*N*E soldiers and was then taken into custody by General Callahan.[671]

Logan was taken to Hotel Romeo where he was healed by former X-Men student Triage. After Triage was electrocuted by O*N*E, Logan finally woke up and began to attack O*N*E soldiers all around him. Afterwards, Logan found Velocidad, now merged with the Transmode Virus. Velocidad explained that O*N*E was using him to grow multiple Warlocks. As Velocidad was close to death, he told Logan to tell Blindfold that he was sorry that he didn't believe her and that she was right. Logan said that he would, stabbing Velocidad with his claws do end his suffering. As Logan continued to fight his way out of the secret O*N*E facility, the X-Men appeared. Logan was hurt in an explosion caused by a O*N*E sentinel, Banshee was killed not long afterwards by this sentinel and General Callahan deactivated Magik's Mutant powers, only for her to transform into Darkchilde and destroy the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak, causing Juggernaut to lose his powers. Duplicating Magik's mutant powers, Hope teleported Logan and the remaining X-Men back to Manhattan but Logan fell in a coma because of a chemical he inhaled during the explosion while the rest of the X-Men discovered that Emma Frost, with the help of Doctor Nemesis, Fabian Cortez and Mister Sinister, removed the bomb implanted inside her head by the general Calahan and used her own version of Cerebro to remove the concept of mutant kind from every minds on the planet.[672]

Shortly after Logan awaken from his coma and attacked Mister Sinister on sight and killed him, revealing he was a clone all along. Logan learned what Emma did and told her she was a fool if she thought it was over.
